title: UI/UX Director
description:
Labhouse is a fast-growing startup that builds, launches, and scales its own AI & Productivity Apps, operating under a subscription-based business model.

Based in Barcelona, Labhouse was founded by Andrés Bou and Horacio Martos (Co-Founders of SocialPoint).

We operate at the intersection of mobile technology, AI, and product-driven growth, with a strong focus on experimentation and performance.

Would you like to make an impact as part of a company that builds the best mobile apps used by millions of users worldwide? If so, discover your next challenge below.

**About the Role:**
===================

As UI/UX Director, you will set the design vision for Labhouse and be accountable for the quality and impact of the experience across our whole app portfolio. Working as a direct partner to the CEO and Head of Product, you will decide how design is done in the company: the standards, the process, the team and the level of craft that sets our apps apart.

This is a leadership role with **deep craft and hands-on work**. You will set the strategy and build the design team, and still step in on the work that matters most, from defining a new app's concept to reviewing the final pixels, animations and store assets. You will own the design system across all products, make sure every launch meets a best-in-class bar, and tie design decisions directly to business results: activation, retention, conversion and store performance.

**What you'll own:**
====================

* **Design vision and strategy:** define the UI/UX principles, visual language and quality bar for the whole portfolio, and bring them to every product decision at leadership level.
* **0 1 launches:** lead the experience for new apps from concept to launch, including research, benchmarking, prototyping and validation with real users.
* **Craft and production quality:** set the standard for every asset we ship: UI, illustrations, icons, motion, animations, store screenshots and videos, and make sure what engineering ships matches what was designed.
* **Measurable design impact:** work with Product and Data to turn onboarding, paywall, core flow and store-asset improvements into measurable gains in activation, conversion, retention and store conversion rate.
* **Design system at scale:** own a portfolio-wide design system that lets us launch new apps faster while keeping consistency and craft.
* **AI-native design workflows:** introduce AI tools into research, ideation, asset creation and prototyping to multiply the team's output.
* **Build and scale design teams**: hiring, mentoring and developing senior talent.

**About You:**
==============

**Craft and technical expertise:**

* Solid track record in product, UX/UI, or visual design, including leading design teams or a design function.
* Experience leading the design of consumer mobile apps from scratch to scale (ideally millions of users), with clear business impact you can quantify.
* A portfolio that shows both exceptional craft and strategic thinking: from early concepts to shipped, high-performing products.
* An artistic eye for color, composition, typography and motion, able to lead and review any type of asset.
* Mastery of Figma and Adobe Creative Suite, and the ability to jump in hands-on.
* Deep knowledge of iOS and Android design guidelines, and of how to go beyond them to create distinctive experiences.

**Product and business focus:**

* Experience owning design strategy at leadership level and influencing founders and executives on product direction.
* A product-first mindset: you think in user problems, hypotheses and outcomes, not just screens.
* Comfortable working with data: you use analytics, A/B tests and store metrics to guide and defend design decisions.
* Strong understanding of consumer app monetization (subscriptions, paywalls, onboarding) and how design moves it.
* Self-driven and entrepreneurial, with high ownership and comfort working directly with founders in a fast-paced environment.

**Communication:**

* Fluent in spoken and written English
* Ability to collaborate effectively with cross-functional teams, including engineering, product, and marketing.

**Nice to Have:**
=================

* Experience in a portfolio or app studio model, managing design across several products at the same time.

**What we Offer:**
==================

* Remote work from anywhere in Spain. If you are based in Barcelona, we would love for you to join us at the office (Barcelona Tech City) at least two days a week.
* Flexible working hours.
* Permanent contract with competitive compensation.
* High-end equipment for your development.
* A top entrepreneurial team in a dynamic startup environment.
* Opportunity to lead, grow, and take on big challenges.
* Work with cutting-edge technologies, including the chance to integrate AI models into new apps.

**Hiring Process**
==================

* **TA Interview** – Initial conversation to get to know each other and understand your background.
* **CEO** – Deep dive into your product thinking, design experience, and fit with the team.
* **Technical Case** – Practical exercise to assess your product, analytical, and strategic capabilities.
* **Final Interview** – Final conversation to ensure alignment on expectations, culture, and role fit.

**You should Know:**
====================

Labhouse is proud to be an equal-opportunity employer. However you identify or whatever your journey to this point, we welcome all candidates to apply for the position that inspires them.

Come join us and help us build a company that everyone is proud to be part of.

title: Creative Strategist
description:
**About Social Scout**

Social Scout is the fastest-growing retention agency in the eCommerce industry, helping DTC brands generate more repeat purchases and increase customer lifetime value through email and SMS marketing.

We currently work with 150+ full-service retainer client accounts and are rapidly expanding into conversion rate optimization (CRO) and webpage design services.

We’re hiring a prolific, high-velocity Creative Strategist to lead our internal client acquisition pipeline. Managing over $110,000/month in internal Meta ad spend, your primary objective will be to conceptualize, script, launch, and scale high-converting B2B ad campaigns that convince eCommerce founders, CMOs, and heads of growth to hire Social Scout.

Our goal is simple: book more qualified calls, sign more clients, and accelerate our growth even further. We want to double, and eventually triple, our current ad spend as quickly as performance allows.

This role will initially focus heavily on scaling our core email and SMS marketing offer, while also helping us expand into new acquisition funnels for CRO and related services.

We’re looking for someone who can operate at high velocity, aiming for 60+ ad variations per week, while still thinking strategically about messaging, hooks, angles, creative formats, testing, and performance.

**Compensation & Role Details**

* Highly competitive salary.
* Full-time (40 hours per week) and fully remote.
* You must be set up and hired as a contractor.
* Fluent English required (written and spoken).
* A minimum five hour overlap between 9:00 AM – 5:00 PM EST.

**The Role**

As a Creative Strategist, you will sit at the intersection of creative concepts, rapid content production, and ad account execution. You won't just be writing briefs, you will actively write scripts, direct existing video footage (studio recordings, founder clips, B-roll, client interviews), manage UGC creator relationships, collaborate with video editors, and directly launch campaigns inside Meta Ads Manager.

This is a high-volume, performance-first role built for someone who understands how to use creative as the primary targeting lever in B2B and performance marketing.

### **What You'll Be Doing**

* High-Velocity Scripting & Concepting: Develop 60 ad creative concepts/variations weekly using modular testing frameworks (swapping hooks, CTAs, angles, and visual formats) tailored for Meta.
* Content & Production Management: Utilize our existing media library (founder studio footage, client interviews, B-roll) to brief video editors. Sourcing and managing relationships with external UGC creators and B2B actors as needed.
* Meta Campaign Setup & Launch: Upload, set up, and launch ad creatives directly inside Meta Ads Manager, ensuring accurate naming conventions, headlines, primary text, and campaign setups.
* Performance Analysis & Testing: Analyze front-end metrics (Hook Rate, Hold Rate, CTR, CPL) and down-funnel performance. Continually iterate on winning angles and eliminate underperforming creative assets.
* Service Ecosystem Synergy: Work closely with our email marketing and upcoming CRO/webpage design teams to ensure ad messaging seamlessly connects with landing pages and backend nurture flows.
* Platform Expansion Strategy: Lead initial efforts on Meta while laying the foundation to repurpose winning creative formats into future channels like LinkedIn and Google.

### **What You Bring**

* 2+ years of hands-on experience as a Performance Creative Strategist focused heavily on Meta Ads.
* Proven track record writing scripts and concepts for short-form video (Reels/UGC) and static graphics that drive direct-response conversions.
* Experience in high-volume creative testing environments, capable of managing asset pipelines and briefing video editors efficiently.
* Hands-on proficiency with Meta Ads Manager, including campaign creation, ad upload, ad copy execution, and metric tracking.
* Strong understanding of creative analytics: You know how to read Hook Rates (3-second view rates), Hold Rates, and CTRs to diagnose why an ad is winning or losing.
* Organized workflow management: Comfortable managing raw footage libraries, creator briefs, and editing queues without letting details slip through the cracks.

### **Who You Are**

* A natural storyteller who understands psychology: You know how to stop the scroll, address pain points, and communicate complex value propositions clearly and persuasively.
* Data-driven and volume-minded: You understand that scaling on Meta requires constant creative iteration and rapid testing rather than relying on a single "perfect" ad.
* Detail-obsessed: From ad copy formatting and UTM links to upload settings in Meta Ads Manager, you hold high standards for accuracy and quality assurance.
* Proactive and execution-focused: You don't wait for footage to be delivered—you review existing raw assets, pull client interviews, write scripts, and push campaigns live efficiently.

### **Why Social Scout?**

* High-impact position: Own the flagship creative production process driving $110k+/month in Meta ad spend across a growing portfolio of 150+ clients.
* Access to strong creative assets: Work with dedicated studio footage, head of growth recordings, client interviews, and in-house video editing support.
* Career growth: Opportunity to shape and lead our expanding paid social department as we scale into new platforms (LinkedIn, Google) and offer cross-channel CRO services.
* A fast-moving, supportive culture: Collaborative environment with proven marketers who celebrate wins and value performance-driven creativity.

title: Art Director, Elevated Shopping
description:

title: Creative Director, Marketing
description:

Based in Barcelona, Labhouse was founded by Andrés Bou and Horacio Martos (Co-Founders of SocialPoint).

We operate at the intersection of mobile technology, AI, and product-driven growth, with a strong focus on experimentation and performance.

Would you like to make an impact as part of a company that builds the best mobile apps used by millions of users worldwide? If so, discover your next challenge below.

**About the Role:**

As Creative Director, you will own the creative vision behind how the world discovers our apps, and you will make a real share of that work yourself. Working as a direct partner to the CEO and the Marketing Leadership, you will define our brand voice and visual identity across the portfolio, and lead the creative engine that fuels our growth: user-acquisition campaigns, store presence, social content and brand storytelling.

This is a player-coach role. You will spend a significant part of your time hands-on: concepting, scripting, designing, animating and editing. You will also lead a team of creatives, setting direction, giving feedback and raising their craft. You will be accountable for creative that is both beautiful and effective, tying creative decisions directly to business results

* Expert-level, hands-on skills in short-form video: hooks, storytelling, pacing, editing and platform-native formats.

* Comfortable working with data. You read ad dashboards, creative analytics and A/B test results to guide and defend creative decisions.
* Experience mentoring creatives and managing freelancers and creators.

**Communication:**

* Fluent in spoken and written English.
* Able to pitch creative ideas in a compelling way, write clear briefs, and give direct, constructive feedback to the team.
* Ability to collaborate effectively with cross-functional teams, including UX, engineering, product, and marketing.

title: Performance Creative Strategist — Freelance
description:
**Modalidad: Freelance · 100% remoto (España / UE, horario CET)**

**Idiomas: español nativo o profesional · inglés fluido**

### **Sobre el rol**

En Ironhack buscamos un/a Performance Creative Strategist freelance que combine pensamiento creativo, copywriting y estrategia orientada a performance. Alguien que entienda la publicidad digital desde la idea hasta el resultado: que sepa identificar un insight, convertirlo en un concepto creativo potente y traducirlo en anuncios capaces de captar la atención, generar interés y convertir.

Trabajarás mano a mano con nuestra diseñadora gráfica para convertir las ideas en creatividades listas para testear, aprender y escalar. La autonomía y el criterio creativo son clave: esperamos que detectes la oportunidad, desarrolles la idea y des una dirección clara a diseño hasta su ejecución.

### **Tus responsabilidades**

* Performance creative y copywriting: desarrollarás conceptos, hooks, headlines, body copy y CTAs orientados a conversión, partiendo de los pain points y motivaciones de nuestra audiencia (cambio de carrera, empleabilidad, progresión profesional). Serás responsable del criterio creativo y estratégico final.
* Conectar datos y creatividad: junto al equipo de Marketing, usarás métricas como CTR, CPA, CVR y frecuencia para detectar oportunidades y convertirlas en nuevas hipótesis, ángulos, formatos y variaciones creativas.
* Dirección creativa y briefing: no necesitas ser diseñador/a, pero sí tener un criterio visual y publicitario sólido. Crearás briefs y/o wireframes que indiquen qué debe comunicar la pieza, qué debe captar la atención, cuál es la jerarquía del mensaje y qué elementos deben destacar. Darás feedback y dirigirás las iteraciones hasta llegar a la creatividad final.
* Creative research e innovación: investigarás de forma continua la Meta Ad Library, TikTok y otras fuentes para identificar tendencias, formatos y oportunidades, analizando competidores directos e indirectos y siempre respetando nuestro Brandbook y posicionamiento.
* Project management: gestionarás el proceso creativo de principio a fin: planificación de ideas, briefs, coordinación con diseño, seguimiento de entregables y preparación de los assets finales para su lanzamiento, cumpliendo los plazos acordados.

### **Lo que buscamos**

* Creative thinking y performance copywriting — Prioridad #1. Generas ideas publicitarias originales que destacan en un feed saturado y sabes explicar por qué deberían funcionar, qué insight explotan y cómo se pueden testear. Tu portfolio demuestra publicidad digital orientada a performance, no solo piezas visualmente atractivas.
* Project management — Prioridad #2. Eres una persona organizada, metódica y autónoma en remoto. Sabes estructurar proyectos, gestionar prioridades y coordinar a otros perfiles para entregar a tiempo.
* Experiencia demostrable en creative strategy para Meta Ads, idealmente en entornos de performance marketing.
* Criterio creativo y atención al detalle. Trabajas dentro de unos Brand Guidelines y Value Propositions definidos sin perder la capacidad de proponer ideas nuevas y diferenciadoras.
* Orientación a resultados. Quieres entender por qué funciona una creatividad y usas los resultados de cada test para alimentar la siguiente ronda de ideas.
* Idiomas: español nativo o profesional para escribir copy; inglés fluido.

### **Será valorable**

* Experiencia en agencia de publicidad
* Experiencia con funnels de adquisición y lead generation.
* Conocimientos básicos de CapCut (edición de vídeo) y Figma.
* Experiencia creando o participando en contenido UGC.

### **Proceso de selección**

* Candidatura: responde a las preguntas de selección e incluye el link a tu portfolio en tu CV.
* Caso práctico: te lo enviaremos por email (45–60 min de trabajo estimado).
* Entrevista: defensa del caso práctico y revisión de un proyecto real de tu portfolio y sus resultados.

### **Portfolio**

Para valorar tu candidatura, incluye un portfolio con ejemplos de performance creative. Siempre que sea posible, añade no solo las piezas y el copy, sino también el contexto del test, el objetivo y los resultados (CTR, CPA, CVR u otras métricas relevantes).

Nos interesa entender qué problema intentabas resolver, cuál era tu hipótesis creativa, cómo llegaste al concepto, qué ejecutaste y qué aprendiste. Las candidaturas sin portfolio no serán consideradas.

title: AI Creative Strategist
description:
Impact Clients is building a new organic growth channel around highly targeted social media pages in the supplement space, each with its own character, audience, voice, and content strategy.

The goal is simple: create genuinely useful content that earns attention organically, builds trust with specific demographics, and ultimately drives supplement sales through relevant affiliate offers.

As our **AI Creative Strategist**, you’ll own the thinking behind the content: developing new characters and avatars, finding angles that resonate with different audiences, writing hooks and scripts, analyzing what performs, and building a repeatable creative system that can scale across dozens of pages.

This isn’t only a content role.

What we learn from building this division will eventually become part of the curriculum taught inside our education company. You’ll help train our coaches and students on what’s working while also giving direct product feedback to our engineering team on the AI creative tools you use every day.

You’ll be helping build the playbook from zero.

**ABOUT IMPACT CLIENTS**

Impact Clients is a fast-growing tech-enabled education company helping everyday people build online businesses through a combination of education, coaching, community, and proprietary software.

Our culture is built around **clarity, extreme ownership, high standards, and speed of execution**.

We move quickly. We expect people to solve problems without constant direction. And we give talented people a significant amount of ownership when they demonstrate they can produce results.

If you thrive in environments where creativity and speed go hand-in-hand, where your work gets implemented immediately, and where you're expected to think like an owner rather than an employee, you'll fit in well here.

***This is a fully remote, full-time role.***

WHAT’S IN IT FOR YOU

* **A blank canvas.** Start from zero and shape the avatars, angles, accounts, and content strategy from the ground up.
* **A path to leadership.** Help build the team as the channel grows, with the opportunity to eventually lead the creative division.
* **A team around you.** Work alongside AI video editors and publishing support so your time stays focused on strategy, copy, and creative direction.
* **Freedom to test.** No ad spend approvals or endless creative bottlenecks. Put ideas into the market, learn what works, and iterate quickly.
* **Simple production.** Let the strength of the idea carry the content without the heavy production requirements often associated with paid creative.
* **Exposure across three business units.** Help build a new supplement division, shape how the playbook is taught inside our education business, and influence the roadmap of our proprietary software.
* **Real influence beyond your own function.** What you discover can become curriculum taught to thousands of students, while your daily use of AI tools helps determine what our engineering team builds next.

**WHAT YOU’RE GETTING INTO - The Day To Day of this Role:**

* Creating the AI avatars: determine which demographics deserve their own character, what those characters should represent, and which concepts should be killed.
* Generate **10–20 new ideas, hooks, and angles every day** for short form 7-30 second reels.
* Write and direct scripts for **30–60 second organic Reels**, then hand them to the AI video editing team for production.
* Own what gets tested across **5–10+ Instagram and Facebook accounts**, each with its own personality, demographic, and content strategy.
* Match message to demographic precisely. A 45-year-old man and a 68-year-old woman should not receive the same hook, framing, or script.
* Turn genuinely useful information into content that earns trust first, allowing the offer in the bio to convert second.
* Study account-level performance and identify which avatars, hooks, formats, and topics are receiving organic distribution.
* Retire weak avatars and scale the characters and concepts that show traction.
* Turn winning creative patterns into repeatable systems rather than one-off successes.
* Help build the department once the model is proven, including future strategists, editors, and publishing support.

Approximately 10–20% of your time:

* Once the model is proven, help build course content for the company's education division
* Run a weekly group coaching call helping students apply what we've learned.
* Give our software engineering team hands-on feedback about how to improve the internal AI tools you use every day.

**WHO YOU ARE**

* You come from the **direct-response Meta advertising world**, ideally within supplements, health, wellness, or another performance-driven ecommerce category.
* You have produced paid creative at meaningful volume — ideally **hundreds or thousands of assets per month**.
* You are a strong direct-response copywriter, and developing hooks, angles, and concepts is one of your favorite parts of the job.
* You've developed messaging for demographics significantly different from your own.
* You understand that what moves men aged 40–50 may be completely different from what moves women aged 60–70 — and you know how to adjust the creative accordingly.
* You can look at performance data and turn what is working into the next generation of creative ideas.
* You are comfortable testing aggressively, killing losing concepts quickly, and doubling down on winners.
* You are highly fluent with AI creative tools. Our current stack includes **Higgsfield, Google Flow Omni, Openart, and CapCut**.
* You can operate independently without needing a detailed SOP for every decision.
* Ideally, you've also worked on an **info-product, course, or coaching-based offer**, particularly in the make-money-online or start-an-online-business space (optional, though preferred).

The ideal candidate brings an unusual combination: **ecommerce/supplement direct-response experience + strong creative strategy and copywriting + familiarity with info-product or coaching businesses.**

**WHAT SUCCESS LOOKS LIKE In Your First 90 Days On Our Team**

**30 Days:**  
Three to five avatars are defined, scripted, and actively in production. A consistent daily idea pipeline exists so the editing team is never waiting on creative direction. The first Reels are live across the initial accounts.

**60 Days:**  
We have a clear understanding of which characters, hooks, topics, and angles Instagram and Facebook are actually distributing. Weak avatars are being retired, winning concepts are being expanded across additional accounts, and each audience is matched to a relevant offer.

A repeatable system exists from avatar brief creative concept script production published Reel performance analysis across 5–10+ accounts, without requiring you to manually touch every step.

You should also be able to clearly tell us what the department needs next, where the bottlenecks are, and who we need to hire to continue scaling it.

description:
**About the company**

### **Tomorrow University: A Next-Generation University for Impactful Careers**

Education is the most powerful lever for driving the transition to a sustainable society. That’s why we’ve built a university dedicated to educating and empowering the change-makers of tomorrow. We offer accredited degree programs designed to equip learners with 21st-century competencies while providing access to a world-class network of experts to maximize their impact.

As a remote-first institution, we use technology and AI to enable flexible, personalized learning - accessible from anywhere in the world.

We are proud to be the first EdTech startup in Europe with a fully state-recognized university license and to be ranked among the **Top 20 EdTech startups globally**.

### **Our Inspiration**

We believe that transforming education requires rethinking how we teach. At Tomorrow University, we move beyond the traditional, teacher-centered approach and embrace **a student-centric learning model**. Our goal is to equip learners with the essential skills and mindset needed to create global impact, supported by a vast network of change-makers.

### **Our Mission**

At Tomorrow University, we leverage **science and technology** to enhance learning while fostering a global community for continuous growth and impact. Our students learn by **applying their knowledge to real-world challenges** and engaging with world-class educators, mentors, and partners from around the globe.

**Be aware that all of our positions are completely Remote but our working hours are Central European Time (+/- 2h)**

**About the role**

The marketing team works across three growth levers: **create demand, acquire demand, convert demand.** Four people own that work between them. **You own create demand.**

Your job is to make more of the right people want a Tomorrow University degree.

Choosing a degree is a slow, expensive, high-trust decision. People discover us, come back weeks later, attend an event, compare options, worry about cost, and take time to decide. Your work gives them a reason to pay attention and helps build the confidence to take the next step.

You set the content strategy and produce much of the work yourself. You decide what we say, who we say it to, which formats and channels we use, and what is worth testing. Most weeks, that also means writing, filming, editing, or building the asset.

You have support. Part-time creators help increase output once we know what works, and our designer supports the work that needs stronger craft or brand treatment.

We are looking for someone who likes making things, putting them in market, and learning from the response. The goal is consistent demand creation, with a clear view of which ideas, messages, and formats are actually working.

What You'll Own

Make people want this degree

* Develop the content strategy across programs, markets, paid, organic, and social. You decide the ideas, the messages, the proof points behind them, and which audiences they are for.
* Turn our positioning into creative that people understand and remember. That means knowing how to express an idea through copy, design, photography, video, or a combination of them.
* Lead the creative for program launches and seasonal campaigns from first idea to execution.

Work at strategy level and make the work yourself

This is a small startup, so the role moves between strategy and execution all the time.

* You write exceptionally well and can take an idea from rough concept to finished asset yourself.
* You are comfortable designing in Figma or Canva, shooting photography, filming and editing video, and producing short-form content for social and paid. You also know when a stronger piece needs a specialist.
* Freelancers and creators are there to support and scale the work, but you need enough creative range and judgement to direct them well.
* Use AI image and video tools where they are genuinely useful, alongside more traditional production.

Own social content strategy and creation

You own what we say on social and what we make for it.

* Set the social content strategy, generate the ideas, write the posts, develop recurring formats, and brief UGC creators.
* Produce the core content yourself and work with freelancers or creators where additional production is needed.
* Work closely with our part-time Social Media Coordinator, who manages scheduling, publishing, engagement, commenting, and the day-to-day running of the channels.
* Build content with both organic and paid use in mind where it makes sense.

Test ideas and build on what works

* Work with Performance Marketing on a regular creative testing rhythm across messages, concepts, formats, and audiences.
* Keep a clear record of which angles work by program and market so future campaigns start with evidence.
* Decide what to test next, stop producing ideas that are not working, and develop the ones that are.
* Bring the useful learnings into the weekly review, including both the strong performers and the ideas that did not land.

What You Bring

* 7+ years in performance creative, growth marketing, content, or social. You have spent a meaningful part of that time making the work yourself.
* You are an excellent writer across hooks, scripts, ad copy, captions, and campaign messaging, and you know how to change the writing when the format changes.
* Comfortable shooting and editing yourself, whether that is on a phone, a camera, or whatever else the idea needs.
* You can design well enough in Figma or Canva to make strong static assets without waiting on a designer for every piece.
* **Creative testing is part of how you work.** You can isolate a variable, read the result properly, and decide what to change next.
* You know how to direct creators, freelancers, coordinators, and designers once an idea is working. Clear briefs and useful feedback matter more than process.
* AI image and video tools are already part of your production workflow, and you have a good sense of when they help and when they do not.
* You are comfortable being measured on outcomes beyond reach or engagement, including applications and enrolled students.
You believe education can change lives.  

  

Nice to have, not required:

* You speak German.
* You have worked in higher education, edtech, or another category with a long purchase decision.
* You have run creator or UGC programs.
* You can do motion design or advanced video editing.
* You are a strong photographer.
* You have worked on performance creative in a regulated category.

**What Matters to Us**

We’re looking for people who thrive in a dynamic, mission-driven environment. These traits are especially important to us:

* **Ownership & Independence** – You take initiative and get things done
* **Collaborative Mindset** – You enjoy working across teams and disciplines
* **Clear & Thoughtful Communication** – You know how to adapt your message to different audiences
* **Integrity, Curiosity & Growth** – You’re honest, open-minded, and always looking to learn
* **Proactivity & Drive** – You bring energy and momentum to your work
* **Commitment to Execution** – You don’t just dream big—you make things happen
* **Passion for Sustainability, Entrepreneurship & Technology** – You care deeply about building a better future

**Perks & Benefits**

**Grow with us**

At Tomorrow University, we foster lifelong learning. You’ll have access to our innovative programs and be part of a culture that encourages continuous growth, personally and professionally.

**Travel the world together**

Twice a year, we bring the whole team together for a week-long Workation somewhere in Europe, think bonding, brainstorming, and big ideas in beautiful places.

**Time to recharge**

You’ll get **25 vacation days** per year, plus public holidays based on your location.

**Ready to shape the future of education and make an impact? Join us and help reimagine how we learn, grow, and build a better tomorrow.**

At Tomorrow University, we believe in your potential, not your paperwork. Degrees are great, but your *drive* matters even more

description:
**About RoomPriceGenie**

Founded in 2017, RoomPriceGenie is dedicated to helping hoteliers around the globe achieve optimal pricing. We understand that many small hotels face challenges with digitalization, making their operations increasingly complex and often resulting in lost revenue. This is where we come in!

We have developed a powerful solution that enables hotels to set the right prices in just seconds. Our state-of-the-art algorithm analyzes both internal hotel data and market trends to recommend pricing strategies that enhance revenue and improve booking rates.

With customers spanning the globe—from the USA and Canada to Iceland, South Africa, China, Slovenia, Italy, and the UK—RoomPriceGenie has made a meaningful impact in the hospitality industry, and our clients love the results.

Now, we are excited to expand our customer base and spread the word about how we can support hoteliers in optimizing their pricing strategies. We invite you to join us on this journey! We actively encourage applications from candidates with diverse backgrounds to enrich our team and drive innovation.

**Your Responsibilities**
-------------------------

Before an independent hotelier sees anything related to RoomPriceGenie, they form a feeling. This role owns that feeling — and builds the systems that make it land consistently everywhere.

The Senior Brand Designer & System Lead is two things at once. First: a true brand designer who lives and breathes visual identity and creating unique identities, executes beautiful work personally, and holds a clear instinctive point of view on what makes RoomPriceGenie visually distinctive. Second: an AI systems architect who transforms how design happens inside the business — building the infrastructure and self-serve frameworks that put on-brand creative capability in the hands of every team member, not just designers.

What great looks like: No design bottlenecks, and the brand has never been more vibrant, distinct and alive.

**Core Accountabilities**
-------------------------

**Visual Identity Ownership** — Own and evolve the visual identity and full visual system; hold a proactive point of view on brand direction presentable to CMO, CEO, and exec team.

**Hero Creative Direction & Development** — Develop/commission and direct the highest-stakes assets — campaign visuals, brand films, event creative, exec presentations — leveraging a trusted freelance network as needed. Set the brief, start the creative process, hold the standard, sign off the output.

**Social Visual Direction** — Set the visual creative direction for LinkedIn, Instagram, and YouTube in partnership with Content and Demand. Be part of showing what ‘great’ looks like in asset production.

**Design AI System Architectur**e — Own the transformation of how design happens at RPG. Build and evolve the AI-powered creative infrastructure — brand-trained models, prompt libraries, and self-serve templates — that puts on-brand design capability in the hands of every team member. Own quality, fidelity, and adoption. Measure success by what the business creates on-brand.

**Brand QA** — Act as standard-keeper for all visual output; run fidelity checks across channels, regions, and partners; update models and templates as needed.

**Product Brand Partnership** — Partner on visual brand development with Product; find ways to ensure the RPG platform and external marketing brand feel connected and aligned — an active partnership, not an advisory one.

**What Success Looks Like**
---------------------------

Top-level qualitative markers — distinct from the KPI targets above.

* A hotelier, partner, or candidate who encounters RoomPriceGenie — in any format — feels something. Comfort, intelligence, warmth, confidence. The sense that we genuinely understand them, and we are an industry visionary. That distinct, uplifting, emotive connection is always present.
* Our brand surprises and delights. There are small, precise moments in our creative — a motion treatment, a colour choice, a typographic detail — where something lands better than expected. These moments accumulate into a brand that feels alive and unmistakably ours.
* RoomPriceGenie is immediately recognisable and genuinely distinctive in the hospitality-tech market. We look and feel like no one else.
* The wider business thinks differently about design because of this role. Teams that previously had no design capability now produce on-brand work independently.
* This person has a clear, articulated point of view on where our brand is going, and presents it credibly to the CMO, CEO, and exec team — proactively, not when asked.

**Your Profile**
----------------

3–5 years in brand design, with a portfolio that demonstrates strategic brand thinking and hands-on creative execution at a high level. This is not a production design role or a marketing design role. We are looking for someone who has owned brand identity — built it, evolved it, and made it unmistakably theirs.

**Required Skills**

* Proven track record of working specifically in brand design — not marketing design or design production. Portfolio must show visual identity work: how the brand was shaped, why decisions were made, what changed as a result
* Demonstrated experience building an AI-driven design system — prompt libraries, brand-trained generative models, AI-powered template frameworks, or visual toolkits used by teams beyond design
* A strong, trained creative instinct — an instinctive eye for what makes a brand visually distinctive. Can articulate why something works, what is off, and exactly what needs to change
* Genuinely brand-obsessed — thinks about brand direction constantly, not just when briefed. Has a point of view on where a brand should go before being asked for one
* Hands-on creative execution — can concept and create beautiful visual work personally, not only direct others. Portfolio shows both strategic direction and craft
* Experience building visual imaging systems — template frameworks, design tokens, channel adaptation rules — that allow a brand to be rolled out consistently, at scale, and at high quality
* Genuinely AI-first — uses AI generative tools (CanvaAI, Figma, ElevenLabs, Claude Design etc) as a core part of their creative workflow, not occasionally
* Experience commissioning and directing freelance creative talent with a clear brief and uncompromisingly high standards

**Advantageous Skills**

* B2B SaaS, tech, or hospitality-tech brand experience. Strong ICP empathy for hotel owner-operators is a meaningful plus
* Experience building self-serve Canva or Figma template systems for non-designer teams, including governance and quality control
* Existing knowledge of or curiosity about the independent hotel market

**What We Offer at RoomPriceGenie**

At RoomPriceGenie, we don’t just offer jobs; we offer an adventure! Join us in an exciting startup atmosphere where you can grow your career while changing the world for tens of thousands of independent hoteliers. Our global and diverse team is fueled by passion and a shared mission. We thrive in a culture that’s all about transparency, respect, and making a real impact together.

description:
**Who We Are**

At Kyndryl, we run and reimagine the mission-critical technology systems that drive advantage for the world’s leading businesses. We are at the heart of progress; with proven expertise and a continuous flow of AI-powered insight, enabling smarter decisions, faster innovation, and a lasting competitive edge. For our people—Kyndryls—that means doing purposeful work that powers human progress. Join us and experience a flexible, supportive environment where your well-being is prioritized and your potential can thrive.

**The Role**

Are you a strategist who makes, or a maker who thinks strategically? Can you turn an ambiguous enterprise challenge into a shared point of view, a testable experience, and evidence for the next decision? If you believe the best AI-enabled services are designed with clients and their users - not simply delivered to them - you will feel at home in the **AI Innovation Lab** with **Kyndryl Vital** .

**Kyndryl Vital** is a global network of designers, engineers, researchers, writers, and strategists helping organizations make sense of complexity and create experiences that are useful, responsible, and buildable. We combine behavioral insight, business understanding, and deep technology expertise so ideas can move beyond aspiration into delivery, adoption, and measurable value.

Based in Madrid and serving clients across Europe, the **AI Innovation Lab** is part studio, part workshop, and part proving ground. Client sponsors, frontline users, Kyndryl designers, and technologists work together in short, focused cycles: framing a challenge, making possibilities tangible, testing prototypes, and deciding what to stop, iterate, pilot, or scale. We favor demos over decks and evidence over opinion.

**The opportunity**

We are hiring two to three Creative Technologists who can bridge human-centered design, business strategy, and emerging technology. This is a shared role family, not a search for identical candidates. Everyone should be comfortable moving from ambiguity to a testable artifact, but each person will bring greater depth in one of two complementary profiles.

* **Strategic / Conceptual profile:** stronger in problem framing, systems thinking, co-design, service and conversational experience, synthesis, and helping senior stakeholders make decisions through tangible artifacts.
* **Practical / Technical profile:** stronger in rapid functional prototyping, low-code and AI platforms, APIs, data integration, agentic patterns, and turning workshop outputs into working demonstrations.

We do not expect every candidate to be equally deep in both profiles. We do expect curiosity across the full cycle, generosity in multidisciplinary teams, and the ability to make their thinking visible. Together, the Lab team should be able to frame, facilitate, build, test, and hand off.

**What you will do**

* **Shape the right challenge.** Work with sponsors and users to locate the real decision inside a broad brief, understand the current system, and define the behavior, outcome, or learning the engagement should create.
* **Design and facilitate co-creation.** Create participatory sessions for executives, subject-matter experts, frontline users, designers, and engineers. Enable people with different levels of confidence and authority to contribute meaningfully.
* **Make ideas tangible early.** Use sketches, scenarios, conversation flows, simulations, low-code tools, or working software to give participants something concrete to react to and improve.
* **Prototype with people.** Build during and between sessions, incorporating feedback while the problem and trade-offs are still visible. Choose fidelity deliberately: each artifact should answer a question or unlock a decision.
* **Design human-agent collaboration.** Create clear patterns for autonomy, approvals, escalation, uncertainty, exceptions, rollback, and human override so users remain informed and in control.
* **Test value and feasibility together.** Explore desirability, business value, data readiness, integration, security, operational impact, cost, and maintainability before recommending a pilot.
* **Turn learning into direction.** Synthesize observations and prototype evidence into opportunity areas, principles, requirements, success measures, and a credible stop / iterate / pilot / scale recommendation.
* **Create a clean path to delivery.** Partner with FDEs, architects, security, data, Consult Partners and delivery leads so validated concepts have an owner, documented assumptions, and an appropriate route forward.
* **Help build the Lab as a capability.** Contribute reusable methods, starter environments, component libraries, evaluation sets, showcases, and decision rituals so every engagement starts faster and leaves knowledge behind.

**Who You Are**

**Required Technical and Professional Expertise. What you bring.**

* **Human-centered and systemic thinking.** You apply human-centered design and design thinking techniques at a strategic level, connecting user behavior and lived experience with business goals, operating models, incentives, technology constraints, and wider organizational consequences.
* **Strategy through making.** You use artifacts and experiments to reduce ambiguity, surface assumptions, and improve decisions rather than treating prototyping as a final presentation step.
* **Participatory facilitation.** You can prepare and lead executive workshops and hands-on making sessions, read the room, rebalance participation, and adapt the plan without losing the intended outcome.
* **Cross-disciplinary fluency.** You collaborate credibly with Consult, design, business, FDEs, data, architecture, security, and client teams without pretending to be the deepest expert in every discipline.
* **AI experience literacy.** You understand how generative and agentic systems behave, where they fail, and how to design for uncertainty, trust, feedback, and appropriate human control.
* **Responsible experimentation.** You make data use, model limitations, permissions, safety, auditability, and ethical trade-offs explicit, proportionate to the risk and maturity of the prototype.
* **Evidence-led storytelling.** You communicate a compelling possibility while distinguishing what has been observed, assumed, simulated, validated, and still needs to be learned.
* **Enterprise pragmatism.** You move quickly while respecting governance, security, accessibility, and the realities of complex organizations.
* **Service Design.**

  

**Preferred Professional and Technical Expertise:**

  

**1) Creative Technologist – AI Experience Prototype**

Rapid creation of functional prototypes using low-code platforms, AI-assisted development, or code.

Hands-on experience with generative AI, prompt and context design, tool use, structured outputs, and agentic workflows.

Working knowledge of RAG, APIs, data integration, identity, permissions, and enterprise cloud patterns.

Ability to create credible web or conversational interfaces and represent loading, uncertainty, error, and edge cases.

Practical evaluation of response quality, groundedness, safety, latency, reliability, and cost.

Clear documentation of what is functional, simulated, reusable, and required for a production implementation.

  

**2) Creative Technologist – AI Strategy**

Advanced problem framing, systems thinking, design research, or experience strategy.

Design of co-creation formats that move groups from divergent perspectives to shared choices.

Synthesis of qualitative evidence into insights, hypotheses, principles, opportunity areas, and roadmaps.

Conversational and agentic experience design, including roles, boundaries, handoffs, and exception journeys.

Executive communication and the ability to challenge solution-first thinking constructively.

Enough prototyping fluency to make ideas testable using tools such as Figma, Miro, or low-code platforms.

  
  

**Tools and technologies**

You do not need experience with every product below. We are interested in transferable capability and evidence of learning quickly. The Lab's working environment is expected to include:

* **Co-creation and experience design:** Figma, FigJam, Miro, or equivalent tools.
* **Low-code and automation:** Microsoft Copilot Studio, Power Apps, Power Automate, or equivalent platforms.
* **AI prototyping:** Microsoft Foundry / Azure AI, model playgrounds, prompt and agent tooling, and evaluation services.

Lab engagements end with a clearer decision, not just more ideas.

Clients and users can see how their input changed the concept and understand the trade-offs.

Evidence, assumptions, risks, data needs, and unresolved questions are documented honestly.

Validated concepts transition with a sponsor, success measures, and a realistic technical and operational path.

Methods, components, and learning are reused across engagements rather than being lost after the demo.

  

**Experience and education**

A strong portfolio showing how you moved from ambiguity to a tangible outcome and what was learned. We are particularly interested in your decisions, contribution, trade-offs, and evidence - not only polished screens.

Relevant professional experience in creative technology, service or product design, innovation, engineering, or consulting. At this level, this is typically five or more years, but demonstrated scope and impact matter more than tenure alone.

Experience working with enterprise clients or similarly complex stakeholder, governance, and delivery environments.

Bachelor's degree in a relevant field or equivalent practical experience and demonstrable portfolio. Advanced study or continued education in design, HCI, technology, business, or AI is welcome but not required.

  

**Location and working model:** Madrid, Spain - hybrid, with regular in-person work in the AI Innovation Lab and at client locations.

**Country/Region:** Spain / European Principal Markets.

The “Kyn” in Kyndryl means kinship, which represents the strong bonds we have with each other, our customers and our communities. That sense of belonging — being a valued, respected, trusted member of the team — is fundamental to our culture and fueling great experiences for our customers. This dedication to welcoming everyone into our company means that Kyndryl gives you the ability to thrive and contribute to our culture of empathy and shared success. That’s The Kyndryl Way.

Your career with us isn’t just a job—it’s an adventure with purpose. We offer a dynamic, hybrid-friendly culture that supports your well-being and empowers you to grow. Our Be Well programs are thoughtfully designed to support your financial, mental, physical, and social health—because we know that when you feel your best, you do your best.
  
  
From your very first day, you’ll dive into impactful work that powers the systems our customers rely on every day. You won’t just contribute—you’ll make a difference, tackling meaningful projects that sharpen your skills and fuel your growth.
  
  
We’re here to champion your journey. With powerful tools to chart your career path, personalized development goals aligned with your ambitions, and continuous feedback to keep you inspired and on track, you’ll have everything you need to thrive and evolve. You’ll develop in-demand skills to grow your career and achieve your ambitions with access to cutting-edge learning opportunities—from certifications with Microsoft, Google, and Amazon to coaching and hands-on experiences. title: Creative Director
description:
The brands on your kitchen shelf are run by people doing extraordinary work that nobody sees.
  
  
We're building the platform they run on, and a brand they'll be proud to be part of.
  
  
Confido is the AI operating system that runs cash application, deductions, trade and planning in one place for CPG brands. That means Finance, Sales, and Ops finally work on the same number.
  
  
We’re trusted by 250+ brands managing $30B+ in revenue, including Daisy, OLIPOP, Simple Mills, Idahoan, and more. We've achieved best-in-class growth and recently raised a $55M Series B led by Insight Partners to accelerate our momentum.
  
  
If you want your work on shelves everywhere — and outsized ownership while you build — we'd love to meet you.
  
  
****The Role****
Most B2B software looks the same. A few companies have proven it doesn't have to: brands with real taste, that people follow, wear and want to work for.
  
  
Behind every CPG brand you love is a back office nobody sees: the finance lead chasing a deduction at 11pm, the sales team planning a promotion blind, the founder watching margin leak line by line. Confido exists for them. Your job is to tell their story, and ours, so well that people who have never heard the words "trade spend" want to be part of it.
  
  
This is a principal-level role. You'll be our first creative brand hire and the keeper of how Confido looks and feels, setting the creative direction for the company and holding the final call on the craft. A new strategy and identity are underway with our agency partner, and you'll take it from a set of guidelines to a brand with a point of view: one customers share, candidates join for, and competitors quietly copy.
  
  
You'll own every place someone meets us, from the website and launches to decks, ads, events, video and the brand moments inside our product. As the work grows, you'll build and direct a bench of specialists across illustration, motion, photography, video production, 3D, presentation design, web development and event fabrication. You'll report to our VP of Marketing and work closely with the founders.
  
  
****What You'll Do****

* Be the creative voice in the room. Partner with the founders and marketing leadership on how we tell our story and what the brand stands for
* Shape the brand from the ground up. Take the new identity from guidelines to a living system with a voice, a point of view and a standard people notice
* Find the story in the numbers. Turn customer outcomes, like $500K recouped for Feastables or revenue doubled with the same finance team at DUDE Wipes, into campaigns, films and stories people remember
* Make the invisible visible. Put the people, shelves, pallets and trucks of CPG at the centre of how we show up, never just another dashboard screenshot
* Own every surface. confido.com, launches, sales and customer decks, ads, social, email and the brand moments inside our product
* Create moments in the room. Concept and direct our booths, customer dinners and owned events so people leave talking about them. We care deeply about unreasonable hospitality - people should feel that across every experiential surface.
* Build your bench. Hire and direct specialists across illustration, motion, photography, video production, 3D, presentation design, web development and event fabrication, with the templates, intake and asset library that let them do their best work
* Make brand and product one. Partner with our product design team so every touchpoint feels like the same company

****What We're Looking For****

* 8+ years in brand design, art direction or creative direction, in-house, at an agency, or both, including time leading brand for a company or major client
* You're a storyteller first. You can take a complex, unglamorous idea and make people feel something about it
* A portfolio with a brand system you built or scaled, and work you're proud to show anyone
* Taste you can defend. You know the difference between good and world class
* Range: you can move from identity and web to a sales deck, a booth and a photo shoot in the same week
* Hands-on craft in Figma. You sweat the kerning and what the work does for the business
* You own work from concept to production, including vendors, printers, fabricators and budgets
* You're comfortable with ambiguity and speed, communicate clearly, and can hold an idea through founder and sales feedback

****Nice to Have****

* Brand experience at a B2B software or fintech company known for its design
* Experience working with or for CPG brands
* Motion design and video editing
* Designing and building websites in a no-code tool
* Experience leading designers or managing freelancers and agencies
* AI tools in your creative workflow, used as a multiplier rather than a gimmick

****🌴 Perks + Benefits****

* Equity — own a meaningful piece of the company you’re helping build
* Fully paid health coverage through Aetna — we cover 100% of employee premiums
* Top-tier dental and vision coverage through Guardian
* Carrot Fertility Pro — comprehensive fertility and family-forming support
* 12 weeks of paid parental leave
* Unlimited PTO — plus regular 4-day holiday weekends we actually take
* 401(k) through Vestwell
* Paid relocation support — we’ll help you make the move to NYC
* Fully equipped workspace from day one — laptop, monitor, keyboard, and a $200 stipend to personalize your setup
* Team perks — catered Friday lunches, team dinners, and unlimited coffee + snacks featuring products from the brands we work with

description:
Interested in joining Blue State's Creative Director team? Submit your application here to ensure you're first in line for future opportunities. Please note: this is an "evergreen" job post (i.e. not an active job post), but your expression of interest matters to us. While interviews aren't ongoing, we're excited to connect with talented individuals who share our commitment to Blue State's mission.

If you came across this job via LinkedIn, please note that it is an evergreen role; Linked In does not differentiate, but we prefer to.

**What to know**
----------------

Create compelling campaigns, brands and experiences for causes that matter. In this role, you will work closely with account directors, strategists, designers, writers and analysts to ensure that we're delivering innovative, beautiful and flawless work that exceeds the expectations of the organisations we work with. You will bring creative vision and impactful leadership to nonprofits, advocacy campaigns and brands' social impact teams.

We believe great creative is data and strategy driven, not ego-driven. We're looking for you to collaborate closely with our teams to shape test-worthy ideas that will let the numbers do the talking.

We're interested in the originality, honesty and proven success of your concepts and appeals.

**The company**
---------------

Blue State is a purpose-driven agency. We partner with leading causes, brands, and campaigns and create real change. From AARP and Doctors Without Borders to Amnesty International and Oxfam, we transform how brands and causes raise money, influence policy, build platforms, and grow communities of supporters. Led by the most creative and analytical minds from the political, nonprofit, and brand worlds, Blue State is an independent agency in the US and London.

**A day in the life**
---------------------

* **Lead and inspire:** Working closely with your colleagues, you'll develop a vision for our client's creative success. You'll guide the development and implementation of campaigns, appeals and creative platforms, from initial presentations through final delivery.
* **Create with purpose:** Organisations come to us with big questions and for direction on how to be more meaningful, relevant and human - your conceptual thinking and messaging will help make that a reality.
* **Accountability:** Assess and ensure the quality of creative process and product on an ongoing basis. Attend internal critiques, and provide creative solutions to team. Final sign-off on design, copy, and UX work for key projects.
* **Foster a culture of collaboration and creativity:** Stay on top of developments in the field, industry, and culture. Help identify, hire and retain designers, copywriters, and other creatives. Mentor junior members of the project team.

**What we offer**
-----------------

* Unlimited time off (inclusive of sick, personal and vacation days)
* $1,000 annual in professional development funds (local equivalent)
* Fully subsidised health and dental insurance for employees (subject to tax)
* Generous pension match via salary sacrifice
* Generous paid holiday schedule
* Parental leave policy for up to 32.5 week of coverage at full pay, inclusive of all genders and supporting a range of family structures
* Group Income Protection (GIP)
* Group Life Assurance (GLA)
* Optional holiday travel insurance
* Pre-tax season ticket loans
* Cycle to work (up to £2000)
* Remote work flexibility

We approach in-office working with a hybrid model, with presence in our office required at two days per week.

**The team**
------------

You'll be a senior member of the London team bringing in new clients and, as a leader, defining and improving the work we're creating. You will also be a part of our global creative director team who meet regularly for creative inspiration.

**Some things we're looking for**
---------------------------------

* 6+ years in senior creative role, ideally with hands-on designing experience. At least some of this experience working on fundraising and mobilisation campaigns.

* Experience in leading and collaborating with teams of designers, copywriters, strategists and creatives - taking insight that has been shaped and developing compelling, digitally-driven ideas and products.

* Strategy-led: able to clearly articulate design or strategy related dilemmas, and offer multiple solutions with a clear link back to the strategy and insights.

* Comfort and passion for creative testing, co-creation with clients and audiences, and constructively consolidating feedback from global stakeholders to improve the work.

* Impeccable presentation skills: able to explain the reasons behind a particular design or creative strategy, and guide clients through difficult decision points. Experience in pitching a strong advantage.

* Deep knowledge of persuasion strategies & tools: copywriting, social influence, brand advocacy, fundraising, UX and experience design.

* Strong sense of communications and its operating model: how impactful messages are created, journeys constructed and users driven on a journey from awareness to advocacy.

* An area of expertise or passion in the design world (be it fundraising, design, UX, communications or social change) that you can harness and upskill wider team members with as a thought leader within the wider company.

* Industry-leading quality of work: you produce inspiring work that stands out, is flawless in execution, and innovative in thought. You are both a doer and a thinker, and your work reflects that.

* Patient with your colleagues and clients, able to make key decisions when and where required.

* Ability to adapt to new situations, solve problems on the fly, and communicate with those around you. Teamwork and scrappiness required, alongside respect to our clients and their expertise.

* A shared passion and curiosity for making change. This includes comfort with ambiguity, a restlessness that resists the status quo, and a commitment to quality that ensures we're always making progress.

* A firm grasp on the latest AI tools, the creative and ethical considerations they demand, and a healthy disrelish for written and visual slop.

* Empathy, communication, respect, and the ability to act as a role model at Blue State.

At Blue State, diversity is a necessity, not a nice-to-have. We encourage those from underrepresented communities — women, people of color, LGBTQIA+, immigrants, those with disabilities and people at all the intersections in between — to apply. Even if you don't think your current skill set checks every box, but this role seems to align with your strengths, we want to hear from you.

Blue State is committed to creating an inclusive and accessible application and interview process. If you would like to request a reasonable accommodation for a disability, including the use of AI tools throughout the hiring process, please contact us at recruiting@bluestate.co with the **subject line: Accommodation Request** to get started.

Your privacy is important to us. You can find out more information on how we handle your data for recruiting purposes in our Privacy Policy for Recruitment.

For a decade, Engine has built the proprietary technology and supply behind modern business travel, serving over 39,000 customers and nearly 2 million travelers, along with leading travel and AI companies that build on Engine's infrastructure. One system powers business travel, group travel, human agents, and AI agents.
  
  
That work has earned recognition as one of Fast Company's Best Workplaces for Innovators (2025), TravelTech's Reservation Platform of the Year (2026), and one of Built In's Best Places to Work (2020–2026).
  
  
We're looking for bold, ambitious people to help redefine how businesses manage and experience travel. Working here, you can expect exponential growth, an ambitious pace, full ownership, and high-caliber colleagues who push you to do the best work of your career. Every hire raises the bar.
  
  
Come outpace the ordinary and build the future of travel with us.
  
  
**Your Mission**
Create across the entire customer journey. Growth touches every stage from the first impression in a paid ad, printed asset, or event through the website, lifecycle, in-product moments, and beyond.
  
  
You'll own the creative that shows up across all of it and build the automation, tooling, and workflows behind a creative engine capable of producing distinctive, high-performing, on-brand work at scale. You'll make AI a core part of how we create while maintaining a high bar for taste, craft, and originality.
  
  
This is a role for a creative leader who wants to
**build as much as they lead**
shaping the work, the systems, and ultimately the team behind it.
  
  
**What You'll Own**

* **The AI-assisted creative engine.**
  Design the end-to-end creative pipeline: workflows, prompt libraries, components, guardrails, asset databases, and tool stacks that allow us to ship high volumes of quality creative quickly. Drive real innovation in how we apply AI to stand out, and establish the QA systems that keep quality high as output scales.
* **New tools and approaches to creative production.**
  Continuously experiment with emerging creative technology, agencies, and production models. Partner with Growth's technical resources to leverage open-source libraries and build new capabilities that increase the speed, quality, and scale of creative production.

Leading indicators include testing velocity, volume of test-ready assets shipped, creative performance signals such as hook rate and hold rate, and reach generated from in-person moments.
  
  
Lagging indicators include efficient acquisition and pipeline driven by creative and events, with creative quality and brand fit maintained as output scales.

* Extensive experience in creative strategy or creative leadership, with a track record of innovation and measurable business impact.
* A portfolio that spans both experiential or event creative and performance-driven digital work.
* Hands-on fluency with generative AI and creative technology including tools like: Midjourney, Runway, Firefly, ElevenLabs, automation platforms and the ability to turn them into scalable creative systems.
* Strong direct-response instincts: you can diagnose hooks, understand why creative performs, and know what makes work effective platform by platform.
* A systems-builder mindset. You naturally think in workflows, SOPs, pipelines, and ways to increase creative velocity without compromising quality.

* Experience leading and developing creative talent while remaining close enough to the work to contribute directly when needed.
* Visionary and pragmatic, with high agency and an appetite for building in a fast-moving, AI-forward environment.

**Creative Director, Product & Experiences — Flow Studio (Remote)**

We’re looking for a
**Creative Director**
to help define what AI filmmaking can become with Autodesk Flow Studio. This is a rare opportunity to shape both the creative direction of the product itself and the films, experiments, demos, and cultural moments that show the world what it can do.
  
  
This is an AI-first, hands-on creative leadership role embedded within the Flow Studio Product organization. You’ll have significant creative freedom, lead a dedicated content team, work closely with Product leadership, and get hands-on with emerging AI filmmaking tools and workflows. The work can range from ambitious cinematic showcases and AI films to fast-moving social experiments designed to earn attention organically.
  
  
You’ll own the creative bar for everything that lives in or represents the product: the creative look and feel of key product surfaces, cinematic and animation libraries, camera moves, templates and examples, demos, launch storytelling, and other content that helps creators understand what Flow Studio can make possible.
  
  
You’ll also be the primary product-side creative partner to Flow Studio Marketing, helping shape concepts, promos, launch videos, campaigns, social content, and other external storytelling. Marketing leads audience, campaign, channel, and brand strategy; this role brings the product’s creative vision, AI filmmaking expertise, cinematic taste, and product truth into the work.
  
  
The ideal person is already deeply engaged in AI filmmaking, has exceptional visual taste and a strong cinematic eye, understands internet culture and social trends, and wants the freedom and resources to make ambitious work that people actually want to watch.
  
  
**Please submit a portfolio or reel with your application.**
What You’ll Do
  
  

* Own the creative vision and quality bar for Flow Studio across in-product creative experiences, cinematic content, libraries, demos, showcases, and product storytelling.
* Lead and develop the Flow Studio content team, setting creative priorities, directing execution, mentoring contributors, and building a team capable of producing exceptional work quickly.
* Create and direct ambitious AI filmmaking work—from cinematic showcases and product films to reference-quality experiments that push the creative possibilities of Flow Studio.
* Work hands-on with emerging AI image, video, performance, animation, and filmmaking tools; prototype new ideas, test new models and techniques, and turn experimentation into finished creative work.
* Shape the creative layer of the product itself, including cinematic and animation libraries, camera moves, examples, templates, onboarding content, reusable scene elements, and other creator-facing experiences.
* Bring strong filmmaking judgment to camera, composition, lighting, performance, pacing, editing, visual treatment, and storytelling across the work.
* Partner closely with Product, Design, and Engineering from early feature development through launch, translating new capabilities into compelling creative experiences and demonstrations.
* Act as the primary product-side creative partner to Marketing for launches, campaigns, promotional films, social, web, events, and other external storytelling—helping shape concepts, scripts, storyboards, visuals, and execution.
* Identify opportunities around emerging AI, filmmaking, and social trends, and create culturally relevant, internet-native work that is distinctive, timely, highly shareable, and capable of earning meaningful organic reach.
* Build lightweight creative standards, reusable assets, and production practices that help the team maintain a very high bar without slowing down experimentation.

**Qualifications**

* Exceptional portfolio or reel demonstrating outstanding cinematic taste, storytelling, and creative direction.
* Deep, hands-on experience with AI filmmaking and modern generative creative tools, with a strong understanding of the rapidly evolving image, video, performance, animation, and AI production landscape.
* Strong filmmaking instincts across camera, composition, lighting, performance, pacing, editing, and visual storytelling. Cinematography or directing experience is a major plus.
* Proven ability to originate and create ambitious cinematic work—not only manage or review the work of others.
* Strong understanding of viral, social, and internet-native content, with sharp awareness of emerging social media trends, formats, platforms, and online culture. Demonstrated experience creating or directing work that has earned meaningful organic reach, audience engagement, or cultural traction.
* Experience leading creative teams, giving direct and constructive feedback, and maintaining a consistently high creative bar.
* Comfort working closely with Product and Engineering teams and turning emerging technology and complex product capabilities into compelling creative ideas, demonstrations, and experiences.

What Success Looks Like
  
  

* Flow Studio develops a recognizable creative voice and a consistently exceptional quality bar across the product, its content, and the work shown publicly.
* New product capabilities become films, demos, experiments, and creative experiences that make people immediately understand—and want to try—what Flow Studio can do.
* The content team becomes a fast, ambitious creative engine that can produce both high-end cinematic work and culturally relevant, internet-native experiments.
* Product and Marketing have a trusted creative leader who can move quickly, make strong decisions, protect product truth, and turn emerging technology into work people want to watch and share.

title: Creative Strategist, Mexico
description:
**Job Description**
**Join the team redefining how the world experiences design.**
Hey, g'day, mabuhay, kia ora, 你好, hallo, vítejte!
  
  
Thanks for stopping by. We know job hunting can be a little time consuming and you're probably keen to find out what's on offer, so we'll get straight to the point.
  
  
**Where And How You Can Work**
Alongside our global campuses, we also collaborate with talented contractors and freelancers from all over the world to help us achieve our crazy big goals. While we support flexible, remote-friendly ways of working, for this role we’re focusing on Mexico City so we can best support our teams and keep collaboration flowing.
  
  
This role is a 12 month engagement, working full time hours per week.
  
  
**What You’d Be Doing In This Role**
As Creative Strategist for Mexico, you’ll be the creative performance engine behind Canva’s paid marketing in the region.
  
  
This role sits at the intersection of Creative, Growth, and Data - combining cultural insight, analytical depth, and creative instinct to continuously improve our performance marketing output. You won’t be running bids day-to-day - you’ll be driving the creative strategy that makes those campaigns win.
  
  
If you love decoding what makes a hook scroll-stopping, turning insights into structured testing, and raising the creative bar sprint after sprint, this role is for you.
  
  
**At The Moment, This Role Is Focused On**

* Leading the full creative cycle - research, briefing, production, and performance review — running weekly sprint cycles that balance quick-win iterations with bigger creative swings, and feeding learnings back to the broader team after every sprint
* Digging into performance dashboards to spot winning patterns, diagnose underperformance, and translate insights into clear, actionable creative direction that drives the next round of concepts
* Directing and collaborating with video editors, designers, writers, and local creators to produce high-quality work across Meta, TikTok, YouTube, and emerging channels - briefing and reviewing content to keep it on-brand, culturally relevant, and platform-optimised
* Bringing deep cultural fluency to every brief - identifying Mexican audience behaviours, regional trends, and platform dynamics that shape compelling, locally resonant storytelling
* Working closely with media buyers, data science, and the LatAm Growth Marketing Lead to make sure creative insights translate into measurable business outcomes
* Driving CRO initiatives that improve acquisition journeys and lift conversion efficiency across key touchpoints
* Using AI tools to accelerate ideation, research, asset generation, and analysis - and staying across emerging formats and creative tech that give the team an edge

**You’re Probably a Match If**

* You have solid experience in growth or performance marketing with a strong focus on creative strategy - and you've worked hands-on across Meta, TikTok, and YouTube
* You can lead structured creative testing and sprint frameworks, analyse what's working, and turn those learnings into clear briefs for the next cycle
* You have strong creative instinct - you know what makes a hook scroll-stopping, a format compelling, and a concept scalable across channels
* You're fluent in Spanish and English, with a sharp eye for tone, nuance, and cultural resonance for Mexican audiences
* You have experience briefing, directing, and iterating with creative talent — video editors, designers, writers, and creators - coaching them to produce performance-driven work
* You're confident using dashboards and analytics tools to inform decisions and optimise creative at scale
* You use AI tools to accelerate your workflow and improve output quality

**Meet the team**
We're Canva's LatAm Marketing group, and our mission is to make Canva the most loved brand in the region. We build culturally resonant, high-impact marketing across Latin America - combining bold creative storytelling with sharp performance thinking to drive visibility and growth, market by market. Mexico is a key focus for us right now, and this role sits right at the heart of that ambition.
  
  
**How We Hire**
We make decisions to engage contractors based on your experience, skills and passion.
  
  
When you apply, please tell us the pronouns you use and any reasonable adjustments you may need during the interview process.
  
  
We celebrate all types of skills and backgrounds at Canva so even if you don't feel like your skills quite match what's listed above - we still want to hear from you!
  
  
Please note that all interviews are conducted virtually.

**Company:** Crystal Arc Factory L.L.C.  
**Location:** Dubai, United Arab Emirates (On-site)  
**Employment type:** Full-time

**About the role**

Crystal Arc Factory is looking for a Creative Director to lead our creative vision. You will own our brand look and feel and the visual quality of everything customers see. That covers product and packaging design, catalogues, marketing, digital content and exhibitions. You will report to the Managing Director and lead our team of graphic designers.

**What you will do**

* Define and protect our brand identity, tone and visual guidelines across all products, channels and markets
* Turn business and sales goals into clear campaign concepts and creative strategies
* Guide the design of new products, finishes and packaging with our Production, Sales and Product teams
* Approve catalogues, brochures, presentations, photography, video, social media and website content before release
* Make sure creative work can be produced in our factory within agreed cost, material and timeline limits
* Lead, brief and develop designers, including remote and freelance team members
* Prepare the annual creative plan and budget, and manage agencies, photographers, printers and other suppliers
* Protect company IP, including source files, licences, fonts and image rights

**What we are looking for**

* Bachelor's degree in Design, Fine Arts, Visual Communication, Marketing or a related field
