**Tether Data:** Fueling breakthroughs in AI and peer-to-peer technology, we reduce infrastructure costs and enhance global communications with cutting-edge solutions like **KEET**, our flagship app that redefines secure and private data sharing.

**Tether Education**: Democratizing access to top-tier digital learning, we empower individuals to thrive in the digital and gig economies, driving global growth and opportunity.

**Tether Evolution**: At the intersection of technology and human potential, we are pushing the boundaries of what is possible, crafting a future where innovation and human capabilities merge in powerful, unprecedented ways.

***Why Join Us?***

Our team is a global talent powerhouse, working remotely from every corner of the world. If you’re passionate about making a mark in the fintech space, this is your opportunity to collaborate with some of the brightest minds, pushing boundaries and setting new standards. We’ve grown fast, stayed lean, and secured our place as a leader in the industry.

If you have excellent English communication skills and are ready to contribute to the most innovative platform on the planet, Tether is the place for you.

**Are you ready to be part of the future?**

**About the job**

We are seeking a highly driven Head of AI Expansion to lead the global adoption of Tether’s AI ecosystem, with a focus on QVAC and decentralized, privacy-preserving AI infrastructure.

The role will engage leading enterprises, institutions, and governments globally, helping them deploy AI solutions built around local computing, data sovereignty, privacy, and independence from centralized cloud infrastructure.

This is a hands-on leadership role combining exceptional commercial and relationship-building capabilities with deep AI knowledge. You will identify and prioritize opportunities, structure complex projects, close strategic partnerships, monitor success of partnerships and build the team required to scale Tether AI globally.

The ideal candidate can comfortably move between technical discussions with AI and engineering teams and strategic conversations with CEOs, CTOs, CIOs, and government leaders and should be used to work in multiple geographies/ cultures.

International travel is required.

**Responsibilities**

Business Development & Partnerships

* Drive global adoption of QVAC and Tether AI across enterprises, institutions, and governments.
* Identify organizations where local, private, decentralized, or sovereign AI provides a strategic advantage.
* Match use cases with needs of identified organizations and build business cases for the implementation of the use case
* Nurture existing and build new relationships with CEOs, CTOs, CIOs, AI leaders, and government stakeholders.
* Personally originate, structure, negotiate, and close strategic AI partnerships and deployments.
* Develop partnerships across the AI ecosystem, including compute, hardware, infrastructure, and technology providers.
* Monitor performance of partnerships, proactively identify risks and design mitigation plans

Market Strategy & Execution

* Define and execute Tether AI’s global go-to-market strategy.
* Identify priority markets, industries, and high-value AI use cases.
* Co-develop with clients their requirements and translate them into deployable solutions together with product and engineering teams.
* Build and manage a global pipeline of strategic AI opportunities.
* Monitor market, competitive, regulatory, and technological developments.

Team Leadership

* Build and lead the AI Expansion team globally.
* Recruit expansion managers, partnership leads, solution architects, and other key profiles.
* Establish KPIs, execution playbooks, and commercial processes.
* Work closely with Tether’s AI, engineering, product, and regional Expansion teams.

Strategic Representation

* Position Tether as a strategic partner for organizations seeking AI sovereignty, privacy, resilience, and infrastructure independence.
* Represent Tether AI in strategic meetings, government engagements, conferences, and industry forums.

**You Have**

* 7+ years of experience across AI, enterprise technology, infrastructure, or technology business development.
* Strong knowledge of AI/ML, LLMs, inference, local/edge computing, data infrastructure, and decentralized architectures.
* Proven experience personally originating, structuring, and closing large enterprise technology deals and partnerships.
* Strong relationships with senior decision-makers across enterprises, technology companies, and/or governments.
* Exceptional communication, negotiation, and relationship-building skills.
* Experience building and managing high-performing teams.
* Entrepreneurial mindset and ability to operate independently in fast-moving environments.
* Degree in AI, Computer Science, Engineering, Business, or related field.

**Important information for candidates**  
Recruitment scams have become increasingly common. To protect yourself, please keep the following in mind when applying for roles:

* **Apply only through our official channels.** We do not use third-party platforms or agencies for recruitment unless clearly stated. All open roles are listed on our official careers page: https://tether.recruitee.com/
* **Verify the recruiter’s identity.** All our recruiters have verified LinkedIn profiles. If you’re unsure, you can confirm their identity by checking their profile or contacting us through our website.
* **Be cautious of unusual communication methods.** We do not conduct interviews over WhatsApp, Telegram, or SMS. All communication is done through official company emails and platforms.
* **Double-check email addresses.** All communication from us will come from emails ending in **@**tether.to **or @**tether.io
* **We will never request payment or financial details.** If someone asks for personal financial information or payment at any point during the hiring process, it is a scam. Please report it immediately.

**When in doubt, feel free to reach out through our official website.**

title: Head of Platform Engineering, Barcelona
description:
Head of Platform Engineering
  
About Seqera
  
  
Seqera is on a mission to empower scientists and organizations to solve humanity s biggest challenges through data-driven science. As the company behind Nextflow and the Seqera Platform, we enable global enterprises, biotech innovators, academic institutions, and public sector organizations to scale complex data workflows with confidence.
  
  
We re a global, remote-friendly team with headquarters in Barcelona and colleagues across the US, UK, and beyond. As we continue to grow, we re strengthening our internal foundations - and that s where you come in.
  
  
About the role
  
  
We are seeking a leader for our Platform Infrastructure team. This role owns infrastructure at Seqera in both directions: the internal platform our engineers build on, and the infrastructure we ship to customers. A large share of our customers experience Seqera through the infrastructure your team produces, which means much of this work is a product surface held to a products quality bar.
  
  
You will lead a team of DevOps and security engineers, and you will be a key member in our architecture review process, where infrastructure, security, and operability are weighed at design time alongside every other significant technical decision. This is a leadership role for someone who wants to define how a growing engineering organization builds, ships, and operates.
  
  
You will report to the CTO.
  
  
What Youll Do
  
  
Own the reliability, security, and cost-effectiveness of our cloud infrastructure, and the ongoing health of the platform - what gets maintained, upgraded, and retired, not only what gets built.
  
  
Lead the technical launch of our dedicated single-tenant hosting offering: tenancy and isolation model, provisioning, upgrade and patching strategy across many customer instances, operational tooling, and the per-tenant cost model it will be priced against.
  
  
Own our Helm charts and Terraform provider as products - versioned, documented, and tested against supported deployment topologies, with the compatibility obligations that customer-deployed infrastructure carries.
  
  
Own CI/CD, infrastructure-as-code, and the supported path from empty repo to production, so that teams get pipelines, deployment standards, and observability defaults without assembling them each time.
  
  
**Make cloud cost an engineering discipline:** attribution by team and by tenant, anomaly alerting, an efficiency backlog with quantified savings, and cost as an input at design time rather than a surprise after the fact.
  
  
Lead our security posture in practice - security architecture applied during design review, and the security story we present to enterprise and life-sciences customers.
  
  
**Own our formal incident response:** severity definitions, an incident commander rotation, runbooks for our top failure modes, and blameless postmortems that change something.
  
  
Define what production-ready means at Seqera - tests, observability, documentation, runbooks - and hold the bar consistently across teams.
  
  
Grow and develop the Platform Infrastructure team, including active hiring at the senior engineer level and active mentorship and career planning for the whole team.
  
  
Partner with engineering, product, and customer-facing teams to bring infrastructure expertise into decisions early.
  
  
About you
  
  
You have led infrastructure, platform, or SRE teams with direct accountability for production reliability, and you are still close enough to the work to review it, set the standard, and make architectural calls yourself.
  
  
You have deep Kubernetes, Helm, and Terraform experience in enterprise settings, and strong opinions about infrastructure-as-code earned from operating it.
  
  
You have shipped infrastructure that customers deploy and run themselves. You know that charts and modules used by people you will never meet is a different discipline from internal IaC - versioning, backward compatibility, upgrade paths, and support all become your problem.
  
  
You have real security depth. You can lead a security architecture conversation rather than coordinate one.
  
  
You treat cloud cost as an engineering responsibility, and you can build cost models that stand up to commercial scrutiny.
  
  
You have built incident response rather than just carried the pager, and you have handled complex incidents including those involving customer infrastructure.
  
  
You are comfortable as a technical peer with senior engineers who will challenge you, and equally comfortable presenting to leadership and customers.
  
  
You write things down. We are moving deliberately from knowledge held by individuals to standards that are explicit, teachable, and enforceable.
  
  
You are comfortable with ambiguity, and you would rather define a platform than operate one that already exists.
  
  
**Nice to have:**  
Experience with single-tenant, dedicated, or customer-isolated deployment models - fleet provisioning, upgrade orchestration across many instances, isolation guarantees.
  
  
Developer productivity or internal developer platform experience.
  
  
Scientific, research, or high-performance computing environments large-scale batch and data-intensive workloads.
  
  
Experience with multiple cloud providers.
  
  
Release engineering experience.
  
  
Open-source community exposure - much of what we build is used in the open.
  
  
Familiarity with compliance frameworks relevant to enterprise life-sciences customers.
  
  
Great benefits
  
  
**Time off:** 23 days for vacations per year, 3 days given by Seqera in December, and the national/public holidays according to your location.
  
  
Equity
  
  
Private health insurance
  
  
Private life insurance
  
  
Home office allowance (valued over 1,000 USD)
  
  
Subscription to Oliva, Mental Health App
  
  
Learning and development budget per year (1,000 USD)
  
  
Location
  
  
Barcelona (Spain)
  
  
Employment Type
  
  
Full time
  
  
Department
  
  
Engineering
  
  
Nextflow, Kubernetes, Helm, Terraform, CI/CD

title: Market Analyst
description:
**About Modo Energy**
---------------------

The energy transition is the biggest infrastructure buildout in human history. Modo Energy is the data platform at the centre of it.

We build the benchmarking, forecasting, and valuation tools that the world's most serious energy investors, developers, and operators depend on to make decisions. If a battery gets financed, built, or traded anywhere in the world, there's a good chance Modo Energy's data was in the room.

Founded in 2019, we're 90+ people across London, New York, Sydney, and Madrid; $30M Series B, AI-native, and moving fast.

This is a rare chance to join a category-defining company at the moment it's scaling globally.

**The Role**
------------

We're hiring an Iberia Market Analyst to build Modo Energy's products for Spain and Portugal. Iberia is one of Europe's fastest-moving storage markets, and our customers rely on us to understand how batteries earn revenue there.

This is a builder's role. You'll design the data workflows behind our Iberian coverage, build and ship benchmarks, and work with our European forecast team to shape the forecast product for both markets. You'll also help teach Ko, our AI analyst, to become the best source of answers on Iberia.

We're looking for a generalist. You should be as comfortable automating a data pipeline as explaining a market to a customer, and you should enjoy turning messy data into products people use.

Our coverage is battery energy storage, solar, wind and data centres, and we expect it to grow.

You'll be part of the Iberia team, reporting to the Iberia Regional Head and working closely with engineering and the European forecasting team.

**What You'll Be Doing**
------------------------

* Build and automate the data workflows behind our Iberian coverage, from TSOs, NEMOs, and other sources.
* Build, maintain and ship Iberian benchmarks, working with engineering to deploy them to customers on the Modo Energy Terminal.
* Train Ko on Iberia: Improve how useful our AI model is to clients. Expose the right datasets, improve its answers, and deepen its market knowledge.
* Work with the European forecast team on the Spanish and Portuguese forecasts: fundamentals, market design, and how regulatory and market changes feed into the models.
* Maintain a grid-scale asset and capacity register for Spain and Portugal.
* Use AI to build tools and workflows that help you and the team scale.
* Contribute market insight through research and customer calls.

**What We're Looking For**
--------------------------

### **The Essentials**

* You like building things, and you use AI to build tools and workflows.
* 2+ years of experience in power markets, energy analytics, data, or a technical analyst role.
* Strong programming skills. You can interrogate complex datasets and pick up new tools quickly.
* Familiarity with battery energy storage or wider energy transition themes.
* A generalist mindset: comfortable moving between data, product, and market questions.
* Clear written communication.
* Professional fluency in Spanish and English.
* You're comfortable building products for a region from the ground up.

### **Nice To Have**

* Knowledge of Iberian electricity markets: OMIE day-ahead and intraday, REE balancing services (aFRR, mFRR, RR), and the capacity mechanism.
* Experience with data pipelines or workflow orchestration (e.g. Airflow, Dagster, dbt).
* Experience building data products or modelling tools, such as revenue models or dispatch optimisation.
* A working knowledge of Portuguese.

**Please note we can only consider candidates who already have the right to work in Spain, as we can't offer visa sponsorship at this time.**

**Equal Opportunity**
---------------------

Modo Energy is an equal opportunity employer. Employment decisions are made on the basis of qualifications, merit, and business need. We do not discriminate on the basis of race, colour, religion, national origin, sex, age, disability, sexual orientation, gender identity or expression, pregnancy, or any other characteristic protected by law.

If you require assistance or a reasonable accommodation during the application or interview process, please contact us at careers@modoenergy.com.

**What You Can Expect From Us**
-------------------------------

At Modo Energy, we believe that exceptional work deserves exceptional reward. We're a high-performance team; ambitious, collaborative, and genuinely motivated by the scale of what we're trying to build.

You'll have real ownership from day one, work alongside some of the brightest people in the industry, and be part of a company that's defining a new category in the global energy market. We're hybrid: everyone works Tuesday to Thursday in office, with Monday and Friday flexible. We offer top-of-market compensation, equity for every employee, and the space to take your career wherever you want it to go.

We're looking for people who want to do the best work of their careers. If that's you, we want to talk.

title: B2B Creative Manager
description:
**Company Description**

Here at Gameloft, we create moments of happiness for our players all over the world through exciting gaming experiences. This is our mission, and it has been the same for over 25 years. We are the proud creators of Asphalt, Dungeon Hunter, Modern Combat, and over 200 other great games.

* Previous exposure to AI-driven or interactive technologies is highly desirable.
* Experience working with prominent international brands is a significant advantage.
* Professional proficiency in English, with the ability to present complex ideas with clarity and impact.

**WHO YOU ARE**

* A structured thinker with the ability to frame complex business cases and identify scalable digital opportunities.
* A data-driven decision-maker who balances creative ambition with operational realism and factual evidence.

* Open-minded and flexible in your thinking, while remaining constructive and acting with integrity at all times.

**WHAT'S IN IT FOR YOU**

* Private medical health insurance.
* Flexible compensation with Ticket Restaurant Card.
* Free language courses.
* Work-from-home hybrid model.
* Merit based salary progression system and a competitive initial salary package.

**Life at** **Gameloft**

Our Barcelona studio offers real career development opportunities and a positive working environment in a centrally located office. We value supportive working conditions and a balanced work-life approach, and our teams work together with a collaborative mindset.

title: Project Manager (Video Ads)
description:
A freelance project manager to run video ad campaigns for B2B tech clients, from the first brief to the final file.

**About us**
------------

We're Camping, a brand storytelling and video agency in Barcelona. We help B2B tech companies go from 'boring' to heartfelt, through brand work and video.

Have we mentioned we have a 4-day workweek?

**The role**
------------

We have more video ad campaigns coming in than our project team can run, and some of them could start in the next few weeks. So we're looking for one more project manager, as a freelancer.

A campaign for us is usually 6 to 12 ads, and then the cutdowns, resizes and language versions for every platform. More and more often the videos are made fully or partly with AI. You take the campaign from the kickoff call to the last file. You're the client's main contact, you send them scripts and cuts, collect their feedback and turn it into clear next steps for the team.

You'll work with our creative director, strategists, AI creatives, producers and freelance editors and motion designers. You won't be the director or the strategist. You'll be the person who knows where every ad stands and tells us early when something slips. Most of the work is in post-production, the rest is pre-production and shoots.

**What you'll do**
------------------

* Run several video ad campaigns at the same time, from kickoff to final delivery
* Be the client's day-to-day contact: send scripts, cuts and updates, and run the feedback rounds
* Plan pre-production and shoots with our producers, directors and production partners
* Book and brief freelance editors, motion designers, color and sound, and track every revision round
* Keep Asana, Notion and Frame.io up to date, so anyone on the team can see where a project stands
* Check every ad before it goes to the client: formats, aspect ratios, subtitles, specs for each platform
* Flag changes to timeline, budget or scope to our Head of Production before you promise anything to the client

**What we're looking for**
--------------------------

* 3+ years as a project manager, producer or post-production coordinator on ads and campaigns, in an agency or a production company
* You know how post-production works: edit, motion, color, sound and final deliveries
* You've handled campaigns with many versions of the same ad, and you don't lose track of which cut is the latest
* You've been the main contact for clients, and you can say no when a request doesn't fit the plan
* Fluent English and Spanish. Our clients work in English, and a lot of our team and suppliers work in Spanish
* You live in Barcelona. Shoots and part of the team are here

**Nice to have**
----------------

* B2B tech or SaaS clients
* You've worked on AI-generated video and you know tools like Runway or Higgsfield
* Paid social: you know what Meta, LinkedIn and YouTube need from an ad file

**How we'll work together**
---------------------------

This is a freelance role at 2,500 EUR per month (plus VAT), invoiced as a freelancer or a company. We work with you full-time on our 4-day week, Monday to Thursday, with flexible hours and at least two days a week at our office in Poblenou.

We'd like to start as soon as possible.

**Diversity & Inclusion**
-------------------------

At Camping, diverse teams drive better ideas and better work. We welcome collaborators from all backgrounds and are committed to providing an inclusive, respectful environment for everyone we work with.

title: Affiliate Manager
description:
**About PFM**  
Prop Firm Match Global FZCO is a leading platform for discovering, comparing, and selecting top proprietary trading firms. We provide traders with tools and features to easily compare challenge details, read verified reviews, see accurate payout data, and much more. We're a fast-moving, fully remote team with members from all around the world caring deeply about the quality of what we build. Our culture values ownership, clear communication, and practical impact over fluff.

**About the department**  
Marketing owns how PFM finds, engages, and converts traders across every channel we use to grow. Affiliate and influencer partnerships are one of our biggest acquisition channels - over $60K a month in spend - and as that function matures under our Owned Media team, our priority is turning it into a well-negotiated, well-tracked channel instead of one that runs on relationships alone.

**About the role**  
The Affiliate Manager builds an affiliate channel that creates measurable, profitable growth for PFM: turning the right partner relationships into qualified traffic, conversions, and durable revenue, while protecting deal quality and spend efficiency. This role establishes the commercial discipline and tracking PFM needs to scale partnerships into priority markets with confidence. It backfills our outgoing Affiliate Manager as they step into leading Owned Media, and works alongside our Influencer Partnerships Specialist, providing light day-to-day direction on their pipeline and priorities. Without a dedicated owner here, deals on one of our largest acquisition channels get missed or under-negotiated.

 **Requirements**

**Performance objectives**

**Objective 1 - Build and activate a productive affiliate portfolio**  
**Outcome:** Within the first 6–12 months, the active portfolio is stronger in priority markets and produces a growing share of qualified traffic and attributable conversions - not simply more signed partners.

**Typical tasks:**

* Map priority regions, partner segments, and target accounts with the Head of Owned Media.
* Source and qualify affiliates on audience fit, traffic quality, commercial potential, and brand suitability.
* Move qualified prospects through outreach, negotiation, onboarding, activation, and first performance review.
* Re-engage, expand, or exit existing partners based on contribution and strategic fit.

**Objective 2 - Improve deal quality and partner economics**  
**Outcome:** New and renewed agreements have clear economics and accountable deliverables; spend and effort shift toward partnerships with stronger return.

**Typical tasks:**

* Negotiate commission structures, fees, placements, deliverables, tracking requirements, and review points.
* Model expected cost and return before committing spend or recommending exceptions.
* Document agreed terms and coordinate approvals, contracts, and handoffs.
* Review underperforming deals and recommend renewal, renegotiation, or exit.

**Objective 3 - Make affiliate-driven results measurable and actionable**  
**Outcome:** Leadership can see attributable revenue, cost, and conversion quality by partner; material data gaps are resolved and commercial decisions follow the evidence.

**Typical tasks:**

* Set tracking and attribution requirements before launch and verify links, codes, and reporting access.
* Reconcile partner-reported activity with internal traffic, sales, and commission data alongside Analytics & Data and Finance.
* Investigate material discrepancies, low-quality traffic, and conversion changes through to resolution.
* Turn performance reviews into specific actions on partner mix, terms, creative, placement, or budget.

**Objective 4 - Build a repeatable partnership operating system and content governance**  
**Outcome:** Priority markets have a visible, qualified pipeline; launches and reviews happen on time; agreed placements go live as contracted, and partner content about PFM is accurate and up to date; the channel can scale without losing commercial control or partner experience.

**Typical tasks:**

* Maintain a current deal pipeline with owner, stage, expected value, next step, and decision date.
* Establish onboarding, briefing, compliance, and performance-review standards for partners.
* Coordinate with the Influencer Partnerships Specialist on shared deal governance and measurement without duplicating ownership of influencer negotiations.
* Monitor what partners publish about PFM for accuracy, brand suitability, and compliance, and act on issues through to resolution.
* Verify that agreed placements and deliverables go live on time and as specified, and keep partner-facing offers, promo codes, creatives, and campaign details current.

**What we look for**  
**Must-Have Requirements**

* Minimum 3 years of experience in a similar affiliate, influencer, or partnerships role, with hands-on ownership of deal sourcing and negotiation end to end.
* Fluent professional English, with strong written and verbal communication skills.
* Strong AI proficiency — comfortable using AI as part of daily work, including experience building or using small automations to improve outreach, tracking, or reporting.
* Working knowledge of Docusign and Calendly, or comparable contract and scheduling tools.
* Strong working knowledge of Google Workspace, Zoom, and Slack for documentation, scheduling, forms, communication, and remote collaboration.
* Basic working knowledge of partnership/affiliate contract terms, with the ability to identify when Legal or Finance input is required.
* Strong organization and follow-through — able to manage a multi-deal pipeline where a missed follow-up can cost a partnership or measurable revenue.
* Clear, direct communication — able to prepare and communicate deal terms, performance updates, and negotiation outcomes accurately to internal and external stakeholders.
* Strong discretion and judgment, given regular access to spend data, deal terms, and partner performance information.
* A relationship-first negotiation style — able to build trust with partners while still protecting PFM's commercial interests.
* Strong cross-functional coordination skills — comfortable working closely with Analytics & Data, Marketing, Strategic Initiatives, and leadership to bring deals and tracking work to completion.

**Nice to Have**

* Previous experience in a fully remote, global, and multicultural team.
* Experience in a fast-scaling organization where affiliate/partnership processes are still being built and improved.
* Deeper experience with AI integrations, workflow automation, and attribution/tracking tooling beyond basic usage.

**Compensation**  
$3,500 - $4,000 / monthly gross

**Location & work setup**  
Remote, CET-aligned working hours.  
Employment type: Full-time.

 **Benefits**

**Hiring stages**  
We keep our process simple, transparent, and respectful of your time. Here's what to expect:

* Application screening – We carefully review all applications to identify candidates whose background aligns with the role's requirements. You'll receive a timely and transparent update on your application status.
* Video intro + role fit questionnaire – A short async step - no scheduling required. You'll record a brief video introduction and complete a written questionnaire, helping us understand your background and fit without either side committing to a live call upfront.
* Discovery HR interview – A conversation with our People team focused on company and culture match - how PFM works, what remote ownership looks like day to day, and what success in this role looks like.
* Practical task – A short, scoped exercise based on a real PFM affiliate/partnership challenge, not an abstract problem, designed to give both sides a realistic view of the work before committing further.
* Professional interview – A conversation with the Head of Owned Media focused on your negotiation experience, how you've owned an affiliate or partnership channel end to end, and how you handle sensitive or ambiguous deal situations.
* Functional interview – A broader professional conversation exploring how you work with commercial teams and partners, how you structure and present data to support business decisions, and how you identify and resolve operational bottlenecks.
* Peer & values conversation – A conversation with a peer from across the team focused on values, culture, and how you work best. You'll have plenty of space to ask questions and get a real feel for life at PFM.

If there's a strong mutual match, we start with an informal conversation to align on expectations, then follow up with a formal written offer. Full transparency throughout, and time for you to make an informed decision.  
To keep things fully transparent and mutually fair, we complete a reference check before the formal offer is extended. No surprises - just part of how we make careful, informed decisions on both sides.

**Before applying take into account that:**  

* If you don’t meet every single qualification but believe you can excel in the role based on what it requires - we encourage you to apply.
* We are an equal opportunity employer and welcome applicants from all backgrounds, experiences, and perspectives.
* Even if it’s not listed as a formal requirement, we truly value candidates who have clear familiarity with the prop trading industry and us, our mission and what we do.

  
**Not the right fit for this role?**  
If this role isn’t the right match but you have experience in trading operations, customer success, compliance, support, partnerships, or a related area - we still want to hear from you. Join our Talent Pool and we’ll reach out when a relevant role opens. Every submission is reviewed, and the pool is always the first place we look before opening a new search.

**At Alexion, AstraZeneca Rare Disease**, we are innovators, leaders, and collaborators. At the heart of everything we do is an intense desire to pursue the toughest challenges and truly change the world for people living with rare and devastating diseases.

**Alexion’s Global Marketing and Market Access team (GMMA)** is an integrated strategy and operations team, with the core objective to develop disease and brand commercial and access strategies, as well as global marketing materials and negotiation strategies, while working closely with markets for implementation. The team diligently monitors the performance of the business and the effectiveness of our strategies, helping to position our brands for sustained long-term access and success. Additionally, the GMMA team delivers commercial strategies for our pipeline programs and establishes commercial marketing and access strategies for new product launches. Our unique culture thrives on collaboration, authenticity, creativity, and pushing boundaries in all that we do to advance patient care.

The Global Brand Strategy Lead, Rare Bone and Endocrine Disorders is a foundational role for the success of the **Hypophosphatasia (HPP)** company strategy with focus on our **Top 21 countries**. You are accountable for leading the development and profitable management of our **Hypophosphatasia** portfolio with full accountability for commercialization. You have a leadership role within a matrix working model between global and local markets and across functions. Working in complex and competitive markets, you are accountable for creating a collaborative and high-performance environment that supports the innovation required to identify and realize substantial value opportunities.

**Key Responsibilities:**

**Brand Strategy In-Line Products**:

* You are responsible for the VST (Lead of Value Sub team) in which you will refine, and safeguard strategic value propositions based on market events and clinical outcomes. In collaboration with Medical and Market Access teams to develop proposals and business cases for further data generation and RWE

* You lead the DSP (Disease Strategy Plan) development and roll-out. Provide input into strategic planning process (patient funnel, patient journey, patient segmentation, et al). Prioritize the critical success factors and associated tactics coming out of the DSP and lead project workstreams for pull-through. Additionally, you will lead planning meetings with key stakeholders to align on DSP development and enterprise approval.

* You are accountable for ensuring CI and Market Research plans are aligned to commercial strategy for your portfolio and ensure the enterprise is prepared for competitive assets in the marketplace

* You are part of the GPT Core Team member (Global Program Team), keeping the GPT apprised of key programs and workstreams. As well as collaborate and align with key functions and government bodies i.e. Regional Area Heads (US, INTL, JP), GPT, GST, Clinical, Development, Regulatory, SciComms, Training etc.

* You provide regular updates on strategy and global performance to senior leadership, e.g. GCOLT (Global Commercial Leadership Team)

**Launch Strategy**

* You are accountable for driving the Global Pre-Launch strategy and planning 12-18 months prior to launch and providing commercial input into development programs.

* Partnering with (R&D, Operations, Corporate Affairs, Finance, et al) and regional/local teams to develop relevant launch strategy. Additionally, working with regional colleagues to plan the market shaping activities 12-18 months prior to launch

**Business & Commercial Performance**:

* You are responsible for development and evolving the commercial strategy (positioning, messaging, claims, patient/HCP segmentation …etc.). in partnership with Regional Commercial leads to ensure local execution of strategy.

* You are responsible for the development, communication and evolution of long-range global forecasts for your portfolio (LTP)

**Pipeline**:

* As the pipeline evolves, this role will also be instrumental in partnering with R&D, BD and other enterprise functions to support Business Cases for pipeline assets to be assessed by the Leadership team

**You will need to have:**

* Bachelor’s degree in business or life sciences; a Masters degree would be supportive

* Minimum 10+ years in pharmaceutical or biotech industry in roles encompassing strategic pre-launch planning and launch, with global/regional/local experience and thorough understanding of the diverse requirements of Global markets

* Country and/ or above-country leadership experience in the pharmaceutical or biotechnology industry with accountability and a proven track record for delivering on business goals in a major healthcare market; PnL responsibility would be supportive

* Broad marketing and commercial experience with demonstrated success across various stages of the brand lifecycle, including pre-launch planning, launch execution, and long-term business planning

* Profound understanding of drug development and commercialization in rare disease

* Solid grasp of ongoing paradigm changes and future trends in healthcare commercialization

* Demonstrated ability to collaborate across matrix teams and achieve goals by delivering through others

* Proven experience and knowledge of a broad base of external partners and customers including patients, prescribers, payors, providers and in/out license partners.

* P&L management experience and ability to build a financial Business Case

* Experienced with key global regulations in the field of pharmaceutical compliance and commercialization, including pharmacovigilance

* Excellent communications skills across a diverse set of stakeholders (commercial, clinical, medical, etc.)

**We would prefer you to have:**

* An advanced degree (MBA, MSc or PhD) is preferred

* Pharmaceutical or Biotech experience at the Global, Regional and Local level.

* You bring an entrepreneurial spirit and strategic mindset including innovation and critical thinking with performance-oriented drive.

* You can integrate a variety of perspectives into meaningful strategies and programs.

* You embrace curiosity, collaboration and smart risk taking as a prerequisite for joint success.

* You enthusiastically embrace the diversity of individual healthcare ecosystems as significant opportunity.

* You can relate and connect deeply with various healthcare and business markets to deliver direction and support.

* You can create and mobilize an inclusive work environment of highest integrity and quality, fostering learning, growth, teamwork, individual development and attraction of top talent.

* You possess excellent communication skills and a strong personal presence internally and externally, acting as a strong catalyst and influencer.

**Position:** Executive Director, Global Site Strategic Network

The **Executive Director, Global Site Strategic Network** is accountable for defining and leading the global strategy for strategic site engagement and partnerships within Global Clinical Operations. The role establishes the strategic architecture, operating principles, governance, portfolio priorities, and performance framework that connect Therapeutic Business Unit (TBU) strategy and Global Clinical Operations priorities with regional and country activation and local site engagement.

The Executive Director shapes how the business identifies, prioritizes, develops, and activates relationships with investigators, health systems, strategic sites, and research networks to improve access to patients, accelerate clinical development, strengthen study delivery, and create differentiated value for customers and TBUs. * Define and own the global Site Strategy & Collaborations vision, multi-year strategic roadmap, and priorities aligned with Global Clinical Operations objectives and TBU portfolio strategy.
* Translate TBU therapeutic and portfolio priorities into a differentiated global site-network strategy, defining where, with whom, and how Thermo Fisher should build strategic site relationships to support current and future clinical development needs.

* Use data, analytics, external market intelligence, and network insights to identify strategic opportunities, anticipate risks, inform network design, and recommend changes to partnership strategy and operating model.
* Champion innovative partnership models, digital capabilities, data-sharing approaches, and collaboration mechanisms that strengthen site engagement and differentiate Thermo Fisher in the clinical research ecosystem.
* Lead organizational transformation and change initiatives that position Site Strategy & Collaborations as a strategic enterprise capability rather than a transactional or support function.

Applies expert knowledge of global clinical operations, strategic site engagement, feasibility, portfolio strategy, investigator and institutional partnerships, clinical trial delivery, and external ecosystem dynamics to shape global strategy and investment priorities. Recognized as an enterprise thought leader who integrates TBU strategy, customer needs, market intelligence, and site-network capabilities to influence organizational design, partnership models, and future business direction.

Leads a global capability at the intersection of TBUs, Global Clinical Operations, regions, countries, and the external site ecosystem. -----------------------------

title: Product Owner, Xsolla Partner Network
description:
**About You**
-------------

We are looking for a **Product Owner** to join the team behind Xsolla Partner Network (XPN). The role is based in the US, and we're open to strong candidates globally. Partner Network connects game publishers with content creators to drive discovery, engagement, and revenue.  
  
XPN is a two-sided marketplace. We help publishers run creator marketing campaigns (xsolla.com/partner-network), and we give creators a way to join those campaigns, along with tools to manage and grow their channels (xsolla.com/for/creators). Each side has its own users and goals, and each shapes the other. Helping both sides succeed together is what makes this role so interesting.  
  
You'll work closely with customers on both sides and with a collaborative team that's building something new in the creator economy. You'll bring what you learn back to the Product Director and the team, help shape where the product goes, and then work alongside design and engineering to bring it to life.  
  
This is a hands-on role that mixes customer conversations, product definition, and day-to-day delivery. If you enjoy turning what you learn from customers into shipped features, and you like doing it with a team that moves fast and supports each other, we'd love to meet you.

### **About Us**

Xsolla is a global commerce company with robust tools and services to help developers solve the inherent challenges of the video game industry. From indie to AAA, companies partner with Xsolla to help them fund, distribute, market, and monetize their games. Grounded in the belief in the future of video games, Xsolla is resolute in the mission to bring opportunities together, and continually make new resources available to creators. Headquartered and incorporated in Los Angeles, California, Xsolla operates as the merchant of record and has helped over 1,500+ game developers to reach more players and grow their businesses around the world. With more paths to profits and ways to win, developers have all the things needed to enjoy the game.

For more information, visit xsolla.com.

### **Responsibilities:**

* **Research and discovery.** Get to know both sides of the XPN marketplace: the game publishers running creator campaigns and the creators bringing those campaigns to life. Talk with customers, gather insights, and keep up with trends in the creator economy and gaming. What you learn shapes where the product goes next.
* **Coordinate the roadmap.** Work with the Product Director to turn insights into priorities. Bring ideas and recommendations, balance publisher and creator needs, and help build a roadmap the whole team is excited about.
* **Write product requirements.** Turn ideas into clear, well-scoped PRDs that give design and engineering what they need to build with confidence.
* **Manage delivery.** Organize the work in Jira and keep design, engineering, and QA aligned and moving from kickoff through release.
* **Track what matters.** Define and follow the metrics that show how XPN is working for publishers and creators, and use them to guide what we build next.
* **Keep everyone connected.** Be the hub for product communication. Share project status, research, and customer insights with the product team. Keep Business Development, Customer Success, and Marketing up to date on what's shipping and what it means for our partners.

* **Product experience.** 3+ years in product management or product ownership, shipping software alongside a dedicated engineering team.

* **Engineering partnership.** You work closely with engineers day to day, making scope and sequencing decisions together, and you're comfortable managing the backlog and tracking work in Jira.

* **Marketplace or platform experience.** You've worked on two-sided marketplaces or platform products.

* **Campaign attribution.** Experience with tracking links, conversion attribution, or measuring marketing performance.

title: SRE Manager (VPN)
description:
**Join Proton and build a better internet where privacy is the default**

Proton was founded in 2014 by scientists from CERN on a simple truth: **privacy is a fundamental human right**. Since then, we’ve built the world’s largest encrypted email service (Proton Mail) and expanded into Proton VPN, Proton Drive, Proton Pass, and Proton Calendar—tools used by millions globally to protect their freedom, fight censorship, and keep their data safe. In some situations, Proton has literally helped save lives!

We are profitable, independent (no VC control), and selectively hire from the top ~1% of applicants. Our 700+ team members across 50+ countries come from leading organizations and elite academic backgrounds. We move fast, keep hierarchy light, and prioritize impact over optics. If you want to do meaningful work with exceptionally high-caliber people, this is it. Join us and do work you can truly be proud of.

**The Team:**

Proton VPN gives millions of people a private connection to the internet, including people in countries where the internet is censored. It runs on thousands of bare-metal servers. We choose the hardware, the datacenters, and the networks ourselves, and we operate all of them.

The VPN Site Reliability Engineering team builds and runs this fleet. It has eight engineers: six site reliability engineers and two engineers who look after day-to-day fleet health. The fleet runs Debian, is automated with Ansible and Python, and is monitored with Prometheus, VictoriaMetrics, and Grafana. The team has kept the service stable through several years of fast growth.

**The role:**

We are hiring an engineering manager to lead this team. You will report to the VPN Engineering Director and work from our Geneva or Barcelona office.

The fleet keeps growing as more people use Proton VPN. To stay ahead of that growth, the team is investing in two areas, and you will lead both.

1. Automation. Engineers still do much of the provisioning, deployment, and repair work by hand. We want software to do that work, so that a fix or a new location reaches the fleet quickly and safely.

2. Observability. We know when a server is down. We do not yet know when users in one country are getting poor throughput. We want to find a problem that affects one server or one country while it is still small.

We chose a simple stack on purpose, and we plan to keep it and extend it.

This is a management role, so you will not write production code. You do need to be technical enough to read the team's code, question its designs, and examine its postmortems in detail.

**What you will do:**

* Manage and develop a team of eight engineers.
* Decide what the team automates and measures first, and deliver that plan.
* Own the reliability of the Proton VPN fleet, including SLOs, error budgets, incident response, and postmortems.
* Build monitoring that shows what users experience in each country, starting with throughput.
* Replace manual provisioning, deployment, and repair work with tooling that ships changes to the fleet quickly and safely.
* Set the engineering standards for the team, and coach engineers to solve operational problems with software.
* Plan capacity and new locations with VPN product engineering, Proton's infrastructure teams, and our network and datacenter providers.

**What we are looking for:**

* Several years of experience managing site reliability, infrastructure, or platform teams.
* Experience leading a team from manual operations to automated ones, with results you can describe.
* Strong technical judgment on large Linux fleets. You can review a design, read Python and Ansible, and find the gaps in a postmortem.
* Experience owning the reliability of a production service, including SLOs, error budgets, incident response, and postmortems.
* Experience building or rebuilding the monitoring of a production service, and getting engineers to rely on it.
* Experience running physical infrastructure, or a clear willingness to learn it.
* Experience developing engineers, giving direct feedback, and addressing underperformance.
* Experience delivering projects that depend on teams outside your own.
* The habit of setting your own priorities. We will give you goals, and you will decide with the team how to reach them.
* Clear writing in strategy documents, incident reports, and engineering standards.
* A commitment to privacy. Proton VPN keeps no logs of user activity, and you will have to improve observability within that limit.

**Bonus points for:**

* Deep networking knowledge: routing, peering, tunnelling protocols such as WireGuard and OpenVPN, and packet-level debugging.
* Experience with censorship circumvention, or with running infrastructure in restricted network environments.
* Experience operating a fleet across many countries, including the vendor and legal work involved.
* A background as a software engineer, in Python or another language.

**What We Offer**

* **Work that Matters:** millions of people trust Proton with their privacy. We answer only to our users — not advertisers, not investors with conflicting agendas, not governments. The work you do here is real, and the impact is measurable.
* **Stock Options:** at Proton, we all have the opportunity to be owners of the company. From day one, you have a real stake in what we're building. When Proton wins, you win.
* **Technology:** you'll get the right hardware and the right software you need to do your best work.
* **Learning & Development:** we invest in your growth because sharp people make us better. Proton is one of the fastest ways to accelerate your career because you'll be thrown into real challenges, with real ownership, from day one.
* **Employee Benefits:** your wellbeing isn't an afterthought. We offer strong health coverage, solid retirement options, generous leave, and wellness support so you can bring your best self to work every day
* **In-Person Collaboration:** Amazing things happen when passionate, smart, and purposeful people get together in the same room. With offices across Geneva, Zürich, Barcelona, London and more, you'll spend most of your time collaborating face-to-face with people who genuinely care about what they're building
* **Food:** Lunch and snacks are on us every day in our offices so you can focus on the work and not on what's for lunch.
* **Transport:** getting to the office shouldn't cost you. We cover public transport, bike allowances, or parking, whichever works for you.
* **Flexible Working:** you own your schedule. Set hours that work for you and your team — because outcomes matter more than when the clock says you started.

**Our Commitment to Diversity and Inclusion**

At Proton, we believe diversity drives innovation and strengthens our mission to provide privacy as a default for all. We are committed to fostering an inclusive environment where all individuals, regardless of race, ethnicity, gender, age, sexual orientation, physical ability, or socio-economic background, feel valued and empowered. We strive to create equal opportunities, promote open dialogue, and support continuous learning to ensure every voice is heard and respected.

If you need any extra support or reasonable adjustments during the hiring process, please let your talent partner know.

**Candidate Privacy Notice**

When you apply for a position, refer a candidate, or are considered for a role at Proton Technologies AG (Proton, we, us, or our), your information is stored in Greenhouse, in accordance with their Service Privacy Policy. This information is used to evaluate your suitability for the posted position. We also retain this information for consideration for future roles that you may apply for or that we believe may align with your background and skills.

If we no longer have a legitimate business need to process your information, we will either delete or anonymize it. Should you have any inquiries about how we use or manage your information, or if you wish to access, correct, or delete your data, please contact our privacy team at careers@proton.ch.

*Proton does not accept unsolicited resumes from any sources other than directly from candidates. We will not pay a fee for any placement resulting from an unsolicited offer, even if the candidate is subsequently hired by Proton.*

*To learn more about our privacy policy, please visit* *our privacy policy page**.*

**Compensation range**
  
**Barcelona** 62,000-95,000 euros gross annually\*
  
Other locations: Compensation will be discussed during the interview process  

* *Final compensation will be determined based on the candidate's qualifications, skills, and previous experience*

AI supercharges this process, running through everything we do, from everyday tasks to our guiding principles.  
  
What powers the loop is talent density. 220+ people from 30+ nationalities, bringing expertise from the world’s best studios and companies. We uphold ambition, curiosity, humility, and focus, and deliver with speed, excellence, and candor. Since the start, we’ve raised $165M from Headline, Northzone, Eurazeo, Bpifrance, and the founders of King, Sorare, and Spotify, people who’ve built and backed the games and platforms we admire, now supporting our drive to create the next ones.  
  
At Homa, we are building the next billion-player experiences from the ground up and shaping the future of entertainment.

**Mission**

As a **Lead Product Manager** on our RPG games, you'll play a key role in defining and owning the product roadmap for our live RPG games portfolio end-to-end, starting by turning one of our current strongest live titles into a franchise players stay with for years. You'll start with one game, and as our RPG portfolio expands, so does your scope, more titles, and a real hand in the product strategy behind them. You're shaping how Homa runs RPG as a whole.

Your main responsibilities will include:

* **Define the product roadmap across one or more live RPG titles:** core loop, progression pacing, monetization, and meta systems such as gacha, PvP, seasons, and guild or pass structures, with the health of the in-game economy.
* **Own LiveOps end-to-end.** You'll define the calendar, the events, and the loop that brings players back by a real understanding of what the team can design, produce, and sustain sprint over sprint: ambitious, but grounded.
* **Lead your team.** You'll have a talented but small team of product, design, and economy experts to lead towards the same goal. Your job is to give them a clear plan, raise their level, and get the best out of them.
* **Oversee the monetization model.** Working closely with economy, you're accountable for leading how the game balances the IAP and ad revenue growth together rather than at each other's expense.
* **Drive growth, in partnership with UA.** You're responsible for how the game scales on the acquisition side: working hand-in-hand with the UA team so that the player data, creative learnings, and campaign performance shapes the product roadmap.
* **Cross-functional excellence.** You'll work hand-in-hand with Publishing and the studios, through logic and shared KPIs, which means understanding how a game gets built and shipped end-to-end, from concept to launch.
* **Set the bar.** Bring genre benchmarks and proven best practices into every major call, so the team always has a clear, shared sense of what great looks like in this genre.
* **Stay hands-on when it counts.** This is a leadership role, but you'll stay close enough to the data and the systems to go deep personally on whatever matters most that month, rather than directing only from a distance.

This is a great opportunity to take a genuinely exceptional game and decide what it becomes: full ownership of the product, the economy, and the LiveOps of a title Homa is betting on, real autonomy over how you get there, and a clear path to leading product across our whole RPG portfolio as it grows.

 **Requirements**

We are looking for someone with **several years of product experience on live mobile games, especially RPG,** with genuine end-to-end ownership of an economy, progression system or monetization roadmap, and the humility, curiosity, ambition, and drive to make an impact fast. You're a great fit if you have:

**Product & RPG expertise**

* P**roduct experience on live F2P mobile games**, ideally RPG/midcore, with end-to-end ownership of major features, progression, monetization or product roadmaps.
* Strong fluency in **RPG mechanics and meta systems:** progression, power curves, collection, PvP/social, seasons and passes, and strong mobile marketability instincts.
* Ideally, you’ve taken a title **from concept/pre-launch through launch and LiveOps**, or shaped product direction across multiple titles.

**LiveOps & Execution**

* Deep **LiveOps experience**, understanding how events, content, progression and monetization work together to drive engagement and repeat spend.
* Strong track record **owning features end-to-end**: identify, build, ship, measure and iterate, with a practical understanding of **what a live team can realistically ship and maintain**, balancing ambition with feasibility.

**Leadership & Ways of working**

* Strong **cross-functional leadership**, able to align Design, Publishing, Data, Economy, UA, Growth and external studios around the product direction.
* A **strategist and builder**: able to set direction and lead others, while remaining highly hands-on with the game, systems and data.
* Thrives in **lean, fast-moving, high-autonomy teams** with quick tests, short feedback loops and high ownership

**Our Culture**

At Homa, we prioritize talent, energy, and determination over traditional credentials. We’re building a global community of brilliant, driven people who think boldly, move fast, and push boundaries. We believe true innovation comes from diverse perspectives, deep collaboration, and curiosity without limits. Our culture is grounded in four core values:

* **Ambition**: We strive for the best - we don’t settle for “good enough.”
* **Humility**: We recognize that we are always learning, we can always improve and grow.
* **Curiosity**: We continuously seek the “why” behind the “what”.
* **Focus**: Our curiosity takes us deeper, not wider - we dive deep into the details.

  
**Benefits**

Building great games starts with building a great place to work. Here’s what you can expect:

* **Comprehensive Benefits:** Depending on your location, you’ll enjoy a range of perks such as insurance, meal vouchers, public transport, gym memberships, and more.
* **Paris HQ Access:** Enjoy a desk at our private office in a well-located WeWork building that will give you access to WeWork perks like rooftop view and designed coworking spaces.
* **Coworking Access:** You will have access to WeWork spaces throughout Europe, along with all their perks and professional office environments.
* **Global Team:** Collaborate in English with top-tier talent from 35+ countries, spanning Europe, the UK, the US, and more. Diversity fuels our creativity and innovation.
* ✈️ **Team Gatherings:** We value time together beyond the screen. Join us for occasional team gatherings, off-site retreats (Workations as we name them) to connect, recharge, and celebrate.
* **Performance Reviews:** We’re committed to your growth. Every six months, we reflect on your progress, recognize your achievements, and align on clear development goals.
* **Equipment Support:** From day one, we’ll provide everything you need to do your best work, including a home office setup allowance if you're working remotely.

Where We Hire

Our HQ in Paris is a vibrant hub of creativity, collaboration, and connection. From rooftop lunches and coffee chats to after-work apéros and community events, we’ve designed a space people genuinely enjoy - all within a cozy WeWork filled with good energy (and snacks).

We also have incredible team members across Europe - from Spain and Turkey to Germany, North Macedonia, Poland, the UK, and more. Whether you’re working from a sunny WeWork in Barcelona or your home setup in Warsaw, you’re fully part of our culture. To keep collaboration smooth, we primarily hire within European time zones (UTC to UTC+3). If you're based there - or planning to be - we’d love to hear from you!

title: Senior Manager, DSP Partnerships, EMEA
description:
We’re looking for a Senior Manager, DSP Partnerships, EMEA to join our team in Madrid or in London and play a key role in shaping the future of neuro-contextual advertising at a global scale.

#### **Who We Are**

Seedtag is the leading Neuro-Contextual Advertising Company.  
We are redefining how advertising works in a privacy-first world by moving beyond keywords and cookies, towards understanding human emotion, intent, and context.

Powered by advanced AI and neuroscience, our proprietary technology, Liz, delivers a deep, human-like understanding of content and attention. This enables brands to connect with audiences at the right moment, in the right mindset, with ads that are relevant, engaging, and respectful of the user experience.

Founded in 2014 by two ex-Googlers, Seedtag has grown into a global company with 500+ Seedtaggers across 17 countries, backed by €250M in funding, and expanding rapidly across the open web and Connected TV.

We’re not just building technology, we’re rewriting the rules of advertising.

#### **The Role**

Seedtag is the leader in neuro-contextual advertising. We help brands reach people through the content they care about, without relying on cookies. Our exchange and our curation platform, NeuroX, give buyers premium European inventory and contextual audiences that DSPs can activate at scale.

We are hiring a Director, DSP Partnerships, EMEA to grow our revenue with DSPs across the region. This is a seller role as much as a partnership role. You will own relationships with local EMEA DSPs and with the EMEA teams of global DSPs. Your job is to make Seedtag the go-to partner for contextual audiences and curated packages in every market you cover.

You will focus on three goals:

* Upsell Seedtag audiences and curated packages to DSP partners and their buyers.
* Maximize local opportunities with the EMEA teams of global DSPs, market by market.
* Onboard new local players and drive new business with curation and neuro-contextual segments.

#### **Your Challenge**

As Senior Manager, DSP Partnerships, EMEA, you will:

1. Upsell audiences and packages

* Sell Seedtag's neuro-contextual audiences and NeuroX curated packages to DSP partners and their agency and brand buyers.
* Grow PMP and curated deal volume with every partner you own.
* Build a clear value story for each DSP: why Seedtag, which packages, and what results buyers can expect.
* Find upsell opportunities in data, formats (display, video, CTV) and new markets.

2. Maximize local opportunities with global DSPs

* Own the EMEA teams of global DSPs, such as The Trade Desk, Google DV360, Amazon DSP, Yahoo DSP, StackAdapt, RTB House, Criteo and Adform.
* Build relationships with their local sales, account and partnership leads in each key market (UK, France, DACH, Spain, Italy, Benelux, Nordics).
* Use their local buyer relationships to create joint go-to-market plans, co-selling and deal activation.
* Write a strategic account plan for each partner. Map their organization, their priorities and Seedtag's fit. Track share of wallet and grow it.

3. Drive new business and onboard local players

* Explain and bring to market Seedtag's curation capabilities through NeuroX. Help DSPs and their buyers understand how curated deals work and why they perform.
* Expand the use of our neuro-contextual segments across each DSP's organization, from partnership teams to local sellers and buyers.
* Identify, pitch and sign regional and local DSPs that are not yet connected to Seedtag.
* Negotiate commercial terms and lead each new partnership from contract to first spend.
* Work with Solutions, Ad Ops and Product to deliver fast, clean integrations (OpenRTB, deal IDs, curation).
* Ramp new partners with launch plans, training and regular business reviews.

Across all three

* Own a revenue target for your EMEA DSP portfolio and exceed it through active selling, partnership management, product and feature implementation, and demand facilitation. Report on it with clear forecasts.
* Build playbooks with the sellers at each DSP. Help them discover Seedtag's full suite of products and audiences, and know when to pitch them to their buyers.
* Engage stakeholders at every level, from day-to-day contacts to the C-suite, both at partners and inside Seedtag.
* Work cross-functionally with Technical Operations, Sales, Account Management, Product, Engineering, BI and Legal to deliver results.
* Represent Seedtag at executive meetings and industry events across EMEA.
* Bring DSP feedback into the product roadmap.

#### **What You’ll Need to Succeed**

* 8–10+ years in programmatic advertising, ideally at a DSP, SSP or exchange, in partnership, business development or sales roles.
* A seller's mindset. You have a track record of hitting revenue targets and closing commercial deals.
* A strong, active network with DSPs in EMEA, both local players and the EMEA teams of global platforms.
* Deep knowledge of DSP integrations, bid mechanics, deal types (PMP, PG, curated deals) and key metrics.
* Experience selling audiences, data or curated packages to the buy side.
* Proven ability to build relationships at multiple levels of an organization, from daily contacts to the C-suite, both internally and at partners. Strong negotiation and executive communication skills.
* Comfort working across teams and countries in a fast-moving company.
* Fluent English. Multiple European languages strongly preferred (e.g. Spanish, French, German, Italian).

It would be a plus

* Experience with contextual targeting, cookieless solutions or curation platforms.
* Relationships with agency trading desks and holding companies in EMEA.
* Knowledge of CTV and video buying in Europe.
* Experience launching new partners from zero to first spend.

#### **Why Join Seedtag?**

This is a defining moment to join Seedtag, a company that combines scale, ambition, and soul.

Growth & Opportunity: Accelerated, hands-on development with real ownership, global projects, and internal mobility.

Flexibility: We trust you to balance work and life with flexible schedules and a hybrid model; work from home, the office, or wherever you do your best work.

Learning & Development: Access to online learning, continuous training, and optional English or Spanish group classes.

Culture that Cares: Well-being is part of how we work, supported by initiatives like SeedDay, Digital Disconnection, and team-building moments.

Connection & Fun: Global events, offsites, celebrations, and a strong sense of belonging across all Seedtag locations.

#### **Ready to Join the Seedtag Universe?**

If you’re looking for a place where technology has soul, where ideas turn into impact, and where people truly come first, welcome to Seedtag.

At Seedtag, we foster an inclusive environment where everyone can thrive. We welcome diverse perspectives, as they fuel our innovation and growth. If you require any accommodations during the hiring process, please let us know. We’re committed to ensuring a positive and accessible experience.

Send us your CV and let’s build the future of advertising together.  
#MakeItHappen #OneTeamOneDream #ILoveSeedtag #DreamBig

You live inside culture and platforms — you know what's working, why it's working, and how to translate that into a content calendar that builds real communities, not just posting schedules. You're equally comfortable briefing in a creative team, jumping into the comments to manage community, and sitting across from a client explaining why a strategy shift makes sense.

You'll work closely with Associate Directors and Directors of Creative Strategy to build out the social calendar, brief creative execution that feels inventive rather than templated, and manage the client relationship day to day — all while keeping the account organized and operating smoothly.

***This is a fully remote role supporting a team in the EST time zone (9 AM–5 PM EST).***

**What You'll Do**

* Manage day-to-day creative execution for organic social programs across a portfolio of client accounts
* Partner with the Director of Creative Strategy to build out the social media calendar and plan
* Brief and direct Designers and Editors on inventive, culturally-relevant statics, motion, video, carousels, and Stories, giving clear, actionable feedback on hooks, pacing, and edit structure
* Lead community management in a way that actively builds community, not just responds to it
* Write copy for social posts, flexing tone and voice by platform and client
* Work alongside the creator team on UGC briefs and execution
* Translate platform and performance data (hook retention, watch time, CTR, engagement rate, saves, follower growth) into clear creative and content direction
* Maintain quality and consistency across a high volume of social creative output, flagging risk to timelines or scope early
* Manage the day-to-day client relationship — communication, updates, and expectations

* Fluent in social media metrics and know how to read them into decisions
* A deep, current understanding of culture and how it moves social — not just what's trending, but why
* Extremely up to date on algorithm changes and platform shifts across Meta, TikTok, and Instagram
* Strong grasp of the briefing process — you know how to brief creative that's actually inventive
* Experience using Sprout Social or a similar social management platform
* Already using AI tools thoughtfully in your workflow — you know where they help and where they don't

Darkroom is not a typical agency. We are looking for A players who want to build something great. We move fast, think deeply, and expect every team member to bring insight and rigor to everything they touch. We hold a high bar for performance, creativity, and ownership — but we also support each other relentlessly. No egos, no red tape — just world-class talent building something remarkable.

We believe in autonomy with accountability, truth over comfort, and outcomes over optics.

* **Parental Leave:** Flexible parental leave to support new parents during this important transition.

Darkroom is an equal opportunity workplace—we are dedicated to equal employment opportunities regardless of race, color, ancestry, religion, sex, national orientation, sexual orientation, age, citizenship, marital status, disability, gender identity, or Veteran status. description:

At Lokalise, we make it easy and profitable for businesses to expand into new markets. Our AI-powered localization platform helps companies manage both software and marketing content from a single, unified environment — ensuring every team speaks with one voice across every language and channel.

By automating workflows, integrating with over 60 tools, and centralizing translation memory and terminology, Lokalise enables product, engineering, and marketing teams to collaborate without friction and launch globally up to 10× faster and at 80% lower cost.

Trusted by thousands of businesses across more than 100 countries, Lokalise empowers millions of people worldwide to use digital services in their native languages. ### **Location**

While our company operates exclusively on a remote basis, you **must reside and have the legal right to work** in one of the following countries: the United Kingdom, Latvia, or Spain.

*This is a full-time, remote position. Please note that we do not engage on a B2B or contractor basis. We do not partner with search firms.*

### 

### **About the Team**

In this role, you will own the commercial outcomes and full commercial lifecycle of your assigned enterprise accounts. You will report to the Director of Sales EMEA and work closely with Customer Success, Solutions Architecture, Product, Finance, and Legal. ### **What You Will Do**

Competency using AI tools to accelerate customer research, synthesis, account planning, and decision-making, with a proactive mindset toward adopting new AI-enabled ways of working.
