AI Delivery Lead - Senior Manager
description:
Accenture, recognized as a Great Place To Work®, is a leading global professional services company that helps major businesses, public administrations, and other organizations around the world develop their digital core, optimize their operations, accelerate revenue growth, and improve services for citizens, creating tangible value at speed and scale.

**About the Program**

The Intelligent Operations program is a multi-year banking modernization program delivering a complex systems integration solution. AI is embedded in the program Way of Working — currently accelerating functional specification, design, and test case generation across ServiceNow, RPA, and API workstreams, etc... The next phase expands AI into client-facing use cases across Know Your Customer “KYC”, Estates, and Core Efficiency Package “CEP”, making the AI Lead a critical program role for the first time.

**Role Purpose**

The AI Lead owns Intelli Ops end-to-end AI agenda — from use case identification and prioritization through to governed delivery and client adoption. The role sets the AI strategy in collaboration with the Program Director and client leadership, then drives execution through workstream teams, the offshore factory, and vendor partners. This is not a research or advisory role. The AI Lead is accountable for use cases landing in production, delivering measurable value, and operating within regulatory and risk framework. Sufficient technical depth to assess feasibility, govern build quality, and challenge vendor claims is essential — but the role leads through others, not by building directly.

**Key Responsibilities**

* Define and own the Intelli Ops AI use case roadmap — identify, assess, and prioritize AI opportunities across “KYC”, Estates, “CEP”, and operational workstreams in collaboration with client leads and program leadership
* Lead use case discovery with client business stakeholders — structured workshops in English (French and/or Dutch a plus) to surface pain points, quantify effort, and translate business need into AI problem statements
* Own the AI delivery lifecycle: from feasibility and solution design through build governance, testing, and production deployment — applying the Intelli Ops stage-gate model to AI use cases
* Govern AI build quality — review model selection, prompt engineering, data pipeline design, and integration architecture produced by factory teams and vendors; enforce quality gates before progression
* Define and maintain the Intelli Ops AI governance framework applicable to each client — responsible AI principles, bias and fairness controls, explainability requirements, data handling standards, and human-in-the-loop design patterns aligned to client policy and EU AI Act obligations
* Act as the primary AI interface to client— presenting use case business cases, progress, risk, and outcomes to initiative leads and exec sponsors
* Manage relationships with AI vendors and platform providers; assess fit, negotiate scope, and hold delivery accountable against committed outcomes
* Track and report AI program value: use case pipeline health, delivery status, realized benefits, and risk posture to Program Director and Steering

**Location and Terms**

* Primary location: Spain flexible
* Travel: 25-30% maybe required to program locations for stakeholder workshops, governance, milestone events, and client relationship management
* Collaboration with offshore teams (e.g. India) and vendors across time zones — flexibility required

  

**Required Experience**

* Minimum 8 years in technology delivery, with at least 4 years leading AI or advanced analytics initiatives from strategy through to production — not proof-of-concept only
* Demonstrated experience delivering AI use cases in financial services or banking — familiarity with the regulatory constraints, data sensitivity requirements, and risk appetite typical of a tier-1 bank
* Sufficient technical depth to assess AI solution design: understanding of LLM capabilities and limitations, retrieval-augmented generation, classification and extraction models, prompt engineering principles, and API-based AI integration patterns
* Experience governing AI delivery through others — setting standards, reviewing outputs from factory teams or vendors, and enforcing quality gates without doing the build personally
* Strong business case and value realization track record — has quantified AI opportunity, presented to exec stakeholders, and closed the loop on delivered benefit
* Strong written English for program documentation and exec artefacts, Fluent in French and/or Dutch (written and spoken) is a plus but not required
* Experienced in regulated delivery environments — understands what responsible AI, explainability, and human oversight mean in practice, not just in principle
* Comfortable in SI program structures — stage gates, milestone governance, PMO reporting, and multi-party delivery across client, SI, and vendor organizations

**Preferred Experience**

* Familiarity with EU AI Act classification, obligations, and compliance design — particularly for high-risk use cases in banking (credit, “KYC”, fraud)
* Experience with Mistral AI or equivalent enterprise AI platforms in a regulated environment
* Prior delivery of NLP or document intelligence use cases relevant to banking operations — “KYC” document extraction, correspondence classification, estate processing automation
* ServiceNow AI/ML capabilities — Now Intelligence, predictive intelligence, or virtual agent design in an enterprise context

**Profile**

* Credible with both business and technology audiences — can discuss AI strategy with client executives and challenge a model design decision with a technical factory lead in the same day
* Pragmatic over theoretical — prioritizes use cases that can land in production within program timelines over technically interesting but low-deliverability ideas
* Governance-minded — understands that AI in a regulated bank requires more rigor, not less, and designs for that from the start rather than retrofitting controls
* Operates through influence across a complex multi-party environment — client stakeholders, offshore factory, vendors, and program leadership all pull in different directions; the AI Lead aligns them

At Accenture, a company recognized as a Great Place To Work®, we are committed to a hybrid work model that, thanks to technology and our facilities, allows us to maintain the essential human connection to work with our teams and clients. This connection enables us to uphold our culture of inclusion and diversity and be, according to Refinitiv, the most diverse company in the world.

Additionally, we offer you other benefits such as:

* Medical, Life, and Accident Insurance
* Medical service and wellness programs
* Flexible compensation program and stock purchase
* Flexibility programs (schedules, days off, vacations...)
* Individualized training itinerary
* Sustainability programs and Accenture Foundation
* Employee network for diversity
* Other benefits: Bankinter office with special conditions and profit sharing

* Identify regional market opportunities, trends and growth initiatives.

Manage regional marketing budgets and investment priorities.  

  

**Campaign Planning & Delivery**

* Monitor campaign performance and recommend optimisation opportunities.
Ensure all campaigns are delivered on time and within budget.

* Partner with Regional Managing Directors, Sales Directors and Practice Leaders.
* Gather regional requirements and translate business priorities into marketing activity.
* Ensure alignment between local market needs and global marketing strategy.
* Present marketing plans, results and recommendations to senior stakeholders.

**Event & Field Marketing**

* Plan and deliver regional events, executive roundtables, webinars and industry conferences.
* Coordinate speakers, venues, partners and attendee engagement activities.
* Manage event budgets and ROI tracking.
* Develop post-event follow-up and lead nurture activities with sales teams.

* Develop joint marketing plans with strategic technology partners.
* Manage MDF opportunities and reporting requirements.
* Coordinate partner-led campaigns, webinars and events.
* Strengthen regional partner relationships to maximise commercial outcomes.

**Demand Generation & Pipeline Contribution**

* Support lead generation programmes within the region.
* Work with sales leadership to understand pipeline requirements.
* Ensure effective lead management, tracking and reporting.
Monitor marketing performance against agreed KPIs.

* **Content & Communications Specialists**
* **Digital Marketing Specialists**
* **Design Specialists**

  
  

The Senior Marketing Executive is responsible for **briefing, coordinating and prioritising** these resources to support regional objectives rather than producing these deliverables themselves.

* Commercial awareness
* Strategic planning
* Stakeholder management
* Project management
* Campaign management
* Event management
* Communication and influencing skills
* Analytical and reporting capability
* Strong organisational skills
Excellent English languge skills

description:
**ABOUT QUINCE**

We deliver on that mission through a unique manufacturer-to-consumer (M2C) model eliminating the layers of traditional retail that add cost and result in consumers paying more than they need to. We find, build relationships with, and work directly with the manufacturing partners behind some of the world's finest products. From there, our teams design smart, efficient operational processes and build and deploy proprietary technology, AI, and analytics to help us scale fast.

What began with a small assortment of elevated basics has quickly grown into a cross-category brand spanning apparel, accessories, home goods, and more. Today, tens of millions of people across a growing number of countries come – and return – to Quince because they trust us to deliver.

**OUR CULTURE**

Quince is a culture built for builders by builders. Our way of working starts with a blank sheet of paper. We question conventional thinking, use technology and data to uncover new opportunities, and move quickly to turn ideas into reality. We aren't interested in replicating how others do retail. We're building a better way – at a speed and scale unlike anything that's been done before.

* We dream big and chase the hard problems others shy away from. Rejecting long-held assumptions is part of our company's DNA. Where conventional wisdom says you have to choose – soft or durable, speed or rigor, quality or price – we ask why that trade-off has to exist in the first place.
* Our pace is fast and the bar is high because our customers expect a lot from us and we refuse to let them down. We believe the best results come from challenging ourselves, learning from one another, and building on each other's strengths.

If you're someone who likes to imagine new possibilities and build better systems rather than plug-in to outdated ones, Quince is the place for you.

**THE ROLE**

**Manager, CRM Category Expansion**

The **Manager, CRM Category Expansion** owns every scheduled brand campaign across email, SMS, push, and in-app for the UK, Germany, and France. This includes new arrivals, restocks, seasonal and gifting moments, and key discount events like Black Friday/Cyber Monday and Quince Day. These are broad, brand-wide sends that go out to the whole customer base or large segments, designed to take customers beyond the one category they already know us for and introduce them to the rest of the range.

Reporting into the UK/EU CRM Director, this person runs the process end-to-end: briefing, selecting products with Merchandising, briefing Design, aligning with US Marketing, localizing copy, and partnering with Tech on features like dynamic product/price modules — then building, QA'ing, and shipping every send, reading results, and continuously improving toward faster, more personalized delivery.

**Required**

* 5+ years CRM/email marketing in DTC/ecommerce, including 3+ years running a full campaign calendar end-to-end (not just triggered flows)
* Hands-on with Iterable (or Braze/Klaviyo/SFMC), including multi-market campaign builds with dynamic content and personalization
* Experience delivering SMS, push, and in-app campaigns, plus enough HTML/CSS to brief and QA email builds
* Segmentation and deliverability fluency (engagement tiers, suppression, frequency caps), including reading Postmaster Tools
* SQL working knowledge — able to self-serve audience/results checks in Looker without an analyst
* A/B testing and incrementality rigor; comfortable setting up and reading holdouts with the Data team
* Already using AI in daily workflows, and ruthless about QA and automating it

**Pay Range: GBP 66,000 - 76,000**

Joining Quince means being part of a mission-driven team reshaping retail. You will work alongside talented colleagues, tackle meaningful challenges, and contribute to building a more sustainable, accessible future for customers and partners alike.

title: Video Producer
description:
**About Frontiers**

At Frontiers, our purpose is simple yet ambitious: to make science open. We believe open science empowers the global scientific community to accelerate discovery and develop the solutions needed for healthy lives on a healthy planet.

We are one of the world’s largest and most influential open-access research publishers. Every article we publish is peer-reviewed and quality-certified, ensuring research is accessible to everyone, everywhere. To date, Frontiers research has been viewed over 4 billion times, demonstrating the real-world impact of science without barriers.

Joining Frontiers means being part of a global, mission-driven organization at the intersection of science, technology, and innovation — working alongside passionate colleagues who care deeply about advancing knowledge for the benefit of society. To learn more about our impact and culture, please watch this video.

**About the role**

We're looking for a **Video Producer** to join our Visual Design team and work closely with the Senior Video Producer to expand and accelerate Frontiers' video storytelling. In this role, you'll take ownership of video productions from planning and filming through to post-production, creating interviews, talking-head content, b-roll, and studio shoots for company-wide communications and campaigns.

As a second videographer, you'll have the opportunity to lead independent shoots while also supporting larger productions led by the Senior Video Producer. You'll combine strong technical video skills with excellent organization, ensuring that shoots run smoothly, footage meets Frontiers' creative and technical standards, and media assets are efficiently managed throughout the production process.

You'll work closely with colleagues across Communications and Visual Design, as well as researchers, authors, employees, external contributors, and production partners. If you enjoy working both behind the camera and behind the scenes, solving problems on the go, and creating high-quality visual content in a fast-paced environment, you'll thrive in this role.

You'll also contribute to improving video production workflows by using technology, AI-powered tools, and consistent production practices to streamline scheduling, media management, transcription, subtitling, and post-production.

**Key Responsibilities**

* Coordinate video shoots end-to-end, including scheduling interviews, talking-head sessions, b-roll, and studio productions with internal and external stakeholders.
* Prepare and distribute call sheets, coordinate shoot logistics, and ensure crews and on-camera participants have clear information about locations, timings, requirements, and expectations.
* Scout and book filming locations, studios, and meeting spaces, coordinating travel arrangements and equipment transportation for shoots outside Lausanne.
* Prepare, test, organize, and maintain camera, lighting, audio, and studio equipment, ensuring all production kits are ready for each assignment.
* Independently film interviews, talking-heads, b-roll, and studio content, operating professional camera, lighting, and audio equipment to a consistently high standard.
* Work as a second camera operator and provide technical support on larger and multi-camera productions led by the Senior Video Producer.
* Welcome and brief on-camera participants, helping guests feel comfortable and confident throughout the filming process while ensuring required release forms and consent documentation are completed.
* Ingest, back up, organize, and archive raw footage following established folder structures, file-naming conventions, and media management practices.
* Support post-production by cutting and editing footage, applying colour grading and established brand guidelines, creating and using motion graphics, and preparing subtitles and AI-assisted transcriptions.
* Work with Adobe Premiere Pro, After Effects, DaVinci Resolve, and other relevant production tools to support high-quality video delivery.
* Collaborate with internal teams and external production partners, including freelance crew, studios, equipment suppliers, editors, and post-production specialists.
* Identify and resolve technical, logistical, and production challenges independently while maintaining quality, schedules, and production standards.
* Contribute to improving video production workflows, playbooks, and best practices, helping the team increase production capacity and deliver content efficiently.

  
**Requirements**  

* 2–3 years of hands-on experience in video production, videography, or a similar role, with experience taking video projects from production planning and filming through to post-production.
* Strong technical video production skills, including professional camera operation, lighting, and audio recording, with the ability to independently deliver high-quality footage.
* A strong portfolio or showreel demonstrating relevant camera, lighting, sound, editing, and/or studio production experience.
* Proficiency in video editing and post-production tools, particularly Adobe Premiere Pro or DaVinci Resolve, with experience in editing, colour grading, and Adobe After Effects/motion graphics.
* Strong production coordination and organizational skills, with experience managing shoot schedules, call sheets, locations, equipment, travel, production documentation, and digital media organization, including footage ingestion, file naming, folder structures, and backups.
* Experience with Microsoft 365 and project collaboration tools such as Jira, Confluence, or similar platforms.
* Fluency in English, with strong written and verbal communication skills and the ability to work effectively with internal teams, external production partners, and on-camera participants.
* A proactive and solutions-oriented approach, with the ability to troubleshoot technical and logistical challenges calmly and independently while maintaining production and brand standards.
* Familiarity with AI-powered tools for transcription, subtitling, or production workflows is an advantage.
* Willingness and ability to travel for filming assignments and flexibility to accommodate changing production schedules.
* A bachelor's degree or equivalent qualification in Media Production, Film, Communications, or a related field is preferred, although relevant practical experience will also be considered.
* Experience in corporate communications, science communication, or event filming is an advantage.

  
**Benefits**  

* We prioritise office presence and emphasise in-person collaboration, but also offer appropriate adjustments where needed, in line with company policy
* Extra wellbeing days on top of your annual leave allowance
* Up to 3 paid volunteering days each year
* 24/7 confidential Employee Assistance Programme (wellbeing, mental health, legal & financial support)
* Learning & development support via the Frontiers Learning Hub

***Equal opportunity statement***

***Frontiers actively embraces diversity and is a safe and welcoming workplace. Recruitment is free from discrimination – including based on race, national or ethnic origin, age, religion, disability, sex, gender identity or sexual orientation. With employees from more than 50 different nations, our diversity creates vibrant teams and constantly challenges us to appreciate multiple perspectives.***

title: Lead Strategist
description:
**About SH/FT**

Shift Paradigm is an execution-led strategic consultancy that bridges the gap between enterprise strategy and technical reality. We partner with Fortune 500 brands and emerging leaders to solve the inherent complexity of modern digital marketing. As partners to the world’s leading MarTech platforms, including Adobe, Salesforce, Optimizely, and Braze, we deploy integrated experts across data analytics, marketing strategy, technology development, engineering, and revenue operations to ensure our clients’ tech stacks don't just exist, but perform.

**The Role**
------------

Are you passionate about premium, dynamic brand experiences powered by data-driven personalization? A proven expert in omnichannel lifecycle marketing, with a particular niche for email? If yes, we’d love to connect! Shift Paradigm is searching for a seasoned **Lead Strategist** to serve as a trusted consultant on our team devoted to one of the world’s most admired financial services brands.

Reporting directly to our Senior Director of Data & Insights, in this role you will blend consulting instincts with hands-on channel knowledge to lead end-to-end strategic analysis, diagnose performance gaps, map multi-touch journeys, and guide creative recommendations. You will collaborate across data, creative, and operations teams to deliver post-campaign reporting and build business-led narratives with slick, compelling data visualizations and actionable audience insights. Please note, this is not a technical engineer role or a sales role - this is a true strategic consultant.

Though we are a remote organization, **this role must work on US east coast hours.**

**What You'll Accomplish**
--------------------------

* Serve as a trusted strategic advisor to clients, operating as a thought partner to build long-term relationships and identify growth opportunities.
* Lead client-facing workshops, strategy presentations, and workshops sessions, aligning design and copywriting partners to execute the vision.
* Develop quantifiable content strategies, test and learn and measurement methodologies to demonstrate marketing ROI against client business objectives.
* Leverage dashboards and raw data in collaboration with data engineers to interpret complex datasets, generating clear and error-free insights.
* Create and own intelligent and beautiful client-facing decks, utilizing your expertise in storytelling with data and presentation design to clearly communicate your narrative.
* Be a subject matter expert on email marketing trends and best practices.
* Share best practices with clients and your colleagues.

What You Bring

* 10+ years of experience in omnichannel or lifecycle marketing strategy, with meaningful time spent working on email marketing for or with major consumer brands. (Financial services experience a huge plus.)
* A proven expert leveraging data to drive business decisions.
* Deeply passionate marketer who can effortlessly shift from the strategic altitude of multi-year, omni-channel test-and-learn roadmaps down to the granular mechanics of a specific journey stage, channel brief, or immediate optimization.
* Curious, always-learning practitioner of AI tools to aid your thinking, output and efficiency.
* Strong critical thinking and analytical skill paired with a creative spark. You know great design, copy and CX and you can collaborate with creatives to deliver it.
* Comfortable abstracting insights from large data sets and using dashboards (Tableau, AWS) to make engaging, customer-first content recommendations.
* Expert in Excel/Google Suite.
* **Advanced knowledge of email and digital marketing metrics.**
* Highly detail-oriented, organized self-starter with strong problem-solving skills.
* Executive presence with excellent written and oral communication, time management, and client deliverable development skills.
* Familiarity with ESPs (SFMC, Adobe) preferred but not required.

Why SH/FT:

SH/FT is a consultancy built for transformation. We bridge the gap between marketing, data, and technology to unlock growth for some of the world's most recognized brands. At SH/FT you'll shape the future of how organizations connect with their customers through intelligent architecture, scalable systems, and the power of data-driven strategy.

Comp & Benefits

The salary range for this role is $115,000 to $150,000. Salary is based on several factors including but not limited to skillset, relevant education, level of experience, certifications, and scope of responsibilities.

In addition to base salary, SH/FT offers benefits such as medical, dental, vision, STD/LTD, Life/AD&D, 401k, Flexible Paid Time Off, and various other ancillary benefits and perks.

We welcome and encourage applications from people with disabilities under the Accessibility for Ontarians with Disabilities Act. Accommodations are available on request for candidates taking part in all aspects of the selection process.

Candidates must have current US or Canada work authorization. For US candidates, this employer participates in E-Verify and will provide the federal government with your Form I-9 information to confirm that you are authorized to work in the US.

No relocation assistance can be offered at this time.

All inquiries are held in strict confidence.

description:
Company Description

  

MET Retail is a new chapter for the group: bringing energy directly to households. We're building a technology-driven retail platform for power and gas, with a digital, customer-first model. One model, built to scale across Europe.

We're a small international team, and there's a lot to build. Join us on this exciting journey and you'll help shape how this company works, with real ownership from day one.

  

Job Description

  

He/She brings practical service knowledge into digital delivery: understanding customer, operational, commercial and regulatory needs, shaping how customers reach us and how we respond, and building a support function that is fast, compliant, measurable and AI-assisted by design rather than by retrofit.

The role covers the customer-facing layer of the end-to-end journey (from contracting to first bill, collection and service) across the contact channels, self-service area and support tooling. Spain at launch, followed by other markets such as France, Germany and Italy. The person in this role will own customer ticketing and service, customer engagement, the continuous optimisation of support including its tools, and claim management, end to end.

**Key Responsibilities**

* Act as the business reference point for customer service, engagement and claims across the Spanish operation and, subsequently, the markets that follow
* Translate customer and regulatory objectives into clear service processes, procedures, service levels and quality standards
* Design the omnichannel service model across phone, email, chat, WhatsApp, app and self-service portal
* Build the ticketing operation: taxonomy, routing and prioritisation rules, SLA framework, escalation paths, and shift and capacity planning
* Design proactive lifecycle communications: onboarding, first-bill explanation, consumption and tariff alerts, renewal and price-change notifications, and payment reminders
* Own the service side of retention — save flows, churn-signal detection and the operational response to them.
* Build the claims process end to end
* Ensure compliance with statutory response deadlines and the formal complaint framework, including complaint forms, consumer arbitration boards and regional consumer authorities
* Act as business owner for the support stack — CRM and ticketing, telephony/CCaaS, knowledge base, survey and QA tooling: define functional requirements, target design and evaluation criteria, support the IT organisation in vendor and partner selection, and drive business validation before go-live
* Hire, structure and lead the customer operations team; define roles, career paths, training curriculum and onboarding
* Identify, prioritise and specify AI use cases across the support chain
* Collaborate across Growth, Offering, Operations and Finance on the business side, and Product, UX, Architecture, Engineering and Data on the delivery side

  

Qualifications

  

* University degree
* **Energy retail background is a must**
* Between 5 and 10 years of experience in customer operations, service management or contact centre leadership in a B2C environment, including hands-on responsibility for building or substantially rebuilding a service function
* Experience in the Spanish market, with a working understanding of Spanish consumer protection obligations and the formal complaints and arbitration framework
* Proven experience setting up processes, procedures and teams from scratch, including defining the requirements for the supporting tooling
* Demonstrable, practical experience applying AI in a customer support context
* Comfortable in a CRM or ticketing environment, able to read data models, define integration requirements at functional level and build reporting
* Track record of leading, growing and developing teams

title: Senior Product Manager
description:
**Who we are**

At Frontiers, our purpose is simple yet ambitious: to make science open. We believe open science empowers the global scientific community to accelerate discovery and develop the solutions needed for healthy lives on a healthy planet.

We are one of the world’s largest and most influential open-access research publishers. Every article we publish is peer-reviewed and quality-certified, ensuring research is accessible to everyone, everywhere. To date, Frontiers research has been viewed over 4 billion times, demonstrating the real-world impact of science without barriers

Joining Frontiers means being part of a global, mission-driven organisation at the intersection of science, technology, and innovation — working alongside passionate colleagues who care deeply about advancing knowledge for the benefit of society.

To learn more about our impact and culture, please watch this video:

https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=jLJ7ZO3wOW4

**About the Role**:

Frontiers is seeking a Senior Product Manager to own a defined product, platform, or workflow area within our publishing ecosystem. The exact domain — submission, peer review, production, partnerships, AI, or another area — will be confirmed at the offer stage based on where the business need and the candidate's strengths best align. This description sets the bar and shape of the role common to all our Senior PM positions, so that candidates can be assessed once and matched to the right opening.

You will own your product end to end: understanding user and business needs, defining the roadmap, working with engineering, design and operational stakeholders to ship it, and being accountable for the outcomes it produces. You will operate within Frontiers' one-platform strategy — favouring shared, scalable workflows over bespoke, one-off solutions — regardless of which domain you land in.

You will not wait for a perfect brief. You will spot the problem, make a call with the data you have, and go find the rest. We want someone who treats a blocker as a puzzle to solve, not a reason to pause.

Key Responsibilities

* Roadmap ownership: Define and drive the roadmap for your product area, balancing user needs, business priorities, and platform constraints into a clear, sequenced plan.
* Requirements discipline: Gather, document, and reconcile requirements from multiple stakeholders — internal teams, partners, or end users — into a coherent, scalable product definition rather than a pile of one-off requests.
* Cross-team delivery: Work with and through engineering, design, and other product teams to ship your roadmap, tracking dependencies and resolving conflicts without necessarily having direct authority over every team involved.
* User- and stakeholder-facing discovery: Engage directly with the people who use or depend on your product — authors, editors, reviewers, partners, or internal teams — to uncover real underlying needs and validate that proposed solutions solve them.
* Creative, pragmatic solutioning: Where requirements conflict with simplicity or scale, propose solutions — configuration over customisation, shared workflows over bespoke branches — that satisfy the intent without fragmenting the platform.
* Evidence-led decisions: Steer your roadmap with data: define the metrics that matter for your area, track them, and show what you measured, what you changed, and what moved. Be ready to change course when the data says you were wrong.
* Quality and risk ownership: Hold the bar for whatever your product area delivers, and manage risk transparently when timelines, dependencies, or stakeholder expectations are under pressure. Define acceptance criteria, test with real users before release, and own post-launch quality.
* Product vision: Set a clear vision for your product area and connect it to Frontiers' one-platform strategy, so every roadmap choice traces back to a purpose.
* Business outcome ownership: Build and defend the business case for your product. Set the investment, expected return and payback, and answer for whether it was worth it.
* Team leadership: Lead your squad of engineers, designers and analysts toward shared goals. Coach, set direction and raise the bar, even without formal reporting lines.
* Managing up: Give the Head of Product and senior leadership regular, candid updates on progress, risks and trade-offs. Bring a recommendation with each decision you need.
* AI and automation: Find where AI agents and automation can remove manual work or improve outcomes in your area. Then scope, ship and measure them.
* Launch and adoption: Take your product from idea through launch to adoption. Plan rollout, train users, then track usage and iterate until the outcome moves.
* Resourceful problem-solving: When data, access or alignment is missing, say what you need, from whom and how you will get it. Keep moving in the meantime.

  
**Requirements**  

* Clarity of thought: You think critically and bring structure and clear rationale to ambiguous, cross-domain problems.
* Experience: 5+ years in Product Management, ideally including ownership of a multi-stakeholder, operations-heavy, or platform-level product.
* Requirements practitioner: Proven ability to gather, document, and unify requirements from multiple demanding stakeholders into a coherent product definition.
* Technical literacy: Comfortable discussing workflows, data, and system design with engineers, and reading the evidence behind a problem, without needing to be a domain specialist on day one.
* User-centric design: A track record of turning a complex process into an experience that different types of users can complete with confidence.
* Cross-team influence: Experience delivering through other teams and aligning multiple roadmaps toward a shared outcome, including without direct authority over every team involved.
* Outcomes: You can point to what you measured, what you changed, and what moved as a result of your product work.
* Ownership and agency: You take responsibility without being asked. When you hit an obstacle, you ask "how do I get this done?" and propose a path. You treat mistakes as information and move on quickly.
* Domain exposure: Background in academic publishing, SaaS platforms, multi-tenant B2B products, or AI/ML products is a plus, but strong learning agility can substitute for direct domain experience.

  
**Benefits**  

* We prioritise office presence and emphasise in-person collaboration, but also offer appropriate adjustments where needed, in line with company policy
* Extra wellbeing days on top of your annual leave allowance
* Up to 3 paid volunteering days each year
* 24/7 confidential Employee Assistance Programme (wellbeing, mental health, legal & financial support)
* Learning & development support via the Frontiers Learning Hub
* Competitive local benefits country dependent (e.g. healthcare and pension/retirement provision)

*Frontiers actively embraces diversity and is a safe and welcoming workplace. Recruitment is free from discrimination – including based on race, national or ethnic origin, age, religion, disability, sex, gender identity or sexual orientation. With employees from more than 50 different nations, our diversity creates vibrant teams and constantly challenges us to appreciate multiple perspectives.*

title: X-ray/TEM Postdoctoral Researcher
description:
**X-ray/TEM Postdoctoral Researcher**
=====================================

Reference

2026-IMPRESS-1

Deadline

15/11/2026

Division

Experiments

#### **Institution**

ALBA is the Spanish synchrotron light source, a large research infrastructure operating thirteen beamlines, complementary facilities, and an Electron Microscopy Center, this last in partnership with other institutions. Currently constructing multiple more beamlines, expanding the Electron Microscopy Center, and integrating advanced data analytics, it sums up a wide range of infrastructures geared toward finding solutions to societal challenges.

Located in Cerdanyola del Vallès (Barcelona, Catalonia, Spain), it is funded by the Spanish Government (Ministerio de Ciencia e Innovación) and the Catalan Government (Generalitat de Catalunya, Departament de Recerca i Universitats). The synchrotron light produced by 3 GeV electrons is used by thousands of researchers to analyse and understand the properties and functionality of matter, spanning a wide variety of fields, such as catalytic research, health, energy production/storage, environmental research, communication technologies, or cultural heritage.

Our highly motivated staff works in a multidisciplinary work environment with an atmosphere formed by lived diversity, inclusion and respect for our colleagues. One of the goals of our gender equality plan is to reach parity within the Consortium’s different divisions and offices, and several actions have been taken to encourage applications from women mostly in scientific, engineer and technical job positions.

Located close to Barcelona in a natural park and well connected by car and public transportation, with excellent connectivity to the world and an employer who understands the importance of life-work balance.

Facing an upgrade to ALBA II, a 4th generation facility, which will increase dramatically brightness and coherent flux, ALBA is in a phase of growth and dynamics. Being a part of the ALBA team will promote your career and will give you the opportunities to explore new territories.

For more information, you can take a look on our history watching this video:

https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=gHMqiH4qBAo

#### **Tasks**

This postdoctoral position is dedicated to scientific and technical methods for correlative operando X-ray Absorption Spectroscopy (XAS) and (Scanning) Transmission Electron Microscopy (S)TEM within the frame of the IMPRESS project (Interoperable electron Microscopy Platform for advanced RESearch and Services), funded by HORIZON-INFRA-2022-TECH-01-01.

The IMPRESS project aims to develop an interoperable platform based on a modular and standardized cartridge concept. The cartridges are designed to be inserted into TEM specimen and aperture holders, as well as other instruments for preparation and characterization, including surface science tools, transport measurements, microfocus X-ray tomography instruments, and synchrotrons. Within IMPRESS, ALBA is involved in the development of a MEMS-based micro-reactor for correlative photocatalytic experiments in TEM and synchrotron beamlines for CO2 reduction reaction and generation of high value products.

The selected person will report to the Interdisciplinary and Multimodal Section Head and will work in close synergy with the Interface X-ray/TEM and Methodology groups, with beamline scientists, the Joint Electron Microscopy Center at ALBA (JEMCA), and with the project partners. The role emphasis is on the testing of the microreactor prototypes in the (S)TEM and x-ray beamlines.

Specifically, the responsibilities will include:

• Executing the commissioning, operation and maintenance of micro-cell reactor systems for catalysis research.

* Contributing to define procedures for operando and in-situ correlative (S)TEM/X-ray analysis services within a network of experts and under consideration of the international community.

* Contributing to the improvement of the micro-cell reactor system and the development of a true multi-technique approach that will benefit staff, collaborators, and external users.

* Supporting staff and collaborators in (S)TEM and x-ray experiments making use of the micro-cell reactor systems.

* Analysing and interpreting multimodal experimental data.

* Disseminating results through peer-reviewed publications, conference contributions, project deliverables and reports.

#### **Requirements**

The requirements for participation must be met on the date of the deadline for the submission of applications and will be accredited by means of the CV attached to it, without prejudice to the power of the selection body to require the contribution of the originals of the certifications accrediting the qualifications, training and work experience invoked in the CV.

Applications that do not present the aforementioned or required documentation during the selection procedure will not be accepted.

Candidates must hold a PhD in Chemistry, Materials Science, Nanotechnology, Physics, or equivalent, and have hands-on experience in (S)TEM and/or synchrotron X-ray techniques.

Everyone who meets the requirements will be admitted for the selection process. This position is reserved for those candidates having the legal status of person with disabilities, with a degree of disability equal or greater than 33%. In case of one or more admitted applicants with this status of disability, these candidates will be evaluated at first. In the event that no candidate with the status of disability is finally selected for the position, the selection process shall continue and the rest of the applicants will be evaluated.

#### **Selection Process Development**

The selection will be carried out through the competition-opposition system.

As a first phase, an analysis of the curriculum will be carried out (assessment of previous experience and / or scientific history, degree, training and other professional information relevant to the position). Career breaks or variations in the chronological order of CVs will be regarded as an evolution of a career, and consequently, as a contribution to the professional development.

The assessment of the CV in the competition phase will be scored up to 40 points, which will consider the following aspects:

* Hands-on experience with in situ (S)TEM - up to 10 points.
* Hands-on experience with in situ synchrotron experiments - up to 10 points.
* Experience in developing and testing scientific instrumentation (reaction cells, gas delivery systems, illumination systems, strain cells...) – up to 10 pts.
* Scientific experience in x-ray/(S)TEM correlative experiments – up to 5 pts.
* Hands-on experience with advanced (S)TEM) techniques (e.g.: 4D-STEM, EDX/EELS, e-tomography, e-ptychography, …) and/or advanced correlative data analysis – up to 5 pts.

The best rated candidates, at least two if possible, will be invited to an interview where the technical competence, knowledge, skills and professional experience linked to the position will be assessed, with a total score of 60 points. A minimum of 30 points must be obtained out of a total of 60 points to be eligible.

Provided they meet the minimum requirements and have ranked among the top five after the assessment of the CV phase, at least one person from the underrepresented gender in the division/office will be interviewed.

The interview will include at least:

* Presentation of professional experience and capability to independently design and execute advanced scientific experiments - up to 20 points.
* Soft skills, capability to work in a team - up to 10 points.
* Capability to develop innovative methodologies - up to 10 points.
* Communication and coordination skills - up to 10 points.
* Vision of the job position and motivation for applying - up to 10 points.

The merits will be accredited by means of the CV attached to the application. The selection board may require accreditation by additional documentation, originals or certified copies confirming the experience invoked in the CV.

In case of a tied final score, the position will be awarded to the person who belongs to the most underrepresented gender in the corresponding Division and subsidiarily to the overall company.

If necessary, alternates of the members of the selection board will be appointed by the president of the selection process, and the change will be published in the announcement.

The resolution of the selection procedure will be carried out within a maximum period of six months from the deadline for submitting applications for participation.

The selection process may be declared vacant if the selection board considers not to have found eligible candidates for the position although they might meet the requirements to participate in the selection process specified in the offer.

#### **Other information**

Temporary contract linked to the HORIZON-INFRA-2022-TECH-01-01 IMPRESS project.

Base salary range €39,350 – €42,982 gross per year.

The base salary offered will be determined according to the selected candidate's qualifications, relevant professional experience, competencies and overall suitability for the position.

ALBA also offers an attractive employment conditions, including flexible working arrangements and professional development opportunities.

The Selection Board is composed by the following members: Núria Bagués Salguero, Antoni García de Herreros Dunyac, Joaquín Otón Pérez, Lucía Aballe Aramburu.

title: Tech Lead
description:
**About Board of Innovation**

BOI partners with large, ambitious organizations to design and build applied AI products that create measurable business impact. We help enterprise and scale-up clients move beyond experimentation by embedding AI directly into their operations, decision-making, and products. Our work spans industries, but always centers on production-ready AI, strong engineering, and real-world adoption.

**About the Role**

We're looking for a Tech Lead to own the technical side of our most demanding AI builds, end to end. You step in the moment a client request lands, shape the scope and the solution with the team, turn it into an architecture and a build plan, lead the engineering through project delivery, and be the client's technical counterpart until the system runs in their environment.

This is a senior, on-project engineering role. Our builds typically run for several months, with three to five BOI engineers, inside the client's own cloud environment. You make the technical decisions within your projects, running one flagship build close to full-time or two or three smaller builds at once, depending on the portfolio. You report directly to our Engineering Director.

**What You'll Do**

You lead the technical delivery of enterprise AI builds, from agentic systems and LLM-powered services to the platforms around them, deployed into clients' own environments. The work runs in four strands.

Shape the solution. When a request lands on one of your accounts, you work out with the team what to build, how, with whom and in how many weeks. You write the technical side of the proposal and defend the estimate. Occasionally you do the same for a new deal, when a pitch needs an engineer who can credibly say how it will be built.

Lead the build. You own the architecture, make and document the decisions that shape it, review the team's work, and keep client stakeholders aligned on progress, trade-offs and risks. The engineers on the project look to you for direction, and you give it.

Build where it matters. When the critical path needs it, you build it yourself, whether that's a prototype that proves an approach in days, a hard integration, or a fix nobody else can land. What you ship is production-grade.

Carry the client. You're the technical voice in the room. You explain what we're building and why to people who don't write code, you earn their confidence that we can deliver, and you handle the realities of a large organization, from approvals and platform teams to security reviews and politics. You know when to push, when to work around, and when to escalate.

Between builds, you work on the internal tooling and templates that make every BOI engineer faster.

**What You Bring**

Experience. You have 5+ years of engineering experience, including at least two in which you technically led a build and the engineers on it, ideally for clients who were not technical themselves. You've taken systems from a design on paper to production in someone else's environment, and you know what that costs.

Applied AI depth. Your core strength is applied AI engineering, meaning agents, tool use, retrieval, MCP, evals and the orchestration around them. You've shipped LLM-based systems into production and have opinions about reliability, cost and evaluation that came from being burned. Our Engineering Director covers the deep ML side, so the best complement is someone whose instincts sit in systems, agents and delivery.

Engineering fundamentals. Python, CI/CD, testing, review discipline and infrastructure-as-code are second nature, and you use AI-assisted coding tools like Claude Code, Codex and MCP-based workflows fluently, with the guardrails that keep generated code production-grade. Real production cloud experience, Azure preferred, and experience deploying inside locked-down enterprise environments are a big plus.

Communication and judgement. You can explain an architecture to a VP in five minutes and hold a client room without a project manager running interference for you. You're creative in finding a path when the obvious one is blocked, you build trust fast, and you know what to decide yourself, what to flag, and when to escalate.

People management and hiring sit with the Engineering Director. You mentor the engineers on your projects, and the role can grow toward team-level leadership over time.

**How You Work**

You treat a build as yours. You make decisions and own them, keep the people who depend on you informed in writing, briefly and regularly, and ask for help early when the commercial or people side of a project needs it.

You're at home in a consulting environment, where each engagement brings a new domain, a new client culture and a new set of constraints, and you work in the open with strategists, designers and consultants.

The field moves quickly, and so do we. You pull in what's useful, bring it back to the team, and push back when something doesn't make sense.

**Contract & Setup**

You're based in Lisbon or elsewhere in Portugal, where our engineering team sits. We're open to permanent employment and long-term contractor arrangements, and the final setup depends on your situation and local compliance requirements. We'd like you to start in November 2026.

**Interested?**

Apply with your CV and a short note on a build you technically led, what went wrong, and what you'd do differently. Bonus points for something we can actually look at.

title: Paid Media Director - Europe

This is a fully virtual role for candidates based in London or Berlin. You will primarily work within your local time zone, with some flexibility to overlap with U.S. East Coast hours when needed. This role requires both strategic leadership and practical execution; it is not a strategy-only or oversight-only position.

  

**Responsibilities include but are not limited to:**

*Strategy and Client Leadership*

* Own senior client relationships, translating business objectives into clear media strategies, measurement frameworks, and growth roadmaps.
* Lead the development and execution of full-funnel paid media strategies across paid social, paid search, display, video, and emerging platforms.
* Drive bottom-of-funnel performance programs optimized to revenue, ROAS, CPA, and customer acquisition, which represent the majority of client investment, while building the traffic, consideration, and awareness campaigns that support them.
* Oversee campaign performance and investment decisions, using incrementality, marginal returns, and business outcomes, rather than platform-reported results alone, to guide budget allocation.
* Partner with consumer-brand clients to identify growth opportunities and connect media performance to broader commercial goals.

*Hands-On Execution*

* Work directly within Meta, Google, and other advertising platforms to build, QA, audit, and troubleshoot campaigns.
* Set up and restructure ad accounts, including shopping, product feed, and catalog-based campaigns.
* Design and lead testing roadmaps, secure client alignment on tests, and translate results into clear recommendations.

*European Market Leadership*

* Direct multi-market European campaigns across the UK, Germany, France, Spain, and other key markets, ensuring strategies reflect local consumer behaviors, cultural nuances, market conditions, and platform dynamics.
* Stay current on changes in the European media landscape, privacy regulations, measurement practices, platforms, and consumer trends.

*Team Leadership and Collaboration*

* Lead, mentor, and develop cross-functional teams of media buyers and strategists, establishing high standards for strategic thinking, execution, and client service.
* Collaborate with creative, analytics, strategy, and external partners to deliver integrated, innovative solutions.
* Work closely with global teammates, including North America, to align media strategy, share best practices, and support international accounts.
* Improve team processes, operating standards, and ways of working, including the use of AI and automation, to support quality, scalability, and efficiency.

**Requirements:**

* ***Must currently live in London or Berlin.***
* 8+ years of paid media or performance marketing experience, including significant agency experience.
* Currently working at the Associate Director or Director level in paid media, performance marketing, or a closely related discipline.
* Proven experience leading paid media for DTC, retail, or ecommerce brands with campaigns optimized to revenue, ROAS, CPA, or CAC.
* Full-funnel experience, including deep bottom-of-funnel performance expertise as well as traffic, consideration, and awareness campaigns.
* Current, hands-on proficiency in Meta and Google Ads, with the ability to walk through account structure, targeting, bid strategy, and optimization decisions in detail.
* Substantial experience serving consumers across multiple European markets; experience limited solely to the United Kingdom is not sufficient.
* Demonstrated understanding of measurement approaches, including incrementality testing, holdout or geo experiments, and work with MMM or MTA partners.
* Proven success managing and developing teams and leading senior-level client relationships.
* Experience managing meaningful media budgets and complex, multi-market campaign portfolios.
* Strong strategic, analytical, and commercial thinking, with the ability to turn performance data into clear recommendations and business decisions.
* Excellent communication and presentation skills, with fluency in English required.

**Preferred Qualifications:**

* Proficiency in an additional European language.
* Experience with additional channels such as TikTok, Pinterest, Snapchat, programmatic, or Amazon.
* Practical experience applying AI tools within media planning, execution, or reporting workflows.
* Ability to collaborate effectively across countries and time zones, including occasional work outside standard hours for global meetings.

* Cognitive Aptitude and Typing Test
* Logic assessment on Excel

**We offer a competitive salary and benefits based on education, experience, and skills level, including:**

* Unlimited vacation policy
* Monthly Phone Stipend

Total compensation based on education, experience, and skills level

description:

Iconic British brand ghd is a global leader in high end professional hair styling tools and the UK’s number one recommended styling brand. Loved by stylists and consumers, loved by press, and loved by the people that work for the brand!

The Amazon Media Manager will own the UK & Ireland Amazon media strategy and activation, turning investment into profitable growth and stronger brand visibility. Reporting to the Director of eCommerce UK & Ireland, this role will lead the planning, execution and optimisation of Amazon Advertising across the full funnel, working closely with the UK&I eCommerce, Marketing, Commercial and Finance teams, alongside Global stakeholders and agency partners.

This is a commercially focused role for an Amazon media specialist who combines deep platform expertise with rigorous performance management. The role will use data, testing and consumer insight to improve discoverability, conversion and return on investment, while ensuring ghd is presented consistently and brilliantly across Amazon UK and Ireland.

**LOCATION**

This role will be based in our London (Soho) office, and we offer a hybrid working pattern of 3 days in the office and 2 days WFH.

**JOB ROLE AND RESPONSIBILTIES**

  

* Own and evolve the UK&I Amazon media strategy and roadmap, aligned to commercial targets, brand priorities and the wider eCommerce plan.
* Plan, execute and optimise Amazon PPC, Sponsored Ads, Amazon DSP and relevant Amazon Marketing Services activity across the full consumer funnel.
* Translate sales, traffic and media data into clear actions, with disciplined management of ACoS, ROAS, conversion rate, share of voice and incremental growth.
* Lead annual and campaign budget planning, pacing and forecasting, ensuring investment is directed to the highest-impact opportunities.
* Build a structured test-and-learn agenda across audiences, formats, creative, keywords, bidding and retail moments; evaluate results with methodical accuracy and scale what works.
* Own keyword strategy and search optimisation, partnering with eCommerce teams to improve discoverability, SEO ranking, product detail page performance and conversion.
* Partner with the Amazon account team and internal stakeholders on campaign calendars, promotions, product launches, availability and trading priorities.
* Act as the key UK&I stakeholder for Amazon media agency management, including clear briefs, performance challenge, governance and delivery against agreed objectives.
* Use Amazon Marketing Cloud and other available data sources to deepen audience insight, improve measurement and inform future investment decisions.
* Own Amazon media dashboards and performance commentary, providing concise, commercially focused updates and recommendations to senior stakeholders.
* Collaborate with Global eCommerce and media teams to share learning, adopt best practice and ensure UK&I requirements are represented in global plans.
* Ensure campaign assets, copy and customer journeys reflect ghd brand standards and deliver a best-in-class Amazon experience.
* Monitor Amazon advertising developments, algorithm changes, competitor activity and beauty market trends, translating relevant changes into action for ghd.
* Continuously improve reporting, data accuracy, processes and ways of working to increase speed, accountability and effectiveness.

**SUCCESS MEASURES**

  

* Profitable Amazon sales growth and delivery against UK&I commercial targets.
* Improved return on media investment, including ACoS and ROAS performance.
* Growth in relevant search visibility, share of voice, traffic and conversion.
* Effective budget pacing, forecast accuracy and clear performance reporting.
* A strong test-and-learn pipeline that delivers measurable improvements and scalable learning.
* Consistent, best-in-class brand execution across Amazon UK and Ireland.

**REQUIREMETS & KEY ATTRIBUTES**

  

* Proven experience managing Amazon Advertising campaigns, including Sponsored Ads, PPC and Amazon DSP; experience of Amazon Marketing Cloud is advantageous.
* A strong track record of using Amazon media to drive sales and revenue growth, with clear understanding of retail media economics and performance levers.
* Excellent analytical skills and confidence interpreting complex data to develop practical insights and recommendations.
* Strong knowledge of Amazon search, keyword strategy, SEO principles, product detail page optimisation and conversion drivers.
* Experience managing agencies and external partners, with the confidence to set direction, challenge performance and hold partners to account.
* Strong commercial judgement, with the ability to balance short-term trading needs, long-term growth and brand equity.
* Excellent project management and organisational skills, with the ability to prioritise effectively in a fast-moving environment.
* Clear and influential written and verbal communication, including the ability to simplify performance for senior and non-specialist audiences.
* A collaborative, proactive and accountable approach, with the ability to work across local and global teams.
* Experience in beauty, premium consumer goods or a fast-paced retail environment is desirable.
* Degree-level education or equivalent professional experience.
