title: VP Solutions Architecture
description:
**Description**

Location: Remote

Travel: Up to 25%

This job posting will come down on Monday October, 12th at 12:00 pm ET.

**About the Role**

The Vice President of Solutions Architecture leads Frontline’s national pre-sales organization and is responsible for defining, scaling, and evolving a world-class Solutions Architecture (SA) practice. This leader owns the enterprise SA strategy, operating model, and organizational direction, ensuring the function scales with Frontline’s business, portfolio, and growth priorities and operates as a strategic, high-impact function across the full customer lifecycle, from discovery and evaluation through implementation readiness and long-term customer outcomes.

The successful leader in this role will build the pre-sales motion and capability set such that the team is viewed as Frontline’s “SWAT Team” in the field. When the going gets tough, this is the team sales will lean on for help and they will answer the call.

The Vice President will partner with the CSO to set the strategic direction for the SA function, establish standards of excellence, drive technical and value-based selling strategy, and ensure SA partnership is tightly integrated with Sales, Product, Professional Services, Customer Support, and Client Success. This role serves as the primary conduit of voice of customer (VOC) and voice of field (VOF), translating insights from districts, partners, and internal stakeholders into recommendations that influence product roadmap, GTM motions, and broader enterprise priorities.

To be clear, this is an in-the-field and hands-on leadership role. This leader is expected to operate at an enterprise level while remaining actively engaged with the field and Frontline’s most strategic opportunities.

The Vice President ensures that every field seller is equipped with exceptional presales partnership, technical guidance, and value-driven solution storytelling. When they need help, are in trouble, are struggling, they will contact their “SWAT Team”. This role is critical in shaping Frontline’s differentiation, competitive posture, and market impact and is accountable for ensuring the SA function delivers measurable impact against Frontline’s broader GTM and growth objectives.

**How You Will Make an Impact**

**Lead the National Solutions Architecture Strategy**

* Define the long-term vision, charter, and operating principles for the SA organization in alignment with Frontline’s broader GTM and growth strategy.
* Own the organizational design and investment priorities for the SA function, building a scalable SA structure that aligns to Frontline’s solution portfolio and future growth plans.
* Get out of the ticketing process and into the partnering process with the sales teams.
* This is not a team that answers tickets. This is a team that works deals with the sellers.
* Establish the national SA methodology for discovery, solution mapping, technical evaluation, value articulation, and demonstration excellence.
* Support our ongoing effort to remove the word “demo” from our vocabulary and move to “solution mapping” and “solution presentation”.
* Develop platform-level value narratives that unify Student, ERP, HCM, IHDM, and future solutions into a cohesive story.
* Design and rollout a “solution presentation” systems platform such that pre-sales can run in a more efficient manner.
* Identify and design a support process that allows us to expand SA reach and coverage without needing to ask for headcount at every turn, making strategic decisions around resource deployment, capacity, and scalability.

  

**Partner with Product to Influence Roadmap**

* Serve as the organization’s clearest, most structured voice of customer across all solution lines, bringing an enterprise and market perspective to product strategy and investment decisions.

Identify product gaps, competitive risks, and high-value opportunities informed by SA field engagement, and translate those insights into prioritized recommendations based on customer, revenue, and market impact.

* Collaborate with Product leadership on roadmap prioritization, feature validation, GTM rollout planning, and pre-launch field enablement.
* Evaluate new product releases to ensure SA teams are trained, certified, and able to articulate value and differentiation.

  

**Support Sales Leadership Across Regions**

* Act as a strategy partner to the Chief Sales Officer, bringing an informed point of view and the ability to think through complex issues at the whiteboard, constructively challenging and shaping GTM strategy and business decisions.
* Act as a strategic advisor to Regional Sales Directors and National Sales Directors on territory and overall GTM strategy.
* Ensure SA support is aligned to territory priority accounts, strategic pursuits, whitespace initiatives, and renewal/adoption risks, making prioritization and resource allocation decisions across competing business needs. Oversee SA engagement in complex, high-value, politically sensitive, or competitive opportunities.
* You are personally expected to be involved in our most complex and demanding opportunities.
* Strengthen win rates by aligning presales strategy to deal risks, personas, discovery insights, and evaluation design.
* Drive SA involvement in account planning, pipeline reviews, and territory strategy sessions.

  

**Build and Lead a High-Performing Solutions Architecture Organization**

* Recruit, develop, and retain an elite team of pre-sales resources and build a strong leadership bench capable of scaling with the organization.
* Define competency models and clearly build and manage a cross-training plan to strengthen organizational capability, succession, and flexibility across the solution portfolio.
* Lead performance management, including coaching, calibration, and professional development.
* Establish SA onboarding, certification, and continuous learning programs that align with product evolution and sales priorities.
* Foster a collaborative culture focused on technical excellence, curiosity, customer empathy, and continuous improvement.

  

**Drive Operational Excellence**

* Establish presales KPIs such as demo quality, SA engagement impact, win rate lift, technical qualification accuracy, and cycle acceleration, and hold the organization accountable for measurable business impact. Standardize discovery frameworks, demo templates, solution maps, RFP guidance, and value engineering artifacts.
* Partner with Sales Enablement to ensure all teams are trained on demo methodology, positioning, and technical fundamentals.
* Implement SA systems, workflows, and documentation standards to increase visibility and reduce operational burden.
* Analyze SA performance data to refine capacity planning, improve effectiveness, and inform resource allocation, investment, and organizational decisions.

**Act as a Senior Technical Voice for Frontline**

* Represent Frontline’s solutions and strategy at large district events, conferences, advisory boards, user groups, and partner engagements.
* Provide technical leadership, architectural thinking, and executive-level storytelling for mission-critical opportunities.
* Build trusted relationships with district superintendents, CFOs, CHROs, CIOs and other executive-level customer and industry stakeholders.
* Elevate Frontline’s presence and thinking in the K–12 technology landscape through thought leadership, webinars, content, and field education, helping shape Frontline’s external point of view on market trends, customer needs, and solution strategy.

**What You Bring**

* Ten or more years of presales, solutions architecture, or technical sales engineering experience.
* Eight or more years leading presales or technical customer-facing teams at scale, including leadership of complex, multi-layered organizations.
* Mastery of value-based storytelling, advanced discovery techniques, and multi-solution demonstration strategy.
* Proven ability to influence product roadmap and collaborate deeply with Product, PS, CS, and Support.
* Experience leading complex technical evaluations, enterprise solution design, and multi-stakeholder decision cycles.
* Demonstrated ability to set strategic direction, exercise sound business judgment, and make decisions involving competing priorities, resources, and organizational needs.
* Proven ability to lead organizational transformation and translate business strategy into scalable capabilities and measurable outcomes.
* Executive presence and the ability to communicate with district and state leadership with confidence and clarity.
* Commitment to developing talent and scaling a best-in-class SA organization.
* Strong analytical, strategic planning, and organizational skills.
* Ability to travel 25%.

  

**AI-First Competencies**

The Vice President of Solutions Architecture:

* Leverages AI-powered insights for segmentation, forecasting, technical evaluation modeling, and competitive analysis.
* Establishes AI best practices for presales research, demo preparation, narrative design, and value engineering.
* Ensures ethical and responsible AI use across the SA organization, especially in public-sector contexts.
* Coaches SA Managers, Strategists, and ICs on effective AI adoption to accelerate quality and efficiency.

**Our Mission, Our People, Our Purpose**

At Frontline Education, we’re reimagining what’s possible by becoming an AI-first organization, transforming how we think, work, and serve the educators who shape our schools every day. By using AI in thoughtful, practical ways, we’re creating tools that help educators save time, gain insights, and focus more on what matters most — their students.

As part of our team, you’ll be expected and empowered to build and apply AI skillsets that grow with you, because at Frontline Education, technology amplifies what matters most: the human drive to learn, improve, and make a difference.

**How We Support Growth, Balance, and Well-Being**

* Personalized Time Off: Take time when it’s needed most — whether that’s a family vacation, a reset day, or simply time to rest and refocus.
* Paid Sick Time: Separate, dedicated sick leave to care for yourself or loved ones.
* Volunteer Time Off: Paid time to give back and support causes that matter to you.
* Ten Paid Holidays: Enjoy meaningful moments and traditions throughout the year.
* Our Philosophy: We believe time away from work helps you bring your best self to it.

**Continuous Learning and Growth**

* World-Class Learning Access: Explore thousands of on-demand courses through platforms like LinkedIn Learning.
* Leadership & Technical Skill Building: Develop new capabilities and chart your own professional path.
* AI Empowerment: Use OpenAI tools to build fluency with emerging technology and harness AI as a creative partner for innovation and problem-solving.
* Tuition Reimbursement: Invest in formal education to advance your skills and career.
* Ongoing Learning Culture: Participate in company-led webinars on AI, inclusion, and industry trends—designed to inspire curiosity and continuous improvement.

**Health, Happiness, and Purpose**

* Wellness Initiatives: Company-sponsored programs that support physical, mental, and emotional well-being.
* Employee Assistance Program (EAP): Confidential support for you and your family’s needs.
* Comprehensive Benefits: Health and financial benefits that support your happiness and future.
* A Culture That Cares: At Frontline Education, we want every team member to learn, grow, and thrive—personally, professionally, and purposefully.

  

**Compensation & Benefits:**

The full-based compensation range for this position is $225,000-$250,000 with $100K variable.

Frontline offers a competitive compensation package that includes base salary, bonus opportunities, 401(k) matching, and comprehensive health and wellness benefits.

Additional benefits include:

* Personalized PTO

* Tuition reimbursement for eligible coursework

* Career development opportunities

* Employee-focused wellness resources

* A collaborative, mission-driven culture focused on meaningful impact

**Inclusion, Belonging & Equal Opportunity:**

Frontline Education is an equal opportunity/affirmative action employer. We aspire to have an inclusive workplace and strongly encourage suitably qualified applicants from a wide range of backgrounds to apply and join our team.

**Interview Process & Data Privacy:**

As part of our interview process, Frontline uses video conferencing tools that may include photo capture and automated transcription features. A screenshot or photo may be taken at the start of the interview for internal identification and record-keeping purposes only, and transcription may be used to support notetaking and evaluation consistency. These materials are used solely by our recruiting and hiring teams, stored securely, and not shared outside the hiring process. Candidates may opt out of transcription at any time by notifying their recruiter in advance. Frontline processes this information in accordance with applicable data privacy laws and only for legitimate business purposes related to recruitment and hiring.

title: Account Director
description:
**Mower i**s a fiercely independent, 100% employee-owned, full-service advertising, marketing, and public relations agency with team members located across the United States.

Our team is seeking an **Account Director** to provide strategic leadership across major client relationships and integrated marketing programs. This individual will serve as a trusted client partner, developing a deep understanding of clients’ businesses, industries, challenges, and opportunities while bringing together the right agency disciplines to deliver smart, effective solutions.

**Integrated media expertise will be particularly important in this role**. The Account Director should be comfortable leading clients and internal teams across complex, multi-channel programs and understand how paid, owned, and earned channels work together to achieve business and marketing objectives. The ability to confidently discuss media strategy, performance, optimization, and measurement with both clients and agency specialists is essential.

The ideal candidate is a strategic, curious, and confident client leader who builds strong relationships, brings valuable insights and ideas to clients, and knows how to lead cross-functional teams toward shared goals. They are equally comfortable discussing big-picture strategy, integrated media and campaign performance, navigating challenging situations, managing account financials, and identifying opportunities to grow client relationships.

Experience working with energy, utilities, sustainability, or related industries would be particularly valuable, but is not required.

**Essential Duties & Responsibilities**

*Other duties may be assigned.*

**Client Relationship & Strategic Leadership**

* Lead the overall health of assigned client relationships while providing senior-level oversight of day-to-day account management.
* Build positive, lasting client relationships based on a deep understanding of clients’ businesses, industries, marketing objectives, and challenges.
* Serve as a trusted advisor by bringing clients insights, perspectives, and recommendations that add value beyond the immediate assignment.
* Partner with Mower Insight and other agency disciplines to provide strategic planning and direction across assigned accounts.
* Develop and present strategic, creative, integrated media, and marketing recommendations to clients.
* Navigate complex or challenging client situations with professionalism, sound judgment, and a solutions-oriented approach.
* Plan and lead formal and informal client presentations, meetings, and strategic discussions.

**Integrated Marketing, Media & Account Leadership**

* Lead the development and implementation of integrated marketing communications plans aligned with client business and marketing objectives.
* Demonstrate strong integrated media fluency and the ability to connect media strategy and channel recommendations to broader client objectives.
* Partner closely with Media and Performance Marketing teams to help clients understand media strategy, channel mix, audience approach, investment, performance, optimization, and measurement.
* Understand how paid, owned, and earned channels work together and help ensure media is integrated with creative, content, public relations, digital, and other marketing efforts.
* Translate media performance, analytics, and campaign results into meaningful client conversations, insights, and opportunities.
* Partner across Insight, Creative, Project Management, Media, Performance Marketing, Public Relations, Public Affairs, and other agency disciplines to develop and deliver effective client solutions.
* Develop strong strategic and tactical briefs that provide clear direction to agency teams.
* Maintain a strong understanding of traditional and digital marketing disciplines, emerging media channels and technologies, analytics, and measurement to help clients identify opportunities and make informed decisions.
* Provide strong, positive leadership to internal teams and help create a collaborative, accountable, and solutions-oriented team environment.
* Ensure agency teams remain aligned around client objectives, expectations, and priorities.

**Financial Management & Account Growth**

* Manage the overall financial health of assigned client relationships, including internal forecasting, client budget planning, and participation in financial negotiations.
* Maintain target agency profitability and margin goals while balancing client needs and delivering high-quality work.
* Identify and recommend organic growth opportunities within existing client relationships.
* Introduce additional Mower capabilities and services when they align with client business and marketing needs.
* Develop relationships with prospective clients and effectively communicate Mower’s capabilities, expertise, and approach.
* Participate in new business efforts, including networking, prospect engagement, proposal development, RFPs, and pitches.
* Build and maintain professional relationships and networks that strengthen Mower’s visibility and create opportunities for the agency.

**Team & Agency Leadership**

* Provide positive leadership to cross-functional account teams, including effective delegation, mentorship, and development of team members.
* Collaborate with agency leaders and subject-matter experts to ensure clients benefit from the full range of Mower’s capabilities.
* Contribute to special initiatives and projects that strengthen the agency and move Mower forward.
* Support agency growth through networking, industry involvement, thought leadership, and other business development activities as appropriate.

**Education & Qualifications**

* Bachelor’s degree in marketing, advertising, communications, business, or an equivalent combination of education and relevant professional experience.
* 10+ years of account management or related client-side marketing experience.
* Experience leading complex client relationships and integrated marketing programs.
* Strong integrated media experience, with demonstrated ability to lead client conversations and collaborate with media specialists across traditional and digital channels.
* Experience connecting media strategy, performance, analytics, and measurement to broader marketing and business objectives.
* Experience developing and presenting strategic recommendations to senior client stakeholders.
* Broad understanding of digital and traditional marketing disciplines, including strategy, creative, media, performance marketing, analytics, public relations, and integrated communications.
* Experience in energy, utilities, sustainability, or a related industry is preferred but not required.
* Working knowledge of Google Analytics and marketing measurement.
* Experience managing client budgets, account financial performance, and organic growth opportunities.
* Demonstrated supervisory, delegation, and mentorship skills.
* Proficiency with Microsoft Office, collaboration technologies, and AI-enabled productivity tools.

**Knowledge, Skills & Competencies**

* Strong strategic thinking with the ability to connect marketing and media recommendations to client business objectives.
* Strong integrated media fluency and the ability to confidently discuss channel strategy, performance, measurement, and optimization with clients and internal specialists.
* Excellent written, verbal, presentation, and interpersonal communication skills.
* Strong relationship-building skills with the ability to establish credibility and trust with clients and internal teams.
* Ability to lead and influence cross-functional teams and foster a positive, collaborative team environment.
* Strong business and financial acumen with an understanding of account profitability, forecasting, budgeting, and growth.
* Sound judgment, curiosity, and creative problem-solving abilities.
* Ability to anticipate client needs and proactively bring forward ideas, insights, and opportunities.
* AI proficiency: Ability to confidently and responsibly use AI tools in daily work to improve efficiency, creativity, and insight. Demonstrates curiosity about emerging technologies and identifies innovative ways to apply AI to enhance productivity, problem-solving, and client outcomes while adhering to Mower policies. Embraces new possibilities and adapts readily to evolving technologies.
* Ability to continuously learn and adapt to changing client needs, marketing environments, technologies, and priorities.
* Proactive, accountable, and comfortable taking ownership while maintaining a collaborative approach.

**Salary Range: $105,000–$140,000 annually**

***Salary differential is based on seniority, merit, education, training, and experience.***

description:

title: Controller
description:
### **Description**

OVME, pronounced “of me,” is a medical aesthetic enterprise that connects aspiring women and men with skilled health care providers in select cities nationwide. OVME combines a bespoke selection of minimally invasive cosmetic services with contemporary yet welcoming retail boutiques that promise the “Fountain OV You.”  
  
Our team is composed of creative caregivers who provide solutions for “age appropriate” skin health. We believe the needs of the medical aesthetics consumer have evolved beyond the industry landscape. We are thought leaders who understand the status quo must be challenged to remain vibrant. We believe excellence is achieved through attention to detail. We are honest and transparent. We give back.  
  
Our product promise is simple, “The best OV you.”  
  
POSITION SUMMARY

We are seeking a hands-on, forward-thinking Controller at the Director level to lead our accounting function through its next stage of growth. With NetSuite now in place as our ERP, this role will own how we get the most out of it: automating the close, strengthening the integrations between NetSuite and the systems that run our studios, and putting AI tools to work so that accounting is faster, more accurate, and built to scale.

The ideal candidate pairs deep technical accounting and control discipline with a builder’s mindset. When you see a manual process, your first question is how to eliminate it, not just how to execute it. You will balance strategic ownership of the function with the day-to-day rigor that keeps our numbers right.

OVME is private equity-backed, operates across multiple states and legal entities, and works in a regulated healthcare environment. That combination brings investor- and lender-grade reporting expectations, multi-jurisdiction tax and entity complexity, and compliance requirements well beyond a typical consumer business. Experience navigating any of these will set you apart.

REPORTING RELATIONSHIP

The Controller reports to the SVP, Finance

  

### **Key Responsibilities**

Accounting Operations & Financial Reporting

* Lead all accounting operations, including general ledger, accounts payable, accounts receivable, fixed assets, inventory and COGS, and tax compliance, across a multi-state, multi-entity, multi-location organization.
* Own entity-level accounting and consolidation, including intercompany transactions, eliminations, and entity-level reporting.
* Own the month-end, quarter-end, and year-end close, delivering accurate and timely GAAP financial statements on a faster, more predictable close calendar.
* Oversee revenue recognition for memberships, packages, and gift cards, including deferred revenue reporting.
* Prepare monthly financial reporting for executive leadership and the board.
* Manage the annual audit and tax provision process, serving as the primary contact for external auditors and tax advisors

Private Equity & Capital Partners

* Maintain audit-ready, investor-grade books that stand up to private equity sponsor, board, and lender scrutiny.
* Deliver timely monthly reporting to sponsors and lenders, including debt covenant calculations and compliance certificates.
* Support capital markets and strategic activity, such as debt refinancing, equipment financing, and due diligence, including quality of earnings reviews and data requests.
* Maintain the accounting for equity, incentive units, and transaction-related items in partnership with outside advisors.
* Multi-State Tax, Regulatory & Compliance
* Manage multi-state tax compliance with outside advisors, including sales and use, income and franchise, property, and payroll taxes, and monitor nexus as we enter new markets.
* Maintain legal entity compliance, including state registrations, annual reports, and licensing, in partnership with Legal.
* Oversee compliance for gift cards, prepaid packages, and membership balances, including unclaimed property (escheat) reporting across states.
* Maintain strong inventory and cost controls over regulated medical products, such as neurotoxins and dermal fillers.
* Ensure financial systems and processes protect patient information and support the company’s broader healthcare regulatory compliance.

NetSuite, Automation & AI

* Serve as the business owner of NetSuite, driving ongoing optimization of our new implementation through configuration, saved searches, workflows, dashboards, and multi-subsidiary consolidation.
* Strengthen and monitor integrations between NetSuite and our operating systems, including Zenoti (point of sale), Ramp (spend management), payroll, and procurement, so transactions reach the general ledger accurately with minimal manual effort.
* Automate high-volume, repeatable work such as bank and card reconciliations, accruals, intercompany entries, deferred revenue schedules, and AP processing, moving the team toward exception-based review.
* Identify, pilot, and scale practical AI use cases across the function, such as invoice capture and coding, reconciliation matching, flux and variance commentary, journal entry support, and accounting research, with clear review and control points.
* Partner with Business Intelligence to ensure accounting data is clean, well-structured, and ready for downstream reporting and analytics.
* Build and own a technology roadmap for the accounting function, with measurable goals for close cycle time, manual journal entry volume, and reconciliation automation.

Internal Controls & Governance

* Develop and maintain a robust internal control environment that safeguards company assets, including controls over system integrations, automated processes, and AI-assisted work.
* Ensure NetSuite roles, access, and segregation of duties are appropriately designed and regularly reviewed.
* Maintain current, well-documented accounting policies, procedures, and close checklists.

Leadership & Partnership

* Lead, mentor, and develop the accounting team, building a high-performing, collaborative culture of continuous improvement.
* Upskill the team on NetSuite and AI tools, shifting time from transaction processing toward analysis and business partnership.
* Collaborate with the SVP, Finance, the CFO, and the executive leadership team to develop financial strategies that support company growth.
* Partner with FP&A on budgeting, forecasting, and variance analysis, and provide financial insights that support key business decisions.

### **Skills, Knowledge and Expertise**

WHAT SUCCESS LOOKS LIKE IN YEAR ONE

* The close runs on a shorter, predictable calendar in NetSuite, supported by a documented, repeatable close process.
* Core integrations reconcile cleanly to the general ledger, with exceptions surfaced and resolved quickly
* Manual journal entries and reconciliations are measurably reduced through automation.
* Several AI-enabled workflows are live in the accounting function, each with documented controls.
* A clean annual audit, with no significant adjustments or control findings.

QUALIFICATIONS

* Bachelor’s degree in accounting, Finance, or a related field; Master’s degree or MBA a plus.
* CPA certification required
* 10+ years of progressive accounting experience, with at least 3 years in a leadership role.
* Strong knowledge of GAAP and financial reporting standards, including revenue recognition (ASC 606) and leases (ASC 842).
* Hands-on NetSuite experience required, ideally including post-implementation optimization, workflow and saved search design, and multi-subsidiary consolidation.
* Demonstrated track record of automating accounting processes, with familiarity with close management, reconciliation, AP automation, and integration tools.
* Practical, current experience using AI tools in finance or accounting workflows, and sound judgment about where they add value and where controls are required.
* Experience in the following areas is a strong plus:
  + Private equity-backed companies: sponsor and lender reporting, covenant compliance, and transactions such as refinancings, acquisitions, or quality of earnings diligence.
  + Multi-state, multi-entity organizations: consolidations, intercompany accounting, and multi-jurisdiction sales, income, payroll, and property tax.
  + Compliance and regulation-heavy industries, ideally healthcare, medical aesthetics, or other licensed consumer services, including unclaimed property and patient data considerations.
  + Membership, subscription, or prepaid revenue models in a multi-location consumer business.
* Proven success managing audits and leading process and systems improvements.
* Advanced Excel skills; experience with SQL, BI tools, or data warehouses a plus.
* Strong analytical, organizational, and communication skills, with the ability to explain technical accounting and systems topics to non-finance partners.
* Ability to work collaboratively across departments and at all levels of the organization, including private equity partners, the board, and lenders.

### **Benefits**

Benefits & Perks

* 15 Days of Paid Time Off
* 12 Paid Holidays
* Medical, Dental & Vision Coverage
* Optional Pet Insurance
* Travel at Work Perks/Discounts
* ***100% Company-Paid*** Short-Term Disability, Long-Term Disability, AD&D & Life Insurance
* 401(k) Retirement Plan with Employer Match
* Employee Assistance Program (EAP)
* Team Member Service Allowance

title: Senior Director, Paid Media
description:
**About Kaseya**

Kaseya is the leading provider of AI-powered IT management and cybersecurity software, serving Managed Service Providers (MSPs) and internal IT organizations worldwide. Our comprehensive platform helps organizations efficiently manage, secure, and automate their IT environments, driving operational efficiency and long-term business success.

Backed by Insight Partners, a leading global software investor, Kaseya has experienced sustained double-digit growth and continues to expand its global footprint. Today, Kaseya supports customers in more than 20 countries and manages over 15 million endpoints worldwide.

Founded in 2000, Kaseya was built by builders - and we're still building. We look for people who create rather than wait, who see a hard problem and lean in, and who treat challenges as raw material. At Kaseya, everyone plays a role in shaping the future of IT: whether you're in engineering, product, sales, marketing, customer support, or operations, your work helps protect, defend, and optimize IT environments across the globe.

We're building teams that grow, perform, and make an impact. If you're driven by the itch to make things better - a product, a process, a career - you'll fit right in.

At Kaseya, we don't just raise the bar. We build it.

**Position Summary**

Kaseya is seeking a **Senior Director, Paid Media** to own the strategy, execution, and performance of the company's global paid media investment. This leader will manage a significant multi-channel budget spanning paid search, paid social, programmatic display, video, content syndication, and emerging channels — with full accountability for pipeline contribution, efficiency, and return on spend.

Reporting to the VP, Digital Marketing, the Senior Director will build much of this function from the ground up — designing the processes, playbooks, measurement frameworks, and channel strategies that will scale with the business, not just inheriting and managing them. This is a builder's role for a leader who likes to get their hands dirty: someone as comfortable in the ad platforms, the data, and the campaign builds as they are in the boardroom presenting results. The right candidate combines deep channel expertise with rigorous financial discipline, treats paid media as a P&L rather than a cost center, and leads their team from the front.

**Key Responsibilities**

* Own the global paid media strategy and budget across paid search (Google, Bing), paid social (LinkedIn, Meta, YouTube), programmatic display, video, content syndication, review sites, and emerging channels
* Build the operational foundation of the paid media function — processes, playbooks, campaign workflows, QA standards, and reporting cadences — designing for scale rather than inheriting legacy structure
* Stay hands-on in the work: in-platform strategy and optimization, campaign architecture, audience and bidding strategy, and budget pacing alongside the team
* Set channel-level targets for pipeline, CAC, ROAS, and efficiency; forecast, allocate, and reallocate spend based on performance data
* Build, lead, and develop a team of paid media managers and channel specialists; manage agency and vendor relationships where leveraged, including performance accountability and contract negotiation
* Own the measurement and attribution framework for paid media in partnership with marketing operations and analytics — including incrementality testing, media mix modeling, and full-funnel reporting from impression to closed-won revenue
* Partner with demand generation on integrated campaign strategy, ensuring paid media amplifies the right offers, segments, and buyer journeys
* Collaborate with product marketing and brand teams to ensure ad creative, messaging, and landing experiences convert — and run a disciplined testing program across creative, audience, and bidding strategies
* Drive continuous optimization of the paid funnel in partnership with web and conversion rate optimization teams
* Stay ahead of platform changes, privacy and signal-loss shifts, and emerging paid channels; pilot new opportunities with clear success criteria
* Present performance, forecasts, and investment recommendations to executive leadership on a regular cadence

**Required Qualifications**

* 10+ years of digital marketing experience with deep specialization in paid media, including 5+ years leading paid media teams and owning eight-figure or high seven-figure annual budgets
* Proven track record driving pipeline and revenue through paid channels in B2B software or technology, with fluency in the metrics that matter: CAC, ROAS, pipeline contribution, LTV, and payback
* Expert-level command of the major paid platforms (Google Ads, LinkedIn Campaign Manager, Meta, programmatic DSPs) and the martech stack surrounding them
* Strong analytical and quantitative skills, including hands-on experience with attribution models, incrementality testing, and marketing analytics tools
* A builder's track record: you've stood up or significantly rebuilt a paid media function, program, or process infrastructure — not just optimized one you inherited
* Genuinely hands-on operator at the senior level — still fluent and current in-platform, willing to build campaigns, dig into the data, and prototype processes yourself before delegating them
* Demonstrated success building and developing high-performing in-house teams and managing agency relationships with clear accountability
* Executive communication skills — able to translate channel performance into business narrative for C-level audiences

**Preferred Qualifications**

* Experience in high-velocity, high-volume B2B demand generation environments (SMB or mid-market motion with short sales cycles)
* Familiarity with the IT management, security, or infrastructure software landscape, or experience marketing to IT buyers
* Experience with media mix modeling and navigating privacy-driven measurement change (signal loss, cookie deprecation)
* Experience at a company that scaled through acquisition, consolidating paid programs across multiple brands or business units
* Familiarity with ABM platforms and paid ABM execution (6sense, Demandbase, RollWorks)

**Additional information**

title: Senior Account Manager, Customer Success
description:
**Job Description**
-------------------

At Pencil, we are driving innovation in advertising technology through our state-of-the-art SaaS product, which harnesses Generative AI to redefine content creation. Our mission is to make AI the default in advertising without replacing creative people. To achieve this, we need to make sure that our technology isn’t just in the hands of big brands - we need to try to help small businesses and creative individuals too.

As a Senior Account Manager, Customer Success, you'll own the commercial and strategic health of Pencil's more complex accounts — the ones with layered stakeholders, higher stakes, or agency partners like OLIVER and Jellyfish in the mix. You'll work independently on the issues that matter most to the business, mentor newer CSPs, and help shape how the CSP function operates, not just execute within it. Clients experience you as the person who's always thinking a step ahead of them; internally, you're the person other CSPs and CSTs go to when an account gets complicated.

**Key responsibilities:**

* Own the commercial and strategic health of a portfolio of higher-complexity or higher-stakes accounts, including those with agency partners sharing the account.
* Independently resolve complex, cross-functional account issues, escalating only when something is genuinely outside your authority to fix.
* Coordinate with agency-side Account Director counterparts so client, agency, and Pencil are aligned before key moments — QBRs, renewals, and joint client events.
* Mentor and be a go-to resource for newer CSPs, reviewing their account plans and QBR narratives and helping them level up.
* Identify and help build improvements to CSP processes, playbooks, and tooling that benefit accounts beyond your own portfolio.

**Your background:**

* 5-9 years of experience in customer success, account management, or strategic client partnership roles, with a track record on complex or enterprise-adjacent accounts.
* Agency experience is essential. Candidates must have experience managing 3–7 client accounts simultaneously, with strong organisational and account management skills.
* Demonstrated experience coordinating multi-party account relationships, including agency or partner-side stakeholders.
* Experience mentoring or informally leading other client-facing team members.
* History of building or improving processes, playbooks, or documentation that other people relied on.
* Strong executive-level communication skills — comfortable building and delivering a QBR narrative to senior client stakeholders.

**You’ll Thrive Here If You…**

* You work closely with the wider business — you don't just improve your own accounts, you create processes others use too.
* You're the person newer CSPs come to for advice, and you take that seriously.
* You navigate multi-party relationships (client + agency + internal teams) without losing sight of who owns what.
* You bring a forward-thinking, change-ready attitude — you don't expect the product or the playbook to stay static.
* You champion Pencil's values in how you show up, not just what you deliver.

**KPIs & Success Measures**

* Retention, renewal, and expansion performance across a higher-complexity portfolio.
* Escalations and complex issues resolved independently, without requiring leadership intervention.
* Effectiveness of agency-partner coordination — joint QBRs and client events run in lockstep, not as two separate vendors.
* Mentorship impact — visible improvement in the CSPs you support.
* Adoption of playbooks or process improvements you've driven across the wider CSP team.
* Client satisfaction / executive stakeholder confidence across your accounts.

**Benefits:**

* 25 days PTO plus public holidays, although we operate a Flexible Time Off scheme
* Health insurance / private medical cover
* Monthly stipend towards wellness, fitness, and learning and development
* Remote - work from anywhere in your home country
* Enhanced parental leave policies, whether you become a parent through birth, adoption or surrogacy
* Flexible working hours

title: Director, Capital Markets
description:
**Company Overview**

Rex is a privately held ecosystem of entrepreneurial ventures led by Peter Rex, spanning real estate private equity, technology, insurance, and AI. We build businesses and investment platforms that generate both exceptional financial returns and meaningful societal impact. At the core of our strategy is investor engagement: attracting aligned capital partners who share our long-term vision. We are building the most compelling investor-facing ecosystem in the private markets. The role offers exposure to a uniquely diverse platform, combining institutional-quality real estate and high-growth tech ventures, all aligned under a singular mission-driven vision.

  

**About Us**

Our mission is to catalyze human flourishing through stewardship, serving people in all nations. We seek a transcendent impact, second to none, crossing geographies and making a permanent mark on history.

  

We aim to uplift investors, foster flourishing families, create enduring trust, and contribute to a more beautiful world through our investments, products and services, and new ventures.

  

Our investments are primarily in real estate, with additional allocations to tech, energy, and alternatives, employing a downside-protected, long-term approach to investing. We are grounded in timeless morals and seek to preserve and grow both investor capital and our own.

  

We serve a diverse ecosystem that includes:

* Multifamily apartment management with 20,000+ apartments
* Hotel and office buildings
* Tech ventures
* Insurance companies
  

  

Our businesses, with over 500 employees, are primarily throughout Texas and Florida, but we aim to expand globally with our products and services, impacting people in all countries.

  

**Mindset**

* Fanatical Investor Focus: Serve our investors by preserving their wealth first and foremost and secondarily seeking to maximize their return on equity while fostering human progress through stewardship of the assets and companies.
* Ecosystem Alignment: Execute in a spirit of partnership across all components of the Rex ecosystem, including multifamily and other real estate assets as well as tech companies.
* Missionary Zeal: Care about investor stewardship and advancing the vision of catalyzing human flourishing.
  

  

**The Opportunity**

Rex is seeking a Director, Capital Markets to own direct LP capital formation across our private equity real estate platform. We are expanding aggressively, backed by a proven record of executing major multifamily transactions. Each acquisition requires $10M to $30M in non-controlling LP equity, and the capital pool we intend to deploy over the coming years runs into the billions. This leader turns that appetite into a repeatable, high-conviction investor engine. This role is anchored by three core mandates. First, originate and close direct LP relationships with ultra-high-net-worth individuals, family offices, independent RIAs, and their advisors, focused on true LP capital rather than institutional JV equity. Second, own the capital formation process across multiple live deals at once, from first call to funded commitment, working in lockstep with acquisitions and senior leadership. Third, build the team and infrastructure behind it: the pipeline discipline, investor CRM, reporting rhythm, and associate bench that scale raising capacity well beyond any single person. Capital stacks typically combine agency debt, preferred equity, and passive LP equity, and this leader must speak that language fluently with investors and internal partners alike. The ideal candidate has 5-8+ years of experience in private equity real estate capital raising, private wealth, or a closely related investor-facing role, with a demonstrable track record of raising LP equity from private capital. They are a principal-level presence: credible in the room with a family office principal, relentless on the phone, and comfortable carrying a number. They lead associates by example, hold themselves to a competitive athlete's standard, and show a bias toward action. They combine sharp commercial judgment with a fiduciary's respect for investor trust. Not for mercenaries. Only for missionaries. This leader must be deeply aligned with Rex's mission to catalyze human flourishing through disciplined stewardship of investor capital. Fully remote.

  

#### **About the Role**

Rex is hiring a Director, Capital Markets to turn an active, capitalized acquisitions platform into a dependable flow of committed LP equity. The platform has real transaction velocity, and the mandate is to build the investor engine that keeps pace with it and then outruns it.

  

This role owns outcomes across origination, relationship management, and closing, not just activity. You will operate as the connective tissue between investors, acquisitions, asset management, and senior leadership, ensuring that every live deal has a clear equity plan, a disciplined pipeline, and a named path to funded commitments. You will carry a number and be accountable for it.

  

You will cultivate deep, trusted relationships with ultra-high-net-worth individuals, single-family offices, independent RIAs, and the advisors who steer large private capital allocations. This role does not involve raising JV equity from institutional groups. You are building lasting relationships with investors who allocate their own capital without requiring control, and you are earning their conviction through judgment, transparency, and follow-through.

  

This is a hands-on, high-impact seat for a principal-level capital raiser who wants to build something durable inside a mission-driven enterprise. Must be missionary to the bone.

  

#### **Key Responsibilities**

* Originate, develop, and close direct LP relationships with ultra-high-net-worth individuals, family offices, independent RIAs, and their advisors
* Own the capital formation process across multiple live transactions simultaneously, from first call through funded commitment
* Carry a defined raise target and be accountable for equity commitments against each acquisition's $10M to $30M requirement
* Partner in lockstep with acquisitions and senior leadership to align equity timelines, deal narratives, and investor communications
* Present Rex's investment thesis, track record, and live opportunities with clarity and conviction, tailored to the sophistication of each investor
* Explain and field questions on capital stacks combining agency debt, preferred equity, and passive LP equity
* Build and maintain a disciplined investor pipeline, with clear stages, conversion metrics, and follow-up standards
* Manage the investor CRM, ensuring clean data, consistent usage, and real-time visibility into relationship status
* Establish a reporting rhythm for leadership covering pipeline, commitments, conversion, and forecasted raise by deal
* Oversee preparation of pitch materials, investor decks, and data room content, ensuring accuracy and polish
* Manage investors through diligence, subscription, and closing, in coordination with legal, finance, and investor relations
* Represent Rex at investor events, conferences, and networking forums to expand the private capital network
* Uphold fiduciary standards in every investor interaction, protecting trust as Rex's most valuable asset
  

  

#### **Ideal Candidate Profile**

* 5 to 8+ years of experience in private equity real estate capital raising, private wealth, or a closely related investor facing role
* Demonstrable track record of raising LP equity from private capital, with the ability to speak to specific raise sizes, investor types, and outcomes
* Established relationships, or a proven ability to build them, with ultra-high-net-worth individuals, family offices, independent RIAs, and wealth advisors
* Fluency in real estate capital structures, including agency debt, preferred equity, and passive LP equity, and the ability to explain them credibly to sophisticated investors
* Strong grasp of multifamily acquisitions, underwriting fundamentals, and the return profile of value-add strategies
* Principal-level presence: credible in the room with a family office principal, composed under scrutiny, and comfortable carrying a number
* Relentless on the phone, with a bias toward action and a high-volume outbound discipline
* Experience building or managing pipeline processes, investor CRM systems, and reporting cadences
* Proven ability to lead, coach, and develop associates, leading by example and holding a competitive athlete's standard
* Sharp commercial judgment paired with a fiduciary's respect for investor trust
* Excellent written and verbal communication, with the polish to represent Rex in high-stakes investor settings
* Ability to manage multiple live deals, investors, and timelines simultaneously without dropping a thread
* Bachelor's degree preferred; relevant securities licensing or advanced finance training is a plus
* Mission-driven and deeply aligned with disciplined stewardship of investor capital and the belief that business can catalyze human flourishing
  

  

**Rex Ecosystem-Wide Mission**

Catalyze Human Flourishing through our products and services and to elevate and further humanity in all our business dealings.

  

**Rex Values / Rex Culture**

* Customer Fanatic. We fanatically focus on customers, seeking to ever-deliver more value, and inventing and innovating on their behalf.
* Product/Service Passion. Our business thrives or dies by products and services.
* Ludicrous Speed. Our default pace is extremely fast. Time is precious, life is short, and moving fast is more fun and effective.
* FAWOMO. We will find a way, or make one.
* Loves Going to War. Prefers wartime to peacetime, always hungry to move forward, do more, and push growth.
* Chutzpah. Nothing ventured, nothing gained. Fortune favors the bold. Duc in altum.
* Fun. We should only do work, over the long run, that is fun, and work with fun people. Jokes and humor welcomed, PC stuff and uptight behavior prohibited.
* Never-Lose-Money Approach. Protects the downside, using careful analysis before deploying significant resources, and ensuring cash is plentiful, never risking what others have and need for what they do not have and do not need.
* Other-Centered. Idealist, desperate more than anything to leave an impact with their life by helping other people, seeing money as a means to serve.
* Creative Cost Cutting Constantly. There is always a smarter way, always room to cut, always ways to do more with less. A cost advantage is a competitive edge.
* Fewer, More Capable. Bias to as lean of a team as possible, with the highest competency, reducing communication and coordination, creating more effectiveness.
* Underdogs. What we have done is nothing compared to what we are going to achieve now. We are fighting to be the best, clawing and biting up and forward, aiming to be the champs, be number one. Scrappy AF no matter how much we accomplish. We have never arrived in our minds. We are the underdogs always.
* Other Attributes Valued. Point-blank forthrightness in conversation with teammates, brutally facing problems. Velvet glove with iron fist in human dealings. Shrewd as a serpent innocent as a dove. Hardcore work hustle. Invictus mentality. Swagger with humility. Quiet professionalism. Thrifty and not materialistic. Loves who they work with, loves what they do, and loves who we serve.
  

  

**Compensation & Benefits**

Base Salary: Commensurate with experience and market standards

Opportunity for performance-based bonus and/or equity in deals and funds

Benefits:

* Comprehensive health, dental, and vision insurance
* 401(k) with company matching
* Fully remote work environment
  

  

**Employment Eligibility Requirements**

Applicants will be required to pass a background check and a credit check prior to their first day, given this role's direct ownership of personal credit, banking, and tax relationships. Applicants will also be required to execute a comprehensive confidentiality and non-disclosure agreement prior to start.

title: Director, Customer Success
description:
At NiCE, we don’t limit our challenges. We challenge our limits. Always. We’re ambitious. We’re game changers. And we play to win. We set the highest standards and execute beyond them. And if you’re like us, we can offer you the ultimate career opportunity that will light a fire within you.

**So, what’s the role all about?**

The Director, Customer Success is accountable for leading a Technical Account Management (TAM) organization, which is responsible for the retention and health of some of NiCE’s largest, most strategic customers by delivering strong post-sale outcomes. Your mission: deliver measurable value, accelerate adoption of our cloud-native, AI powered platform and drive long-term customer success, retention and growth.

Leading a team of 10-15 TAMs, the Director enables the team achieve their goals of consumption and adoption, Gross Revenue Retention (GRR), and NPS, while contributing to ARR growth shared with Sales, as well as industry-leading customer satisfaction, reference-ability, and retention.

This is a customer-facing position chartered with engaging customer executives and senior stakeholders as a trusted strategic advisor. The Director will be responsible for both technical and business outcomes including managing customer expectations and satisfaction, coaching and mentoring TAMs, coordinating inter-departmental activities within NiCE (Sales, Renewals, Professional Services, Support, Product, and Billing), ensuring account data in Salesforce and Gainsight is reliable and current, and other tasks related to the success of the team and its customers.

**How will you make an impact?**

* Provide leadership to your TAM organization, including managers and individual contributors, through coaching, feedback, development goals, and performance management
* Own the retention outcome (GRR) for the TAM portfolio: ensure risks are identified early and tracked in Salesforce/Gainsight with a documented path to save and at least weekly updates; ensure TAMs deliver accurate renewal and compression risk forecasts and proactively trigger renewal engagement; and partner with Renewal Managers (RAMs), who own renewal negotiation and execution
* Own customer satisfaction (NPS) for the portfolio, personally leading the action-plan discussion with the client where poor responses are received
* Drive consumption, adoption, and value realization across the book of business, ensuring TAMs are equipped with adoption data, solution knowledge, and the required certifications.
* Enable TAMs to develop and execute strategic success plans in partnership with our clients with clear goals, timelines, and success criteria.
* Build and maintain executive-level relationships with key customers
* Escalate, resolve, and communicate client risks, blockers, and feedback to relevant NiCE stakeholders.
* Manage the assignment of accounts within your book of business
* Own operating cadence, performance reporting, and forecasting for the organization’s KPIs (consumption/adoption, GRR, NPS, and shared ARR growth), reporting results to executive leadership
* This position requires travel (up to 25%)

**Have you got what it takes?**

* Bachelor’s degree in Business Information Systems or related field or equivalent work experience required.
* 10+ years experience in customer success, technical account management, call/contact center and/or service delivery
* 10+ years of Enterprise (Fortune 500) experience in Customer Success or Service Management
* 5+ years of experience with NiCE CXone or comparable platforms (Genesys, Five9, Talkdesk, Amazon Connect etc.).
* 3+ years experience in building high performance remote teams
* Strong executive presence and a proven ability to build multi-threaded, executive-level relationships and to lead difficult conversations and escalations with composure
* Strong analytical and data fluency, with experience using consumption, adoption, health, and renewal data (e.g., Salesforce and Gainsight) to forecast retention, manage risk and steer the business
* Expertise in contact center operations, cloud migration, and AI/automation adoption; ability to connect NiCE capabilities to customer business outcomes, success plans, and quantified realized value / ROI
* Strong understanding of NiCE CXone architecture, tools (ACD, WFO, WEM, Enlighten AI, Analytics), and integration frameworks.
* Demonstrated ability to lead through influence in matrixed environments and manage multiple competing priorities.
* A track record of owning measurable retention, adoption, and satisfaction outcomes (GRR, NPS, consumption) and partnering effectively with Sales and Renewals teams

**What’s in it for you?**

Join an ever-growing, market disrupting, global company where the teams – comprised of the best of the best – work in a fast-paced, collaborative, and creative environment! As the market leader, every day at NiCE is a chance to learn and grow, and there are endless internal career opportunities across multiple roles, disciplines, domains, and locations. If you are passionate, innovative, and excited to constantly raise the bar, you may just be our next NiCEr!

  

*This job description is not intended to be all-inclusive, and employees will also perform other reasonable related business duties as assigned by immediate supervisor and other management as required.*
  
  
*This organization reserves the right to revise or change job duties as the need arises. This job description does not constitute a written or implied contract of employment.*

***About NiCE***

*NICE Ltd. title: Director of Technology & AI
description:
ABOUT 321 THE AGENCY

321 is a full-funnel creative agency built for brands that operate in complex, regulated industries — healthcare, insurance, legal services, home services, entertainment, and travel and tourism. We're a remote, AI-first team that combines strategic creative with CRM infrastructure, performance marketing, and paid media to drive real, measurable business outcomes for our clients.

Technology isn't a support function at 321 — it's the foundation everything else runs on. Our CRM builds, paid media measurement, AI workflows, and client reporting all depend on systems that are well-architected, secure, and connected. The Director of Technology is the leader who makes that foundation work as one.

ABOUT THE ROLE

As Director of Technology at 321, you will lead the agency's technology function across internal systems, MarTech and CRM infrastructure, data and integrations, AI enablement, and information security. This is a senior leadership role with real strategic authority — you'll own the agency's technology roadmap, set standards for how our platforms are built and governed, and serve as the senior technical voice in client strategy, new business, and agency planning conversations.

The right person for this role thinks in systems, not tools. You understand that a CRM workflow is only as reliable as the integration feeding it, that clean data is the difference between real attribution and guesswork, and that AI only creates leverage when it's built into the way a team actually works. You're as comfortable reviewing a webhook payload or a High Level workflow as you are presenting a technology roadmap to agency leadership — and you lead a team that delivers both.

You'll also work in close coordination with 321 AIM, the agency's proprietary performance marketing platform, ensuring that its technology, data flows, and integrations stay aligned with the systems that power our client programs.

WHAT YOU'LL DO

**Technology Leadership & Team Development**

* Lead, manage, and grow the Technology department, including CRM/MarTech engineers, integration specialists, and systems administration
* Own the agency's technology roadmap, aligning platform investments with client delivery needs, agency growth goals, and operational efficiency
* Set the department's operating model: build standards, QA and testing practices, documentation requirements, change management, and support processes
* Conduct regular 1:1s and performance reviews; provide technical coaching and actively develop team capabilities
* Define role scopes, skill development paths, and staffing recommendations as the department grows to warrant additional headcount
* Serve as the escalation point for system outages, integration failures, data issues, and complex technical questions across the client portfolio

**Agency Systems, Infrastructure & Security**

* Own the agency's internal technology stack, including collaboration, project management, identity, file storage, and communication tools
* Manage user access, single sign-on, device policies, and account provisioning and offboarding for a fully remote team
* Establish and enforce information security policies, password and access standards, backup practices, and incident response procedures
* Ensure agency and client systems meet applicable privacy and compliance requirements, including HIPAA, TCPA, A2P 10DLC, CAN-SPAM, GDPR, and CCPA
* Manage technology vendors, licenses, contracts, and costs; evaluate build-versus-buy decisions

**MarTech, CRM & Integration Architecture**

* Set architecture and governance standards for client CRM and marketing automation programs built primarily on High Level, with additional work in Salesforce, Salesforce Marketing Cloud, and HubSpot
* Oversee integrations between CRMs, ad platforms, websites, call tracking, payment processors, and third-party systems using APIs, webhooks, and middleware such as Zapier, Make, or n8n
* Standardize snapshots, templates, naming conventions, tagging, and data hygiene practices across client accounts
* Lead technical discovery for new client onboarding and CRM migrations, including data mapping, cleansing, and cutover planning
* Review complex builds for scalability, reliability, and maintainability before launch

**AI Enablement & Automation**

* Champion the integration of AI across the agency — from internal operations and reporting to CRM personalization, conversational AI, and workflow automation
* Evaluate, pilot, and roll out AI tools and LLM-powered solutions, with clear standards for data privacy, accuracy, and appropriate use
* Build and maintain internal automations and AI-assisted workflows that reduce manual effort and improve delivery quality
* Stay current on emerging AI and MarTech capabilities and proactively introduce relevant innovations to the agency and its clients

**Data, Analytics & Measurement Infrastructure**

* Own the agency's data and measurement infrastructure, including conversion tracking, Google Tag Manager, GA4, server-side tracking, and offline conversion imports
* Partner with the Director of Digital Marketing to ensure lead source tracking, cost-per-lead reporting, and audience syndication between CRMs and ad platforms work reliably
* Build and maintain data pipelines and reporting infrastructure that feed client dashboards in Looker Studio, Power BI, or similar tools
* Establish data quality standards and monitoring across connected systems

**Client Engagement & Agency Growth**

* Serve as the senior technology authority in client strategy sessions, QBRs, and new business pitches — translating technical solutions into clear, business-outcome terms
* Contribute technology recommendations, solution architecture, and implementation estimates to agency proposals and RFP responses
* Partner with 321 AIM on shared clients and platform needs to ensure technology, data flows, and lead infrastructure are coordinated and mutually reinforcing
* Identify opportunities to productize repeatable technology solutions into new agency service offerings

WHAT YOU HAVE

* 8+ years of experience in technology, MarTech, or systems roles, with demonstrated depth in CRM architecture, integrations, and data infrastructure — agency experience strongly preferred
* At least 2–3 years in a department leadership, team lead, or senior manager role with direct reports
* Hands-on experience architecting and governing CRM and marketing automation programs in High Level is strongly preferred; Salesforce, Salesforce Marketing Cloud, and/or HubSpot experience also valued
* Deep experience with APIs, webhooks, and middleware (Zapier, Make, n8n, or similar), including troubleshooting integrations across multiple systems
* Strong command of conversion tracking and measurement infrastructure: Google Tag Manager, GA4, server-side tracking, and offline conversion imports
* Working knowledge of data pipelines, data warehousing, and reporting tools (BigQuery, Looker Studio, Power BI, or similar)
* Experience administering cloud-based business systems, identity and access management, and security for a remote team
* Working knowledge of privacy and compliance requirements affecting marketing technology in regulated industries, including HIPAA, TCPA, A2P 10DLC, CAN-SPAM, GDPR, and CCPA
* Practical experience deploying AI tools and LLM-powered workflows, with sound judgment on data privacy and appropriate use
* Scripting or development ability in JavaScript, Python, SQL, or similar is a strong plus
* Excellent communication skills — able to explain technical decisions clearly to clients, agency leadership, and non-technical teammates
* Strong organizational and prioritization skills with the ability to manage department operations across a remote, multi-client environment
* Platform certifications (High Level, Salesforce, HubSpot, Google, cloud or security certifications) are a plus
* Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Information Systems, Marketing Technology, or a related field — or equivalent demonstrated experience

REPORTING STRUCTURE

The Director of Technology reports directly to the SVP of Strategy and is a member of the agency's leadership team. This role directly manages the Technology department, encompassing CRM/MarTech engineers, integration specialists, and systems administration. The Director of Technology maintains a working relationship with 321 AIM leadership to align platform technology and data infrastructure, and collaborates closely with the Director of Digital Marketing, Director of Client Strategy, and Creative Director on integrated account delivery.

COMPENSATION

Salary Range: $100K+ annually, based on experience

321 uses a structured compensation framework aligned to role scope, department impact, and agency revenue contribution. Salary placement within range is based on demonstrated experience, leadership depth, and technical breadth across CRM, integrations, data, and AI. Performance bonus eligibility applies at the director level.

321 BENEFITS

* 100% remote work environment
* Flexible scheduling with core collaboration hours
* Paid time off + agency-observed holidays
* Professional development and platform/tool access budget
* Collaborative, AI-forward team culture that values innovation and continuous learning
* Opportunity to build and lead the technology foundation of a high-growth agency operating at the intersection of performance marketing and marketing technology

title: Head of Marketing, B2B Payments
description:
**About Rebill**
Rebill is the financial infrastructure platform for the Americas.
  
  
The companies shaping software, AI, travel, and digital services use Rebill to operate across Brazil, Mexico, Argentina, Colombia, Chile, and the United States.
  
  
Rebill brings local payments, installments, recurring billing, stablecoin rails, treasury, global payouts, and financial operations into one platform built for how money actually works across the Americas.
  
  
Every market is different. Rebill makes the infrastructure consistent. Engineering, finance, and operations teams can manage local currency acceptance, market-specific payment behavior, funds, and financial workflows from the same platform.
  
  
Companies can launch in Latin America in as little as a day and expand across markets without rebuilding their financial stack country by country.
  
  
Built locally. Designed to scale globally.
  
  
Rebill is backed by leading global investors such as Tiger Global, Y Combinator (W22), Soma Capital and SV Angel, and angels including Guillermo Rauch (Vercel) and Arash Ferdowsi (Dropbox).
  
  
Why this role exists
  
  
Our product is ahead of our brand.
  
  
We show up in evaluations against the large regional processors. In too many of them we are not in the room at all, and in the ones where we are, we read as earlier stage than we are. A company about to route its regional volume through us needs to see infrastructure, not a startup. That gap costs us deals we should be winning on product.
  
  
At the same time, every piece of marketing we do today is run by the founders in the gaps between other jobs: the ads, the SEO, the content, the launches, the events. It holds at twelve people. It will not hold through the next stage.
  
  
This role owns both.
  
  
**What You Will Own**

* Brand and positioning. One story about what Rebill is and why it matters, decided once and held everywhere: the site, the deck, the product, the sales calls. There are four versions of it today. The harder half of this is moving Rebill from looking like a startup to being credible to a bank, a public company or a regulated buyer, and doing it without losing the reason people like working with us. Visual identity and the standard of every surface that carries our name are part of the job.
* Product marketing. Our product is technical and our buyer gets more sophisticated every quarter. Someone has to turn what engineering ships into something a CFO or a VP of Finance understands and acts on: launches with a real process behind them, sales material that shortens a cycle instead of decorating it, and airtime for the people building it.
* Content and distribution. Build the publishing engine: site, blog, LinkedIn, press, and the organic surface that AI assistants cite when someone asks how to collect across Latin America. Content goes out in English first and gets localized per market after.
* Events and founder positioning. Own the calendar and the outcome, from Money20/20 and Febraban class shows down to dinners for fifteen people that move one account. Booth, content, capture, follow-up, and the discipline of cross-referencing scanned leads against the CRM so we know what was net new and which opportunities we influenced. The bar is that events pay for themselves and that you can show it. You will also get our founders onto the right stages and make them better once they are up there.
* Demand generation. Campaigns, paid, funnel instrumentation and the loop back to sales. You inherit what the founders run today, starting with Google Ads and SEO.
* Ecosystem. Accelerators, communities, partner co-marketing and the Y Combinator network.

**What We Are Looking For**

* You work inside a technology company today, or did until recently, and someone else paid for that learning curve. Rebill is not where you find out how software gets built and sold. Payments or fintech in Latin America is where our strongest candidates come from. Failing that, a technical B2B category with a sophisticated buyer and a long sales cycle. If your career is in agencies, consulting or consumer brands, this is not the role.
* You have sold to companies, not consumers. You know what a long enterprise cycle feels like from the inside and what actually counts as proof inside one.
* You have run marketing across several countries from one seat. Not one market with regional support. Several markets with different payment cultures, different press and different buyers, with a team you could count on one hand.
* Your career passed through more than one discipline. The people who are best at this job have some combination of classical brand work, where owning a brand meant owning a business, hands-on paid media, and time spent close to product. One lane is not enough here. Two or three is what makes the difference.
* You are hands-on. You write the copy, brief the designer, build the deck and pull the numbers yourself. For the first stretch there is nobody to hand it to.
* You write English at a level that does not need editing, and you present in English and Spanish. Our content is English first.

You use AI tools every day and it is visible in how much you ship and how good it is.
  
  
**Nice to have**

* Portuguese. Brazil is a priority market and we invest there.
* You have taken a company through the move from looking like a startup to being credible to a regulated buyer, and you remember what actually shifted it.
* Press and analyst relations in payments or fintech.
* Ownership of a booth or a program at an event the size of Money20/20 or Febraban.
* You have managed a designer or an agency and held visual consistency across markets.
* A real network in the Latin American fintech ecosystem: accelerators, communities, funds, operators.

**What Success Looks Like**
In the first 90 days there is one version of our story and everyone uses it. The site, the deck and the sales team say the same thing, and you can explain in one paragraph why a company should route its regional volume through us.
  
  
By six months there is a content engine publishing in English with a localization path, launches have a process attached to them, and our events are measured against pipeline instead of against how the booth felt.
  
  
By twelve months, when a mid-market or enterprise company in the Americas starts looking for a way to collect across the region, we are on the shortlist. Marketing sources a measurable share of new pipeline and you know which share and why.
  
  
**What This Role Is Not**
There is no team to inherit. You are the marketing function for the first stretch, and you hire in the second year, not the first.
  
  
The founders stay the public faces of Rebill. We want you to make us better at that and to build a brand that outlasts us doing it. We are not looking for someone to be the voice instead of us.
  
  
We keep marketing in-house. We use agencies for specific pieces, press and visual identity among them, and we do not hand anyone the brand.
  
  
You report to the co-founders, and you will spend your first months earning credibility with people who have never worked alongside a marketing function. That is part of the job and not a sign that it is going badly.
  
  
**Compensation**
Competitive base, meaningful equity, and the scope of a founding function. Hybrid in Buenos Aires, Bogotá or Miami. Remote from Mexico City or São Paulo, with regular time in one of our offices. Travel for events and offsites.

title: Head of Video
description:
**We're hiring: Head of Video – Ramos Real Estate Dubai**

Lead the visual identity of a growing real estate and property tech group.

For four years, Ramos Real Estate has helped clients invest in Dubai property, with a strong focus on off-plan projects and international buyers, especially from Nigeria. We're growing fast alongside our sister company, Expert Listing, a property platform built for Nigeria.

We're looking for a talented video editor and shooter to own our content from idea to final cut. This isn't a "shoot what you're told" role. You'll shape how our brand looks, sounds and feels across every platform.

**What you'll own**

* Our video style and direction across Instagram, TikTok, YouTube and Facebook
* Shooting property tours, off-plan launches, show units, drone and lifestyle footage across Dubai
* Editing high-quality short-form and long-form videos, including faceless content with voice-overs, motion graphics and captions
* A monthly plan of 20+ finished videos, created with our marketing team
* Tracking what performs and using the data to improve each month's content

**What success looks like**

* 20+ finished videos delivered every month
* Edits turned around within 48 hours of a shoot
* Content that grows our reach, engagement and buyer enquiries month on month

**What we're looking for**

* A strong showreel with real estate, luxury, architecture or lifestyle content
* Advanced editing skills in Premiere Pro, After Effects, DaVinci Resolve or Final Cut
* Confidence shooting with mirrorless cameras, gimbals and audio equipment
* A sharp eye for storytelling, pacing and social media trends
* Ability to work independently and deliver on time
* Based in Dubai

**What we offer**

* Salary: AED 5,000–7,000 per month, depending on experience
* Monthly performance bonus for hitting delivery and results targets
* Bonus when a lead from your content turns into a closed sale
* Guaranteed salary review after 3 months
* Creative freedom to define the brand's visual style
* Flexible working: edit remotely between shoots
* Camera, gimbal and audio kit provided
* A clear path to lead content across two growing companies

**How to apply**

Send your CV and portfolio or showreel to info@ramosrealestatedubai.com with the subject line "Head of Video – [Your Name]."

In your email, include a short note describing one real estate video you'd create for us.

Shortlisted candidates will complete a short paid test edit, and we aim to make a decision within one week. Applications without a CV, portfolio and video idea won't be considered.
