title: Fractional Media Director
description:
**Overview**

We are seeking an autonomous, business-minded **Media Director** to take comprehensive ownership of our annual **$20M media budget**. As a $200-$250M omnichannel brand scaling rapidly, we are moving beyond pure-play performance to build a sophisticated, full-funnel media engine.

In this role, you will operate as a high-leverage individual contributor. Instead of managing a large internal team, you will wield full strategic control over media allocation and agency partners. You will be responsible for balancing traditional **DTC conversion media**, deploying our new **brand awareness initiatives**, and maximizing our presence across our core Retail Media Networks: **Amazon** and **Target**. Additionally, you will support us in hiring the right media agency/partner.

**Duties**

**1. Full Media Budget Ownership & Capital Allocation**

* Serve as the sole financial steward for the $XM media budget, fluidly shifting capital between performance, brand, and retail channels to maximize overall enterprise growth.
* Lead comprehensive media planning and scenario-modeling to present direct spending recommendations to executive leadership.

**2. Retail Media Network (RMN) Mastery (Amazon & Target)**

* Drive omni-channel velocity by building and scaling ad strategies on **Amazon Advertising** (Sponsored Ads, DSP) and **Target Roundel**.
* Align digital media plans with retail trade calendars to ensure digital media spend directly boosts physical shelf velocity and online market share.

**3. Full-Funnel Brand Awareness Strategy**

* Own the strategy, deployment, and optimization of upper-funnel brand equity campaigns across Connected TV (CTV), Digital Audio, Linear, and Programmatic video.
* Establish and track upper-funnel success metrics via brand lift studies, tracking share of voice (SOV), and baseline organic search growth.

**4. DTC Conversion & Performance Media**

* Maintain the efficiency of core performance channels (Meta, Google, TikTok) focusing on Customer Acquisition Cost (CAC), Lifetime Value (LTV), and Blended Marketing Efficiency Ratio (MER). Recognizing this is the core of media planning and strategy today, this will be a strong foundation shift.
* Partner with internal creative teams to guide rapid asset testing based on performance data trends.

**5. High-Impact Agency Governance**

* Directly manage external media planning, buying, and performance agencies, acting as their primary point of contact and holding them to strict execution standards.
* Audit agency work continuously to eliminate media waste and ensure data-driven campaign optimizations.

**6. Advanced Attribution & Holistic Measurement**

* Partner with Data Analytics to interpret Media Mix Modeling (MMM) and Multi-Touch Attribution (MTA) readouts.
* Quantify the "halo effect" of brand and retail media spending on our direct-to-consumer website traffic and sales.

**Qualifications**

* **Experience:** 5–8 years of experience overseeing omnichannel media strategy, either brand-side or at a leading growth agency.
* **Budget Scale:** Direct experience managing or heavily influencing media budgets of **$20M+ annually**.
* **RMN Specialization:** Proven, deep expertise navigating **Amazon Advertising** and **Target Roundel** ecosystems.
* **Individual Contributor DNA:** Thrives as a self-directed operator who can command a $50M budget and steer agencies without needing a large internal team to delegate to.
* **Full-Funnel Native:** Demonstrated success deploying and measuring upper-funnel, non-linear brand awareness campaigns.
* **Analytical Rigor:** Highly proficient in interpreting MMM data, Google Analytics 4, and multi-retailer dashboard metrics.

Join us as a Fractional Media Director if you're ready to bring your strategic vision to life through impactful storytelling, innovative media outreach, and engaging digital campaigns!

title: Director, Product Design
description:
**About the role**
------------------

Cyberhaven is building Flow, a unified data security platform spanning Human Data Security, Agentic Data Security, and Data Security Posture Management. The people who use it are security analysts, insider-risk investigators, and data protection leaders — experts doing demanding work under time pressure, who live in our product all day. And increasingly they are not working alone: AI agents are becoming actors inside the enterprise and inside our product, which means the experience we design now has to serve both the human doing the judging and the agent doing the work.

We are looking for a Director of Product Design to lead our design team and own what Flow feels like to use. You will set the experience vision for the platform, define the interaction patterns for a generation of security work that is part human and part agentic, and lead the designers and researchers who make it real.

You will lead a small, talented team of designers and will partner directly with the CPO, product management, engineering, and customer experience, and you will operate as the design voice in the rooms where the roadmap and scope get decided. This is a hands-on leadership role: you will raise the craft bar and grow your team, and still be close enough to the work to have an independent point of view about what we should build.

**What you'll do**
------------------

* Own the end-to-end product design experience across Flow, HDS, ADS, and DSPM from the analyst’s daily workflow to how the platform holds together as one product rather than three.
* Define the next-generation experience vision for the platform, including how humans and AI agents work together inside it: agent-assisted investigation, human-in-the-loop decisions, explainability, and the interaction patterns that let a security professional trust and override automated work.
* Lead, coach, and grow a team of product designers, and raise the standard for craft, critique, and how design decisions are argued and defended.
* Own the UX research function and make sure the team’s work is grounded in evidence customer interviews, usability testing, support and RFE signal, and product instrumentation rather than internal opinion.
* Partner with product management and engineering from the earliest stage of every major initiative, shaping the problem definition and scope rather than styling decisions that have already been made.
* Build and evolve the design system and the patterns that let a growing engineering organization ship a consistent experience at speed.
* Establish how design measures itself usability benchmarks, task success, time to resolution for core analyst workflows, adoption of new surfaces, support deflection and report against it.
* Drive the experience work behind platform migration, making sure the move to Flow is something customers want rather than something they endure.
* Represent the customer’s experience in executive forums roadmap reviews, business reviews, and planning with a clear and honest read on where the product stands.

**Who you are**
---------------

* 10+ years in product design, including 4+ years leading and developing designers, with a portfolio of shipped work you can walk through end to end.
* You have set an experience vision for a complex product and then delivered against it — not just a concept deck, but patterns and surfaces that shipped and held up.
* Experienced with complex, expert-user enterprise software — tools where the user is a professional doing demanding work, not a consumer. Security, IT operations, observability, data infrastructure, or similar domains.
* You have designed AI-powered or agentic product experiences and have a real point of view on trust, transparency, control, and what happens when the model is wrong.
* Strong systems thinker: you can hold a platform-level information architecture in your head, and you build design systems that make teams faster instead of slowing them down.
* You value and use research. You know how to run the function, ask the right questions of it, and act on what comes back.
* An exceptional communicator and influencer. You can tell a room of executives something they do not want to hear, ground it in the customer’s reality, and leave with a decision.
* A people leader first. You develop designers, give direct feedback, and build a team that does its best work.
* You operate with urgency and judgment in a fast-moving environment, and you are comfortable making progress before every input is in hand.
* Located in the US (SF Bay Area preferred).

**Bonus points if you have:**

* Worked in cybersecurity, or designed for security operations, insider risk, or data protection teams.
* Led design through a major platform migration or the consolidation of several products into one.
* Experience building a design function hiring, leveling, process, and the operating rhythm not just running one that already existed.

Joining Cyberhaven means joining the team building Data Security for the Agentic Enterprise. Traditional tools fall short. Cyberhaven traces the full lifecycle of your data, adapting protection to changing context, so protection moves with the way people actually work, not against it. AI Changed Work. We Protect It.  
Backed by $250M from leading investors like Khosla and Redpoint, our team includes leaders who built industry-defining technologies at CrowdStrike, Palo Alto Networks, Meta, Google, and more. This role lets you shape the future of data security, working alongside people driven to protect workflows, not just data, for customers who cannot afford to slow down to stay safe.

The AI Tools may process information you provide during the application and interview process. When AI-assisted interview note taking is used, candidates are notified in advance and have the option to opt out of the AI-assisted interview note taking.

*Cyberhaven is committed to creating a diverse environment and is an equal opportunity employer. All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, color, religion, gender, gender identity or expression, sexual orientation, national origin, genetics, disability, age, or veteran status.*

Compensation Range: $250K - $275K

title: Marketing Manager
description:
**Marketing Manager**

Full-Time **Fully Remote (Continental US)**  Reports to the Managing Partner

**About the Role**

We are hiring a Marketing Manager to build and run Snack Bar’s inbound marketing engine. Earlier this year we hired a Senior Director of Business Development who owns outbound prospecting, pitching, and closing. This role is the other half of that engine: you create the demand he converts.

You will own four things: lead generation (lead magnets, landing pages, funnels, and nurture), social media, the website and everything published on it, and our online reputation through client reviews. The studio does excellent work for some of the largest technology brands in the world and almost nobody knows it. Your job is to fix that and turn it into qualified leads.

This is a hands-on, individual-contributor role. There are no direct reports and no plan to build a marketing team in the first six months or more. You do the work yourself: you write, you build the pages, you run the channels, you ask clients for reviews.

The ideas and expertise already live inside the studio. Our Creative Director and team know app store creative, in-app design, and localization better than almost anyone, and they will feed you the substance. You turn it into content, distribution, and pipeline.

This is a fully remote position for candidates in the continental US, with a preference for Pacific or Mountain time zones for team overlap. Occasional travel to Santa Rosa and to industry events.

**About Snack Bar**

Snack Bar is the visual design studio behind the world’s most downloaded apps. Based in Santa Rosa, CA, we partner with the growth and product teams at enterprise tech and consumer brands, delivering the visual assets apps need to convert and grow: app store screenshots and preview videos, in-app product design, growth marketing creative, and localization across 20+ global markets. We work at a quality level no generalist agency or design subscription can match. We are now building the marketing and new-business engine to grow beyond our anchor clients.

**What You’ll Do**

* **Build the inbound lead engine:** Create lead magnets (guides, teardowns, benchmarks, templates), landing pages, and email nurture sequences that bring the right buyers to us and hand qualified leads to Business Development.
* **Run our social media:** Own the content calendar and daily execution on LinkedIn (company page and leadership voices) and the design-community channels where our buyers and talent look (Instagram, Dribbble, Behance). Turn our client work into posts people actually read.
* **Own the website:** Decide what gets published and when: blog posts, case studies, service pages, and conversion paths. Keep the site current, measurable, and pointed at generating inquiries.
* **Build our online reputation:** Build a repeatable process for collecting client reviews and testimonials on Clutch, Google, and the directories our buyers check. Claim and clean up our profiles. Turn happy clients into public proof.
* **Turn expertise into content:** Work with the Creative Director and team experts who supply the ideas and know-how. You package it: writing, editing, design briefs, and publishing.
* **Measure what matters:** Define and report monthly on qualified leads delivered, inbound pipeline value, website conversion, audience growth, and reviews collected. Work with Business Development to agree on what a qualified lead is and keep that definition honest.

**Required Skills & Experience**

* **5 to 8 years of hands-on B2B marketing with a lead-generation track record.** You have personally built lead magnets, funnels, and nurture programs that produced qualified leads a sales team accepted and closed. You can show the numbers.
* **Experience marketing a services business.** Agency, studio, consultancy, or another company that sells expertise and people rather than a product. You know how long B2B services sales cycles are and how marketing supports them.
* **You can execute across the stack yourself.** Landing page and CMS tools, email marketing platforms, LinkedIn company page management, basic SEO, and web analytics. You do not need a developer or a specialist to ship.
* **Strong writer and editor.** Clear, specific, and free of jargon. You can take a 20-minute conversation with a designer and turn it into a post, a case study, or a guide.
* **Design sense.** You will brief and review design work, so you need taste and a working vocabulary for it. You do not need to be a designer.
* **Fully autonomous.** The Managing Partner has limited weekly hours for Snack Bar and there is no marketing lead above you. You set the plan, do the work, and report results.
* **Location.** Continental US, Pacific or Mountain time preferred.

**Nice to Have**

* **Familiarity with our clients’ world:** Mobile apps, app store creative, ASO, or growth marketing for consumer or prosumer apps.
* **Reputation experience:** You have run a review-collection program before (Clutch, G2, Google, Trustpilot, or similar).
* **CRM literacy:** You have worked with HubSpot, Pipedrive, or a similar CRM and understand lead handoff to sales.

**This Role Is Not For You If**

* You want to manage a team from day one. This is an individual-contributor role for at least the first six months.
* Your background is mainly paid media or SaaS product-led growth. This is organic, content-led demand generation for a services studio.
* You need a strategist above you to tell you what to do. You are the strategist and the executor.
* You prefer to stay in strategy decks. This role ships pages, posts, emails, and review requests every week.

**What We Offer**

* Base salary: $95,000 to $115,000 base salary, depending on location and experience.
* Performance bonus: Up to 10% of base salary per year, tied to lead-generation and reputation goals agreed in your first 90 days. You become eligible after six months on the job.
* Fully remote work environment. Continental US; Pacific or Mountain time zone preferred.
* Work with world-class brands in tech, entertainment, and digital. Our clients are some of the most downloaded apps in the world.
* Health insurance reimbursement benefits.
* 401(k) plan with company match.
* Annual PTO, paid holidays, and a paid birthday day off.

**Our Values**

Undeniably Great Work: We take pride in our work and hold ourselves accountable for its quality and timely delivery. Set a high standard, and the result will be excellence.

It’s a Team Sport: Great solutions come from open communication and honest, respectful feedback. We listen, learn, and build on each other’s ideas to deliver the best possible outcomes. The best ideas are chosen based on merit and relevance. Seniority or loudness does not override quality.

You’re An Artist, a Creative: Our role is to transform client ideas, no matter how loosely formed, into engaging digital design assets. Through creative thinking and thoughtful execution, we turn concepts into memorable, impactful experiences.

Pay: $95,000.00 - $115,000.00 per year

Benefits:

* 401(k) matching
* Retirement plan

Application Question(s):

* How many sales-accepted leads did your best lead magnet, funnel, or nurture program produce in the last 12 months?
* What was the average annual contract or project value of the services you marketed?
* Have you marketed a company that sells services (agency, studio, consultancy) rather than a product?
* Have you built a company’s inbound marketing from zero, with no team and no agency?

Experience:

* B2B marketing with lead generation: 5 years (Required)

Work Location: Remote

title: Sr Manager of Lifecycle & Retention Marketing
description:
Ursa Major is seeking a strategic and hands-on Senior Manager, Lifecycle & Retention Marketing to own and accelerate customer retention, subscription growth, and customer lifetime value.

Reporting directly to the Sr. Director of Ecommerce, this role will lead the entire customer lifecycle strategy from acquisition handoff through repeat purchase, replenishment, subscription retention, loyalty, win-back, and advocacy.

The ideal candidate combines deep retention marketing expertise with a strong focus on subscription growth and retention. You understand that successful lifecycle marketing isn't just about automation and segmentation, it's about delivering the right message, to the right customer, at the right moment. You know how to leverage customer insights, behavioral data, compelling storytelling, and testing to build meaningful customer relationships that drive revenue and long-term brand loyalty.

This is an exciting opportunity to build and optimize a best-in-class lifecycle program for a beloved subscription-enabled skincare brand with a highly engaged customer base.

Own Lifecycle & Retention Strategy

* Develop and execute the overall retention marketing roadmap focused on increasing customer lifetime value (LTV), repeat purchase rate, subscription growth, and customer loyalty.
* Evolve customer journey strategies across acquisition, replenishment, engagement, subscription, cross-sell, upsell, win-back, and loyalty touch points.
* Identify opportunities throughout the customer lifecycle to improve customer experience and maximize retention.

Lead Email & SMS Marketing Programs

* Own the lifecycle calendar across email and SMS channels.
* Create highly personalized customer experiences using segmentation, behavioral triggers, predictive insights, and customer data.

Own Subscription Growth & Retention

* Lead subscription lifecycle strategy from acquisition through long-term retention.
* Increase subscriber acquisition, active subscriber rate, average subscription tenure, and subscriber lifetime value.
* Develop churn reduction initiatives and cancellation prevention programs.
* Build testing strategies around replenishment timing, subscription offers, save tactics, subscriber benefits, and customer education.
* Analyze subscriber behavior and identify fresh new opportunities to increase recurring revenue.

Drive Testing & Optimization

* Establish a rigorous testing culture across lifecycle channels.
* Design and execute A/B and multivariate tests on Subject lines, Messaging, Offers, Creative concepts, Send times, Audience segmentation, Product recommendations, Subscription experiences, Landing pages and conversion paths plus more.
* Translate insights into actionable growth opportunities and scalable best practices.

Leverage Data & Customer Insights

* Monitor and update customer cohorts and lifecycle reporting frameworks.

* Guide messaging frameworks that strengthen emotional connection, product education, community engagement, and brand loyalty.

title: Marketing Director
description:
The Marketing Director will serve as a key business leader who will inspire the marketing team and drive brand portfolio management, consumer communications and new product innovation launches, always incorporating a consumer-centric perspective. The Director will be responsible for planning, development and implementation of marketing strategy , communications, innovation, renovation and portfolio management to exceed stated volume and profit objectives .
  
  
The Marketing Director will oversee all aspects of Top Ramen® across all platforms, formats and sub-brands under Top Ramen.
  
  
**Responsibilities**
**Consumer Insights and Business Acumen:**

* Displays a deep understanding of the consumer and drives a consumer first mentality within the organization.
* Understands relevant marketplace dynamics and other key issues that help the team in the development of the brand's marketing mix (e.g., product quality, pricing, promotions, and distribution).
* Analyzes category, brand, competitive and consumer trends to drive insights into action.
* Has a pulse on trends and category landscape that can influence product development pipelines.
* Accountable for analyzing multiple sources of data effectively to extract insights, find opportunities and risks, and take strategic actions on your brands. Includes POS data ( e.g. IRI monthly), shipments, consumer research and 3 rd party data.
* Able to turn data into implications and actions for the brand.

**Base Brand/Portfolio Management**

* Develop strategic brand plans and translate strategies into annual marketing plans and programs in an effort to exceed stated volume and profit objectives
* Works collaboratively with the team and cross functional partners, leveraging the knowledge and expertise of others to meet brand objectives .
* Works with the Sales Management and R&D teams to prioritize projects and related opportunities based on size of price and strategic considerations related to the consumer and the customer.
* Acts as general manager for brand P&L, understanding opportunities and risks in line items from topline and bottom line. Requires developing understanding of cross-functional costs.
* Partners with Finance to ensure accuracy of P&L inputs and run scenarios for existing business as well as new projects impacting brand , e.g. innovation launches, renovation changes, customer-specific opportunities.
* Advocates for improvements to brand P&L while weighing in voice of the consumer.

**Innovation & Renovation**

* Leads new product ideation and conceptualization for base brands.
* Builds 5- year pipeline for brand portfolio including ideation, concept development, testing, technical assessments, financial assessments and project management.
* Leads packaging strategy to maximize brand equity at retail. Oversee the development of packaging graphics modification projects across agencies, internal cross-functional teams, other segment leaders, and Sales to ensure smooth product/graphics development and launches.
* Directs resource allocation (human and financial) and oversees implementation of innovation and renovation projects in brand portfolio.

**Branding And Communications**

* Directs product definition and packaging graphics direction.
* Ensures execution of packaging development projects.
* Guides marketing team and agencies in the planning of consumer advertising and promotions.
* Manages communications plan execution to deliver on-budget, growth-driving tactics in packaging, promotions, advertising, digital and social engagement.
* Works collaboratively with the Sales team to drive growth with retailers striving to reach the consumer and provides strategic direction in the development of selling and customer presentation documents.

**Team Leadership & Development**

* Identifies and leads direct reports, staff and agencies in management of efficient brand/product portfolio decisions including SKU rationalization, pricing, pack development and customer relations to deliver annual and long-term sales and profit objectives .
* Partners with SVP of Marketing to establish marketing’s cross-functional leadership role in order to build a high performance cross-functional culture with sales, manufacturing, operations, purchasing, distribution, finance and outside agency partners, suppliers and brokers.
* Directs growth in marketing team’s business acumen including consumer insights, project management, financials, forecasting, building a business case, customer relations and presentation skills.

**Evaluation Metrics**

* Brand or Sub-brand $ Sales, $ Sales growth and Market Share, Margin targets
* Flawless execution of project deliverables
* On-time timeline deliverables
* Brand Health scores ( e.g. share of voice, brand equity purchase funnel, household panel indicators)
* Innovation & Renovation Concept Scores
* Innovation & Renovation $ Sales and New product performance vs. forecast
* KPIs met on consumer campaigns and communication activities
* Self-development and team development goals

**Qualifications**
**Required:**

* Bachelor's degree in Marketing or related field
* 8-10 years of brand management experience within the CPG industry
* 3+ years managing direct reports
* Strong proficiency in Microsoft (Word, Excel, and PowerPoint)
* Strong interpersonal

**Preferred**

* MBA

**Work Designation**
This position is a Hybrid position at our Corporate Office which is 3 days onsite and 2 days remote.
  
  
**Pay Range**
USD $180,000.00 - USD $210,000.00 /Yr.
  
  
**About Us**
OUR FOUNDER, MOMOFUKU ANDO
  
  
There is only one company that can rightfully claim the Pinnacle of Noodledom. Only one company whose founder, faced with a Japanese food shortage after WWII, invented instant ramen and sparked a 3-minute global revolution. Only one whose spirit of innovation continues to provide simple, nourishing delight to billions of people. Only one that has been loved around the world for more than 60 years. There is only one Nissin Foods.
  
  
NISSIN IN THE U.S.
  
  
On a trip to the U.S. in 1966, Mr. Ando noticed Americans curiously eating forkfuls of noodles out of cups, instead of using bowls and chopsticks. With that simple observation, the worldwide Cup Noodles® phenomenon was born. Shortly after, Nissin officially put down its roots in the U.S. In 1972, our Gardena, CA, plant started production of Top Ramen®—the first instant ramen manufactured and sold in the U.S. And ever since, Nissin Foods USA has launched a continuous stream of new and innovative products for hungry, noodle-loving Americans.
  
  
WHY NISSIN?
  
  
Nissin Foods celebrates diversity and inclusion both in our brands and how we do business. Why? Innovation is best driven by diverse perspectives, which create unique results. Respect, steady professional growth, and quality work make our team stronger. We welcome quality folks to join Team Nissin and fulfill our mission to “make people happy by creating delicious, convenient and value-oriented Asian-inspired meal solutions.” If you celebrate innovation and love noodles, you belong here!

title: Director of Brand Marketing
description:

This role partners closely with Product Marketing, Growth Marketing, Strategic Insights, Creative Services, Media, and agency partners to develop breakthrough campaigns, launch new products and promotions, and ensure a consistent, distinctive brand experience. Acts as a steward of the Jack in the Box brand, translating strategy into actionable marketing plans, briefs, campaigns, and programs that resonate with consumers and deliver measurable business results.

title: Director, M&A Integration
description:
Aperture brings together leading forensic specialists and technical consultants who clarify complex events, strengthen business decisions, and deliver answers grounded in science and extensive industry experience. Aperture has grown through the combination of fifteen firms and continues to acquire founder-led practices and recruit senior experts and their teams.

**Salary**  
$150,000 - $200,000 base salary, plus annual bonus and eligibility for Aperture's Management Incentive Plan.

**Description**  
As Director of M&A Integration, you will own the onboarding and first year of every firm and team that joins Aperture, whether through acquisition or by recruiting senior experts with their practices. You will lead each one from the time we sign the LOI, through diligence and closing, and through the first 180 days with the platform and beyond, as one of the primary points of contact for the founder and management team. You will own the onboarding plan, the milestone reporting to leadership, and the onboarding playbook, and you will report to the Vice President, Corporate Development & Strategy.  
You will work alongside our Director of Change Management, who runs platform-wide programs, while you run the deal-specific work. This is a hands-on role: you will design the onboarding playbook, build its tools, and run it yourself on live deals. The role has no direct reports at the start and coordinates cross-functional teams on every deal. This position may be remote or hybrid from any Aperture office within the United States, with approximately 25% travel.  
Essential Functions

**Before close (LOI to closing)**  

* Join each deal at the letter of intent, participate in diligence, and convert its findings into the onboarding plan before closing, including the risks to resolve and the value creation levers to pursue
* Build the functional workplan with Finance, HR, Legal, IT, and Marketing, including Day 1 requirements: payroll and benefits, entity and banking, licensure and insurance, and systems access
* Set the first-year plan with the deal team and FP&A: revenue and profitability against the investment case, named-expert retention, and realized rate

**Day 1 through Day 180**  

* Own the master onboarding plan for each acquired firm and hold functional leads to committed dates
* Lead the weekly onboarding call with each acquired firm from Day 1 through Day 180
* Track the value creation levers and retention commitments for each firm, and report milestones, risks, and open decisions to leadership and to the sponsor as part of the regular M&A update
* Surface roadblocks and opportunities early enough to act on them, and bring the decisions that need an executive to the executive who owns them
* Close out each firm at Day 180 against the onboarding completion conditions set at closing.

**Founder, experts and clients**  

* Serve as the primary point of contact for the founder and leadership of each acquired firm from Day 1 through steady state; identify what is stuck and resolve it
* Coordinate the retention plan for named experts and the client transition with the practice leader, so that law-firm relationships and open matters carry over without interruption
* Plan employee communications for each deal with the Director of Change Management
* Run the same onboarding process for experts and teams recruited from competitors

**Playbook and reporting**  

* Design, build, and run the onboarding playbook: the workplan templates, trackers, and checklists each firm moves through; update it after each deal
* Maintain plan status so leadership can read progress at any time

**What Success Looks Like in the First Year**  

* Every firm closed during the year reaches its 180-day targets with the completion conditions signed off.
* The weekly onboarding call runs consistently from Day 1 through Day 180 on every deal.
* First-year EBITDA of acquired firms is reported monthly against the investment case with FP&A, and the value creation levers for each firm have a named owner and a status.
* Named-expert retention at twelve and twenty-four months and realized rate are tracked for every firm.
* The onboarding playbook exists in one place, has been through at least three deals, and the fourth deal runs smoother than the first.

**Other Duties**  
This job description is not designed to cover or contain a comprehensive listing of activities, duties or responsibilities that are required of the employee for this job. Duties, responsibilities and activities may change at any time with or without notice.

**Qualifications**  

* Bachelor's degree or higher in business, finance, accounting, engineering, or a related field, or equivalent experience
* Eight or more years in M&A integration, corporate development, or operations at an acquisitive company, including five or more years leading integrations end to end
* Personally led the integration of five or more acquired companies from diligence through stabilization, including founder-led professional services firms of roughly five to fifty people
* Experience inside a private equity-backed platform with an active add-on program: sponsor reporting, a value creation plan, and three or more closes a year
* Personally designed, built, and ran an integration playbook and the milestone reporting behind it, rather than overseeing others who did; candidates will be asked to walk through both
* Track record of holding functional leaders to dates without line authority, and of working directly with management after close
* Outstanding oral and written communication skills and able to interact effectively with executives, functional leaders and the owners of acquired firms

**Preferred Qualifications**  

* Integration experience in professional services (expert witness, legal, consulting, accounting, or engineering services)
* Experience onboarding senior professionals or teams recruited with a book of business, for example lateral partner integration at a law firm

**Personal Attributes**  

* Credible with the executive team and the sponsor, and with a founder who has just sold the firm they built
* Holds people to dates without authority over them, and does it in a way that keeps the relationship
* Owns the outcome rather than advising on it, and stays engaged through Day 180 when progress stalls
* A doer: designs the playbook, builds the tools, and runs the plan personally rather than directing others to
* Direct, organized, and influential

**Physical Requirements**  

* Work is primarily computer-based and involves remaining in a stationary position for extended periods
* Ability to travel approximately 25%, including overnight stays, with or without reasonable accommodation

**Work Environment**  
This position may be performed remotely or on a hybrid basis from any Aperture office within the United States. Travel is approximately 25%, primarily to acquired firms around closing and as needed during their first 180 days, with occasional travel to Aperture offices for business purposes.  
Benefits  
We strive to offer an environment that provides our employees with the right balance between work and family. We offer a comprehensive benefits package including:  

* Medical, dental, vision, and life insurance
* 401K with company discretionary contributions
* Paid holidays, paid time off, and floating holiday time

**Hours of Work**  

* Classification: Exempt
* Full-time: Defined as 5 days a week for at least 40 hours per week. At times, the employee may be required to work over 40 hours per week in order to successfully complete the expected job duties and projects. When traveling, employee may be exposed to longer work hours.

Our commitment to equal employment opportunities shall include employment, upgrading, promotion, demotion, transfer, leaves or other absences from work, layoff, compensation and benefits, selection for training or other education, professional opportunities, and conflict resolution.

title: Director, Business Analysis
description:
**Director, Business Analysis**

BillGO is seeking a Director, Business Analysis to drive data-informed strategy and decision-making across BGX. This role will lead a team supporting both acquisition and existing customer experience analytics, helping drive insights and optimizations.

You’ll partner closely with BillGO Exchange leadership, marketing, customer experience, product, data and growth teams to analyze acquisition performance across channels, understand customer behavior, and identify opportunities to improve experiences and deliver insights that increase growth, retention and lifetime value. This role plays a key part in ensuring BillGO not only acquires customers—but keeps and grows them effectively.

**Why This Role Matters**

This role is critical to BillGO’s growth because it ensures that customer strategies are effective, scalable, and data-driven. By turning complex marketing, customer behavior, and lifecycle performance data into actionable insights, this role directly impacts how effectively we attract, convert, grow and retain customers to maximize their lifetime value.

Without this role, acquisition and customer retention efforts risk becoming fragmented or inefficient; with it, BillGO gains clear visibility into what drives growth and engagement, enabling smarter, more targeted decisions, faster experimentation, and stronger returns.

**What You’ll Do**

**Customer Acquisition Strategy**

* Drive analysis on end-to-end acquisition funnel performance (impressions to clicks to conversions to activation) to identify trends, anomalies and opportunities
* Develop insights to identify high-value customer segments and optimize audience targeting, segmentation, and channel mix.
* Build models and analyses to understand customer acquisition cost (CAC), lifetime value (LTV), and payback periods.
* Support forecasting and scenario planning for acquisition growth.

**Customer Experience Strategy**

* Drive analysis of the end-to-end customer lifecycle (onboarding to activation to engagement to retention) to identify key business opportunities and strategies to increase customer lifetime value (LTV).
* Identify key drivers behind activation, adoption, and attrition.
* Identify high-value and at-risk customer segments and recommend targeted actions.
* Conduct cohort and longitudinal analyses to understand customer trends over time.
* Deliver insights to improve customer retention, utilization, and frequency of use.
* Partner with product and customer teams to identify friction points and opportunities in the user experience.
* Develop and maintain customer segmentation frameworks (behavioral, cohort-based, value-based).

**Test Design & Analysis**

* Partner with marketing teams to design and measure A/B tests and experiments.
* Partner with product to design and measure tests across the product lifecycle

**Data & Reporting**

* Create and maintain dashboards and reporting frameworks across the acquisition and customer management value chain.
* Ensure stakeholders have clear visibility into key metrics
* Translate complex data into clear, actionable insights for stakeholders.

**Cross-Functional Leadership**

* Influence stakeholders and drive clarity on strategies, priorities, and trade-offs
* Build and mentor analysts as the function scales

**What You Bring**

* Bachelor’s degree in Business or quantitative field (Economics, Finance, Math, Physical Sciences, Statistics, Engineering, etc)
* 5+ years of experience in quantitative analytics
* 2+ years of experience in people management
* Demonstrated ability to problem solve and make decisions based on analysis
* Proven track record of creating and delivering business strategies that enable growth and profitability
* Strong proficiency with data analysis tools and experience working with large datasets
* Experience with cohort analysis and customer segmentation, preferably across the lifecycle from acquisition through retention
* Ability to leverage AI tools (e.g., Claude, ChatGPT) as a force multiplier to improve speed, quality, and impact of work.
* Action-oriented and results-focused approach to decision-making and problem solving
* Demonstrated ability to communicate effectively across levels and groups to drive alignment
* Strong experience working cross-functionally with marketing, data, product, risk, and engineering teams

**Preferred**

* Experience in fintech, payments, banking, or lending

Description Director AI Engineering (Remote Eligible)

At Capital One, we are creating responsible and reliable AI systems, changing banking for good. For years, Capital One has been an industry leader in using machine learning to create real-time, personalized customer experiences. Our investments in technology infrastructure and world-class talent — along with our deep experience in machine learning — position us to be at the forefront of enterprises leveraging AI. From informing customers about unusual charges to answering their questions in real time, our applications of AI & ML are bringing humanity and simplicity to banking. We are committed to continuing to build world-class applied science and engineering teams to deliver our industry leading capabilities with breakthrough product experiences and scalable, high-performance AI infrastructure. At Capital One, you will help bring the transformative power of emerging AI capabilities to reimagine how we serve our customers and businesses who have come to love the products and services we build.

  
  

**Team Description:**

  
  

The Generative AI Training team builds the platform Capital One's scientists and engineers use to train, fine-tune, and experiment with foundation models at scale. We run the GPU clusters and distributed training infrastructure behind the company's generative AI: fair-share scheduling across teams, large-scale fine-tuning and reinforcement learning, resilience for long-running jobs, and the utilization controls that keep that expensive hardware working efficiently. We also provide the self-service environments where teams deploy, serve, and evaluate models during experimentation, built on tools like KServe and vLLM. The platform we build is a central leverage point for AI across Capital One, shaping how fast and how affordable the rest of the company can build with foundation models.

  
  

**What You’ll Do:**

* Partner with a cross-functional team of engineers, research scientists, technical program managers, and product managers to deliver AI-powered products that change how our associates work and how our customers interact with Capital One.
* Oversee the design, development, testing, deployment, and operation of the platform's core systems: distributed training and fine-tuning, reinforcement learning workflows, fair-share GPU scheduling, job resilience and fault tolerance, GPU utilization and efficiency, and self-service environments for model experimentation and evaluation.
* Make high judgment build-vs-buy decisions across a broad stack of Open Source and SaaS AI technologies such as AWS Ultraclusters, Huggingface, VectorDBs, PyTorch, and more.
* Invent and introduce state-of-the-art techniques to improve the scalability, cost, throughput, and reliability of large-scale distributed training and fine-tuning.
* Own GPU capacity planning and cost governance: right-size clusters, instance types, and quotas to the needs of training and experimentation workloads across teams.
* Contribute to the technical vision and the long term roadmap of foundational AI systems at Capital One.
* Attract and retain top talent in the AI industry and nurture personal and professional development for your team. Foster a culture of learning and staying abreast of the state-of-the-art in AI.
* Translate the enterprise AI strategy into portfolio-level execution plans across multiple product areas, balancing innovation with delivery discipline
* Scale AI engineering practices across teams through shared infrastructure, reusable components, and unified observability and governance frameworks
* Establish enterprise standard for Responsible AI, including fairness metrics, model evaluation protocols, documentation requirements, and audit readiness
* Partner with research, compliance, and enterprise risk teams to ensure deployed systems meet emerging ethical and regulatory standards
  

  

**The Ideal Candidate:**

* You love to build systems, take pride in the quality of your work, and also share our passion to do the right thing. You want to work on problems that will help change banking for good
* Passion for staying abreast of the latest research, and an ability to intuitively understand scientific publications and judiciously apply novel techniques in production
* You get fulfillment from empowering others to achieve their potential and you actively drive professional development through mentoring and coaching. You are hands-on when necessary and lead by example
* You adapt quickly and thrive on bringing clarity to big, undefined problems. You love asking questions and digging deep to uncover the root of problems and can articulate your findings concisely with clarity. You have the courage to share new ideas even when they are unproven
* You are deeply Technical. You possess a strong foundation in engineering and mathematics, and your expertise in hardware, software, and AI enables you to see and exploit optimization opportunities that others miss
* You are a resilient trailblazer who can forge new paths to achieve business goals when the route is unknown
  

  

**Capital One is open to hiring a Remote Employee for this opportunity.**

  
  

**Basic Qualifications:**

* Bachelor's Degree in Computer Science, AI, Electrical Engineering, Computer Engineering, or related fields plus at least 8 years of experience developing AI and ML algorithms or technologies, or a Master's degree in Computer Science, AI, Electrical Engineering, Computer Engineering, or related fields plus at least 6 years of experience developing AI and ML algorithms or technologies
* At least 3 years of people leadership experience
  

  

**Preferred Qualifications:**

* 5+ years of experience managing and leading an engineering team
* 7+ years of experience building and operating large-scale ML or GPU training infrastructure on cloud platforms (e.g., AWS, Google Cloud, Azure, or equivalent private cloud)
* Hands-on experience with distributed training at scale: multi-node, multi-GPU jobs and parallelism strategies (e.g., PyTorch FSDP, DeepSpeed, Megatron), with proficiency in Python, Go, C++, or CUDA
* Experience with the ML orchestration and scheduling stack (e.g., Kubernetes, Kubeflow, Kueue, Slurm, Ray, KServe, vLLM)
* Experience operating large GPU fleets with a focus on reliability, fault tolerance, utilization, and cost efficiency
* Experience right-sizing GPU clusters, instance types, interconnect, and quotas to training and experimentation workload requirements (e.g., model size, parallelism strategy, throughput targets)
* Passion for staying abreast of the latest AI and ML-systems research, and judiciously applying novel training and optimization techniques
* Excellent communication and presentation skills, with the ability to articulate complex AI and infrastructure concepts to peers
* Experience building and leading a multi-team AI organization delivering multiple enterprise capabilities concurrently
* Proven ability to expand and execute long-term AI platform strategies aligned to enterprise priorities and regulatory frameworks
* Experience establishing cross-functional operating rhythms and review cadences (OKRs, AI governance councils, quarterly reviews)

description:
**Position Overview**

We are seeking an experienced Senior Manager to join Nscale as the senior manager for our colocation-based facilities overseeing mission-critical data center construction programs. This individual holds accountability for schedule, budget, quality, safety, and risk across all active project sites, and provides direct oversight to the General Construction Manager(s), Preconstruction Manager, Construction Scheduler, Cost Manager, and EHS Manager supporting the program.

The ideal candidate has led complex, multi-site or large single-site data center programs and can translate Nscale's strategic priorities into consistent execution standards across teams and project sites, while serving as the primary escalation point when issues exceed site-level authority.

**Key Responsibilities**

* Provide senior-level oversight of the overall construction program on behalf of Nscale, directly supervising the General Construction Manager(s), Preconstruction Manager, Construction Scheduler, Cost Manager, and EHS Manager
* Serve as the primary escalation point for schedule, cost, quality, and safety issues that exceed site-level authority
* Own the master program schedule and budget; report program status, risk, and financial performance directly to the Director and executive stakeholders
* Review and approve significant change orders, claims, and contract modifications prior to Nscale sign-off
* Chair OAC (Owner-Architect-Contractor) meetings and represent Nscale in key negotiations with General Contractors, design teams, and vendors
* Mentor and develop direct reports; establish and enforce consistent reporting standards, documentation practices, and quality expectations across all sites
* Preserve the independence of the program controls and safety functions, ensuring the Construction Scheduler, Cost Manager, and EHS Manager can escalate concerns without site-level interference
* Coordinate cross-project resources, staffing, and vendor allocation to meet program-wide priorities and deadlines
* Oversee commissioning, turnover, and closeout processes at the program level, ensuring consistency and completeness across sites
* Manage relationships with Nscale leadership, investors, and executive stakeholders; deliver periodic program-level updates and briefings
* Identify and mitigate program-level risks, including schedule slippage, cost overruns, supply chain disruptions, and resource conflicts
* Ensure compliance with contract terms, safety standards, and quality requirements across the full project portfolio

**Qualifications**

**Required**

* 10+ years of construction management experience, including 5+ years overseeing data center, mission-critical, or large-scale industrial programs
* Demonstrated experience directly managing General Construction Managers, program controls (scheduling and cost) functions, EHS leadership, and multi-site subcontractor teams
* Strong command of program-level scheduling (CPM), budget and cost control, and contract administration
* Proficiency in Procore, Bluebeam Revu, and Microsoft Office Suite
* Ability to read and interpret full construction document sets across civil, structural, architectural, and MEP disciplines
* OSHA 30 certification required
* Valid driver's license; ability to travel between multiple project sites as required

**Preferred**

* Experience overseeing hyperscale, colocation, or Tier III/IV data center construction programs
* Familiarity with DCIM systems, raised floor environments, or critical power/cooling infrastructure at a portfolio level
* Experience with program-level reporting and analytics tools (e.g., Power BI)
* PMP, CCM, or equivalent credential
* Bachelor's degree in Construction Management, Civil Engineering, or related field; advanced degree a plus

**Character & Conduct**

**What We Value Most: Character & Conduct**

Technical skills can be taught. Character cannot. At Nscale, we're looking for people who show up with integrity, treat others with respect, and take genuine ownership of their work. As a senior leader on the program, this individual also sets the tone for every direct report and site team they oversee. The following traits matter as much to us as any credential or years of experience:

* Integrity — does the right thing even when no one is watching; never misrepresents status, costs, or progress to protect themselves or their team

* Ownership mentality — treats the program as their own and holds themselves and their direct reports accountable without being told

* Respectful under pressure — stays composed and professional with contractors, trades, direct reports, and internal Nscale teams regardless of the circumstances

* Transparent communicator — surfaces problems early and honestly, never buries bad news, and expects the same from the teams they lead

* Team-first attitude — ego stays at the gate; the program and the people on it come first

* Reliable and consistent — shows up prepared, follows through on commitments, and does what they say they will do

*We actively seek references that speak to a candidate's character, not just their technical output.*

**Tools & Software**

* Procore — program-wide project management, RFIs, submittals, daily reporting, and document control
* Bluebeam Revu — drawing markup, QA/QC overlays
* Microsoft Suite — Word, Excel, Outlook (required); MS Project or Primavera P6 (preferred)
* Power BI or equivalent — program-level reporting and dashboarding (preferred)

**Work Environment & Schedule**

* Full-time role with regular travel across multiple project sites; on-site presence required as needed, particularly during critical milestones
* Schedule flexibility required to support program needs across sites, teams, and time zones
* Active construction environment when on-site — PPE required at all times

title: Provider Recruiting Manager
description:
**About TeleMed2U**

At TeleMed2U, we believe that time is the most valuable resource in healthcare— whether it is time to diagnosis, time to treatment, or time to better health. That is why, since our founding in 2011, we have been dedicated to increasing access to care across 20 medical and behavioral health specialties nationwide. By breaking down traditional barriers to specialty care, TeleMed2U has become a leading technology-enabled healthcare services company, delivering high-quality, convenient, and easy-to-access virtual healthcare solutions. Our integrated approach to chronic disease management empowers both patients and providers, improving health outcomes through seamless care coordination. With a focus on patient-centered innovation, provider collaboration, and data-driven care delivery, TeleMed2U is redefining specialty care—making it faster, simpler, and more accessible for all.

**About the Role**

The Recruiting Manager is responsible for leading TeleMed2U's multi-specialty provider recruitment function, ensuring the organization attracts, hires, and retains exceptional physicians, advanced practice providers, and psychotherapy providers to support clinical growth and strategic objectives. This role oversees full-cycle recruitment activities across a diverse portfolio of specialties, workforce planning initiatives, recruitment marketing, and talent pipeline development. The Recruiting Manager partners closely with the director of provider recruitment, clinical leadership, and operational stakeholders to develop and execute hiring strategies that support expansion efforts, provider excellence, and business growth while delivering an exceptional candidate and hiring leader experience.

**What you'll do**

Talent Acquisition Strategy & Planning

* Develop and implement a comprehensive recruiting strategy aligned with TeleMed2U's growth plans, workforce needs, and organizational values.
* Partner with Operations and department leaders to understand current and future hiring needs, create workforce plans, and prioritize open roles.
* Identify effective sourcing channels and recruitment approaches for a variety of clinical positions in 20 specialties across 50 states.

Full-Cycle Recruiting & Candidate Management

* Oversee and participate in full-cycle recruiting, including job posting, sourcing, screening, interviewing, and offer management.
* Ensure timely and high-quality communication with candidates throughout the hiring process, providing a professional and positive candidate experience.
* Guide and support hiring managers on interviewing best practices, selection criteria, and decision-making to ensure fair and consistent hiring decisions.
* Coordinate and refine interview processes, including panel interviews, assessments, and hiring events as applicable.

Team Leadership & Development

* Lead, mentor, and manage Recruiting and Talent Acquisition staff, providing coaching, feedback, and performance management.
* Set clear goals and expectations for the recruiting team, aligned with time-to-fill, quality-of-hire, and candidate experience metrics.
* Foster a collaborative, service-oriented, and results-driven culture within the recruiting team.
* Identify training and development needs for recruiting staff and support ongoing skill development.
* Develop and maintain proactive pipelines of qualified candidates through sourcing, networking, social media, job boards, professional associations, and employee referrals.

Process, Technology & Compliance

* Manage and optimize the applicant tracking system (ATS) Greenhouse and related recruiting tools to ensure accurate data, efficient workflows, and strong reporting capabilities.
* Develop and maintain standardized recruiting processes, templates, and tools to ensure consistency and scalability across the organization.
* Ensure recruiting practices comply with applicable federal, state, and local employment laws and regulations, including EEO and fair hiring standards.
* Partner with HR to support background checks, employment verifications, and pre-employment requirements in alignment with company policy.

Metrics, Reporting & Continuous Improvement

* Establish, track, and report on key recruiting metrics (e.g., time-to-fill, cost-per-hire, source effectiveness, candidate satisfaction, quality-of-hire).
* Use data and feedback from candidates and hiring managers to identify trends, bottlenecks, and opportunities to improve recruiting processes.
* Recommend and implement process improvements, technology enhancements, and best practices to enhance efficiency, candidate quality, and overall recruiting effectiveness.

Cross-Functional Collaboration & Onboarding Support

* Collaborate with HR, Hiring Managers, and Operations to ensure smooth transitions from hiring to onboarding.
* Provide input on workforce planning, job design, and organizational structure as it relates to recruitment.
* Participate in cross-functional projects and initiatives that impact talent acquisition and workforce development.
* Other duties as assigned

**Qualifications**

Required

Education & Experience

* Bachelor's degree in Human Resources, Business Administration, or a related field, or equivalent combination of education and experience.
* 5+ years of progressive experience in recruiting or talent acquisition, including full-cycle recruiting in a corporate or agency setting.
* 2+ years of experience in a leadership or supervisory role within recruiting or talent acquisition.
* Experience recruiting for a mix of roles (e.g., clinical, technical, operational, and/or leadership positions), preferably within healthcare or telehealth.

Skills & Competencies

* Strong knowledge of full-cycle recruiting processes, sourcing strategies, and selection best practices.
* Demonstrated ability to lead, develop, and motivate recruiting teams in a remote or distributed environment.
* Excellent communication and interpersonal skills, with the ability to build strong relationships with candidates, hiring managers, and leadership.
* Strong organizational and time management skills, with the ability to manage multiple requisitions and priorities simultaneously.
* Proficiency with applicant tracking systems (ATS), HRIS, and standard office productivity tools.
* Understanding of applicable employment laws and regulations related to recruiting, selection, and hiring.
* Data-driven mindset with the ability to interpret metrics and use insights to drive continuous improvement.
* High level of professionalism, integrity, discretion, and sound judgment, especially when handling confidential information.

Preferred

title: VP, Growth Enablement and Operations
description:
**Why Work at Mercer Advisors?**

For more than 40 years, Mercer Advisors has been helping families amplify and simplify their financial lives by integrating financial planning, investment management, business management, tax, estate, insurance, and more, all managed by a single team. We deliver the kind of comprehensive care once reserved for only the wealthiest households.

Today, we serve over 42,800+ families across 110+ cities across the U.S. Ranked the #1 RIA Firm in the nation by Barron's for two consecutive years, Mercer Advisors is an independent fiduciary legally bound to act in our clients' best interests — always.\*

Mercer Advisors offers a workplace that stands apart in the financial industry. More than half of our employees and client-facing professionals are women, reflecting the clients we serve. With a flexible, national footprint, we build our teams around exceptional talent — wherever they are.

Join us and help families amplify and simplify their financial lives with confidence.

* *Mercer Advisors was ranked #1 for RIA firms with up to $70 billion in assets. The Barron's top RIA ranking is based on a combination of metrics – including size, growth, service quality, technology, succession planning and others. No fee was paid for participation in the ranking, however, Mercer Advisors has paid a fee to Barron's to use the ranking in marketing. Please see important information about the ranking criteria methodology* *here**.*

  

**Job Summary:**

Mercer Advisors is looking for a rare operator — someone who can think strategically, move fast, and get a lot done. As VP of Sales Enablement and Operations, you'll sit at the center of one of the most ambitious client development builds in the wealth management industry, responsible for three of the most critical levers in our growth engine. This is a purpose-built role designed for where we are going — not a backfill — created to bring structure, visibility, and momentum to a Growth organization that spans Client Development and Marketing.

This is not a role for someone who manages from a distance. You'll roll up your sleeves every single day — building roadmaps, coordinating conversion programs, running operating rhythms, and leading a high-performing central Revenue Operations and Enablement team. You bring clarity to complexity, urgency to problems, and follow-through to everything you touch.

You'll directly lead the Central Revenue Operations and Enablement team — a four-person team that spans both operational infrastructure and field enablement. Beyond your direct team, you'll orchestrate the broader network of shared services and program managers who keep the Client Development organization running. You'll also serve as a key operating partner within the broader Growth leadership team, which spans Client Development and Marketing program leads. This VP role facilitates and operationalizes decisions — you bring visibility, sequencing, and follow-through. Decision authority sits with Growth leadership.

**Essential Job Functions for this role include:**

**Orchestrate the Value Creation and Program Roadmap**

* Own the master roadmap for the Growth organization — tracking all active programs and projects across Client Development, Growth programs, and shared services, sequencing rollouts, and ensuring shared resources are applied in the right order.

* Portfolio governance: own intake, visibility, sequencing, and capacity management across initiatives — facilitating prioritization decisions with Growth leadership, not making them unilaterally

* Partner with program managers and shared services teams across the broader Growth organization — including initiatives that span Client Development, Marketing, Technology, and Analytics — to facilitate cross-functional coordination, align priorities, remove dependencies, and ensure initiatives progress efficiently

* Maintain a live view of what's in flight, what's at risk, and what needs a decision — surfacing that picture to leadership clearly and consistently

  

**Own the Operating Cadence for the Client Development Team**

* Design and own the meeting cadences, agendas, and operating rituals that keep the Client Development organization aligned and moving forward

* Ensure the right conversations happen at the right time — weekly team syncs, monthly program reviews, quarterly roadmap sessions, and annual planning cycles

* Track key initiatives across the organization, ensuring accountability, follow-through, and visibility for senior leadership

* Produce clear, concise leadership updates and board-ready materials that reflect the state of the Client Development organization

  

**Lead the Revenue Operations and Enablement Team**

* Directly manage 4 members of the Revenue Operations and Enablement team — spanning both operational infrastructure and field enablement — providing clear direction, active coaching, and a culture of high performance

* Set priorities for the central revenue operations team on a weekly and quarterly basis — ensuring the team is working on the highest-leverage activities

* Build a team that operates with urgency, precision, and a bias for action — you set the standard and model it every day

* Drive execution through structured two-week sprints — keeping the team focused on the highest-priority work, moving with urgency, and maintaining clear accountability for what gets done each cycle

* RVP onboarding and training — your team builds and owns the onboarding experience that gets new RVPs productive quickly and aligned to how we work

* Rolling out new capabilities — serve as the deployment lead for new tools, programs, and processes, ensuring field teams understand, adopt, and leverage what's being launched

* Driving change management — lead the people side of significant organizational shifts, including new technology rollouts, compensation plan changes, and territory design

* Partner with the Head of Client Development to grow the Revenue Operations and Enablement function over time, making the case for investment where it's needed

**Own the Conversion Improvement Roadmap**

* Own the conversion improvement roadmap — a prioritized, sequenced, and living view of what's being worked on, what's at risk, and what needs a decision to move forward

* Drive cross-program coordination across all conversion drivers — Proposals, Training, High Value Opportunities, and Performance Coaching — ensuring these programs are sequenced well, not working at cross-purposes, and that blockers get surfaced and resolved quickly

* Partner with the data analytics team — who own full-funnel conversion reporting — to stay current on conversion trends, risks, and program-level performance, and translate that data into clear leadership updates that identify where the system needs attention

* Talk regularly to the field — RVPs, Managing Directors, and advisors — to understand what's holding up conversion in real time, and bring those insights back to the program leads who own the levers

*This role owns the roadmap, the coordination, the visibility, and the follow-through — ensuring the system is working even when no single person owns the whole thing*

* Surface blockers quickly and clearly — escalating where decisions are needed, and ensuring nothing stalls because the right people weren't in the room

* Report on conversion progress, trends, and opportunities to Growth leadership on a regular cadence — producing a clear, concise picture of where we stand and what needs attention

**Work Schedule:**

This professional role requires availability during standard business hours of Monday through Friday from 8AM to 5PM. At times, the role may have early or late hours to meet business tasks and deadlines for external and internal client needs.

All roles classified as a non-exempt are required to record working time into the timekeeping system daily at the start and end of each workday plus a 30-minute unpaid lunch period.

**Working Conditions:**

This position may be in a professional office environment or a dedicated home office workspace which is free of interruptions. Whether position is in a dedicated office space or home office workspace, basic technology needs will be provided to satisfy position requirements. Routinely sitting and standing for periods of time. No heavy lifting over 10 lbs.

**Application Deadline**: The initial deadline for applications is 11/23/2026. Applications submitted after this date may still be considered on a rolling basis until the position/program is filled. We encourage all interested candidates to apply as early as possible. If a final decision has not been made by the initial deadline, subsequent applications will be reviewed as they are received.

**Benefits:**

Mercer Advisors offers a competitive and robust benefit package to our employees. Our benefit programs are focused on meeting all of our employees and their eligible dependents health and welfare needs. We offer the following:

* Company Paid Basic Life & AD&D Insurance
* Company Paid Short-Term and Long-Term Disability Insurance
* Supplemental Life & AD&D; Short-Term Disability; Accident; Critical Illness; and Hospital Indemnity Insurance
* Three Cigna medical plans offerings including two High Deductible Health Plans and a Traditional Co-Pay medical plan.
* Kaiser Medical plans available in California
* Health Savings Account (HSA) with company contributions if enrolled in either HDHP medical plan.
* Two comprehensive Dental Plans
* Vision Insurance Plan
* Dependent Care Savings Account for child and dependent care.
* 14 Company Paid Holidays including a full week off at Thanksgiving.
* Generous paid time off program for vacation and sick days
* Employee Assistance Plan
* Family Medical Leave
* Paid Parental Leave (8 weeks)
* Maternity benefits utilizing company paid STD, any supplemental STD, plus Parental Leave (8 weeks) to provide time for recovery, baby bonding, and enjoying your family time.
* Adoption Assistance Reimbursement Program
* Company Paid Concierge Services for you and your loved ones for the spectrum of caring needs for your aging parents, young children, life's challenges and more.
* 401(k) Retirement Plan with both Traditional and Roth plans with per pay period match as well as an after-tax option
* Pet Insurance
* Personalized financial planning and guidance from Mercer Advisors professionals, offered at preferred employee pricing

**We are not accepting unsolicited resumes from agencies and/or search firms for this job posting.**

title: Principal Data Analyst
description:
**Principal Data Analyst**

New Meridian Corporation, located in Austin, TX seeks outstanding candidates to fill Principal Data Analyst position. This position, reporting to the Director of Psychometrics and Research Services will support New Meridian’s assessment design, psychometric, research, and statistical programming activities to further the goals of New Meridian to develop and market a portfolio of innovative customized assessment offerings.

**WHO WE ARE:**

New Meridian is a non-profit, assessment design and development organization. We believe assessments should focus on skills that matter: critical thinking, deep understanding, and the ability to communicate ideas effectively, helping prepare students to adapt and thrive in a complex world. At New Meridian, we create high-quality assessments that measure these skills to ensure all students have access to valuable educational experiences.

**Our mission is to advance the quality of public education for all students by designing assessments that focus on the skills that matter.**

Our team is defined by a strong commitment to improving student learning, empowering teachers, and advancing the role of high-quality assessment in expanding opportunity for all students. We are recognized leaders in assessment innovation, driven by our willingness to tackle complex challenges and our dedication to delivering exceptional support to our partners.

**WHO WE’RE LOOKING FOR:**

**SUMMARY**: Candidates interested in this position will have a strong working knowledge of and interest in K-12 education, a collaborative working style, and experience in data analysis, data management, and programming.

Successful New Meridian employees possess the following traits:

* *An ability to get things done:* You are results-driven, resourceful, action oriented, and persistent. You consistently look ahead and anticipate needs before they arise.
* *Analytical:* You have strong analytical skills and are comfortable reviewing quantitative data to inform your understanding of the market and customer needs and issues.
* *Creative mindset:* You can quickly adapt and develop creative solutions to challenges. You deeply understand product management principles and can apply them to synthesize information and recommend a plan of action.
* *Emotional intelligence:* You are highly self-aware and perceptive to the dynamics of key relationships. You are positive, empathetic, flexible, and curious. You naturally gain the respect of your colleagues through your authenticity, warmth, and competence.
* *Trustworthy:* You are highly ethical, principled, and mission-driven. You operate with integrity and garner the trust of others. You exemplify the values of the organization

**EXPECTED DUTIES AND RESPONSIBILITIES:**

PSYCHOMETRIC, RESEARCH, AND ASSESSMENT DESIGN SUPPORT

* Performs statistical analysis and data processing tasks which may require a basic understanding of applied statistics and measurement such as multiple regression, reliability, validity, and item response theory. This may include the evaluation of results for reasonableness, by using established program-specific procedures.
* Prepares critical information, including schedules and task lists, and performs quality control on critical information from other sources for statistical procedures, equating plans, test analysis reports, and item and DIF analyses.
* Designs, develops, and coordinates the preparation of tables and text for inclusion in program publications, score reports and other relevant documents.
* Serves as consultant or representative for program(s) when complex computer systems are being designed or revised and when data-related problems need to be resolved.
* Designs, codes, tests, and debugs programs and databases through all levels of complexity
* Contributes to discussion regarding the potential effects of changes in testing program(s); recommends long-range goals and plans for programs (including staffing, budgeting and technology requirements)
* Responsible for identifying the resolution of data-related problems and evaluates data for reasonableness. Train other staff in the use of psychometric and statistical software necessary to carry out required work assignments.
* Responds to requests for data and data interpretation. Identifies the course of action required to process additional and non-routine requests.
* Advanced programming, data analytic and problem-solving skills including:
  + The ability to train and instruct staff on the purpose and necessity of assignments using personal experience and knowledge of programs and their processes.
  + Troubleshoot for the operating systems and/or software programs.
  + Write and/or modify programs with more efficient code, with an eye towards automation, and can train others on how to make their programs more efficient.
  + Replicate other system programs results.
  + Write programs independently to conduct non-routine analyses, special studies and requests under a tight deadline.
  + Apply advanced Excel techniques to manipulate and present data.
* Proactively works toward shorter cycle time and reduced costs, greater customer satisfaction, and quality maintenance by suggesting and implementing process improvements.

PROJECT MANAGEMENT & COMMUNICATION

* Develops, plans, coordinates, and conducts the workflow of statistical operations for complex testing program(s) and research projects with complex procedures, including the implementation of complex data processing systems for these operations.
* Plans and oversees the preparation of statistical procedures memoranda and other statistical documents.
* Develops and manages procedures, processes, and work schedules both within Assessment Design & Development and in conjunction with other departments.
* Independently assigns and monitors work of professional and support staff.
* Works collaboratively with internal team and partners and follows established protocols to fulfill tasks accurately and on time.

* Strong oral and written communication skills.

**REQUIREMENTS AND EXPERIENCE:**

* A Master’s degree or equivalent years of experience in Educational Measurement, Statistics, Mathematics, Psychology or a closely related field.
* Six or more years of experience in managing and coordinating statistical analysis and data processing operations and in performing data analysis by utilizing various types of statistical software packages or programming languages (e.g. SAS, R, or Python).

* Advanced level proficiency with Microsoft Word sufficient to create, format, or merge text and tables for memos and reports.
* Advanced level proficiency with Microsoft Excel in performing data entry, creating and utilizing formulas, efficiently organizing data and information, and analyzing and displaying data.
* Advanced level experience working with Shiny R, Power BI, Tableau, or other data visualization tools.
* Position can be performed remotely or in New Meridian’s offices located in Austin, TX.

* Travel to meetings and conferences as needed (less than 25%).

**SALARY AND BENEFITS:**

We offer a competitive annual salary. Our benefits package includes:

* Medical, prescription, and behavioral health coverages.
* Dental coverage.
* Vision coverage.
* Life and AD&D coverage.
* Short-and long-term disability.
* Employee assistance program.
* 401(k) with company match.
* Up to 20 days of PTO per year.
* 17 paid holidays.
* Accrued Sick Leave
* Paid parental leave.
* Remote work and flexible schedules.

New Meridian Corporation is an equal opportunity employer and encourages individuals of all backgrounds and identities to apply. We are excited to receive applications from people in occupations or positions where they are under-represented, particularly from individuals connected to underserved communities. We feel we are strengthened by diverse perspectives.
